tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba dpal sa skya pa chen po mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs pa dngos grub ma lus pa 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu bzhugs//35 rgya gar skad du/ shrī dharma pra mi siddha shra ra ma hā gu ru badzra ā tsarya na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal chos kyi rje grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /dri med rigs su bsam bzhin sprul pa'i sku/ /grub pa mchog gi sa la nges bzhugs pa'i/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang sku ngo mtshar cha lugs sna tshogs pa/ /ston par mdzad pa kun gyis mthong ma thag /dbang med dad pa'i spu long g.yo mdzad pa'i/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug sku la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gsung chos brgyad grol ba'i ya mtshan tshig /dpal gyi mgul nas sgrib med thol le ba/ /thos pas a 'thas can rnams spa bkong ba'i/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang thugs rnam kun mchog ldan stong nyid dang / /mchog tu mi 'gyur bde chen ro mnyam pas/ /nam yang bde stong rol pas dus 'da' ba'i/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi yon tan skam sar chu 'don zhing / /sra ba'i brag la phyag zhabs rjes 'jog sogs/ /yul snang dbang du lus pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug yon tan bsams bzhin dad/ /gang gi phrin las chos kyi drin nos dang / /zhal mjal gsung thos dkar po'i 'brel can gyis/ /dbus gtsang mnga' ris mdo khams yongs khyab pa'i/ /phrin las rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag khyod gcig bsngags/ /de ltar bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /phrin las rnams kyi rnam thar sgro skur dang / /bral ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i ngag tshig gis/ /gsol 'debs 'di la 'dun rnams skal ba bzang / /bdag 'dra'i lung rtogs yon tan ma lus pa/ /gcig tu spungs kyang mgon khyod rnam thar gyi/

/ngo mtshar gcig gi char yang mi phod pa/ /'di 'dra bsams shing snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /de skad lcam bu'i ngo bstod ma yin zhing / /chos dang zang zing drin la'ang bsams min te/ /des na gnyen gyis 'brel pas ga la zhig /nges par grub pa'i nges shes rnyed las so/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon rnam dkar ba yi mthus/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa'i/ /dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun byang nas /yid la re ba 'di dag 'grub gyur cig /bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag grub pa'i dbang phyug khyed/ /zhabs pad brtan cing bdag kyang tshe mthar phyin/ /bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gdung rigs myur 'byon zhing / /de rgyun skal bar rgyun mi chad par shog /de ltar ci bsam 'grub pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa cher rgyas nas/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor bsam yas kyis/ /dpal ldan sa skya mdzes pa'i rgyan du shog /bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos rje dang / /padma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs/ /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa blo gros kyi/ /bstan pa srid mthar gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba dpal sa skya pa chen po mthu stobs dbang phyug gi ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar rnams mthong ba'i mod la skyes mchog gang de grub pa mchog gi sa la bzhugs pa'i nges shes khyad par can rnyed nas/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub po/ /'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //shrī dharmā swā mi a nanda dā mi ka sya stotta a ho puṣpa mā la na ma:bi ha ra tisma/ dpal chos kyi rje kun dga'i mtshan can la bstod pa ngo mtshar me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/36

rgya gar skad du/ shrī dharmā swā mi a nanda dā mi ka sya stott+ra ya ho puṣpa mā la na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal chos kyi rje kun dga'i mtshan can la bstod pa ngo mtshar me tog gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po tshul khrims 'bar/ /phyi rab ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa zhes/ /dus 'dir spyan snga byams pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so bskal brgyar zhabs brtan mdzod/ /gang sku ngo mtshar tshul khrims dri bsung g.yo/ /gang gsung zab rgyas chos kyi sgo brgya 'byed/ /gang thugs bde gsal mi rtog ngang gnas pa'i/ /gang yang yon tan dpag med gter la 'dud/ /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i rigs sad de/ /yi ge la sogs shes bya'i gnas phal cher/ /ma bslab par yang phul phyin khongs su chud/ /kun gyi yid rab 'phrog par mdzad la 'dud/ /mgon khyod sku gsum mngon du mdzad zin yang / /'jig rten drang phyir brgyud ldan bla ma las/ /skyon med bstan pa'i rtsa ba legs nos te/ /dkar phyogs lha yis dga' ston spel la 'dud/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i skyes chen bgrangs yas las/ /mdo sngags zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /ngoms pa med par gsol ba'i dge mtshan gyis/ /deng dus bstan pa'i nyi mar gyur la 'dud/ /so sor thar pa'i rtsa ba rab brtan zhing / /byang chub sems gnyis lo 'dab bye bas mdzes/ /gsang chen me tog 'bras bu g.yur za ba'i/ /sdom gsum dpag bsam ljon pa khyod la 'dud/ /thos bsam bsgom pas mngon rtogs yon tan brnyes/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas skal bzang gdul bya skyong / /'dzin skyong spel bas thub pa'i rgyal sa 'dzin/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad don gnyis grub la 'dud/ /yi dam lha dang bstan srung dbang po'i tshogs/ /gzhan yang lha mchog zhi khro rab 'byams kyi/ /mtshan dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i rgyan du gyur la 'dud/

/gangs can ma rung 'dul mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ /padmas byin rlabs gnas su khyod gshegs tshe/ /skal bzang 'ga' la u rgyan dngos su bstan/ /lha yi me tog sil mas mchod la 'dud/ /rgyal ba'i sras po dpal ldan a ti shā'i/ /thugs kyi snying po bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la/ /gsol ba btab pas jo bos zhal bstan nas/ /rdo rje gcod pa'i zab don nos la 'dud/ /bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa cher/ /dam can chos skyong las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /khyod ni sngon tshe rgyal sras thogs med ces/ /'phrin las mgon pos lung bstan brnyes la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo nag po che'i/ /phyi yi las mkhan rjes gnang stsal ba'i tshe/ /byin rlabs chu rgyun dngos su phab la 'dud/ /mdor na khyod kyis mkhyen rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /brtse bas 'jig rten dbang phyug zil gyis gnon/ /nus pas nyon mongs ye shes bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan yongs 'dzin dam par 'dud/ /mgon khyod yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur chen po/ /phyogs dus kun du khyer la mi ngal ba'i/ /rjes su slob pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu yis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di khyab par mdzad la 'dud/ /khyod kyi yon tan srad bu mtha' med cing / /rnam thar nor bu brjod pa'i bu ga bral/ /des na bdag 'dra'i phreng ba mkhan po yi/ /cha shas 'ga' yang rgyu bar nus min yang / /rang bzhin dag pa'i ston gyi nam mkha' la/ /ma bkod phreng du bsgrigs pa'i rgyu skar bzhin/ /bdag blo dngas ba'i yid kyi chu gtsang las/ /ma btab bstod tshig me tog phreng 'di 'bul/ /de ltar dam pa'i rnam thar brjod pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang des skye bo kun/ /kun mkhyen zas gtsang sras kyi rjes 'gro zhing / /zhing 'dir phan bde'i dpal 'byor rgyas par shog /bdag kyang gang gi drin las nyer thob pa'i/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul rgya mtsho yis/

/skal bzang 'gro la chos kyi char phab ste/ /brgyud 'dzin slob mas ljongs 'di khyab gyur cig /ces snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa dam pa sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' don grub ces mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa ngo mtshar me tog bde byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ yongs su 'dzin pa chen po de nyid las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin nos pa'i skal ba bzang po can shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chu mo phag gi lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o/ /'di'i yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba gso ba rig pa la mkhas par sbyangs pa bsam pa don grub kyis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //lo nas spyan lnga rin po che'i mdzad pa'i lam 'bras slob bshad rtsod spongs la bsngags pa brjod pa'i rab byed bzhugs/37 oṃ swasti/ phyi ltar gsum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/ /nang ltar gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dngos/ /gsang ba rang sems lhan skyes ye shes cher/ /dbyer med gdod ma'i mgon po gang de dang / /'gran gyi do med rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs mched/ /gcig chog rgyal po rgyal ba mus pa rnams/ /gnas lugs ro gcig ngang du gsol btab nas/ /bla ma'i gsung rab bsngags brjod phreng ba spel/ /gang gsung sngon med legs bshad dbyar skyes rnga/ /'di ni phyogs dang dus dang grub mtha' yis/ /ma bskal blo ldan gzur gnas su zhig gis/ /mthong kyang blo yi dbang po tshim par nges/ /snyan brgyud zab mo mthong ba'i skabs bral ba'i/ /sa skya par grags gzhan dang gzhan dag gis/ /legs bshad 'di 'dra mthong tshe lugs 'di la/ /phyis nas 'jug pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur snyam legs/

/zhes pa 'di yang dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /bla ma'i drin las sngags gzhung rgya mtsho la/ blo yi snang ba rgyas pa gang des sbyar/ /ces pa 'di yang rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched dang / rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung las skyes pa rnal 'byor pa gdod nas rang grol a nanda'i ming can gyis rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar nas/ /lo nas spyan snga rin po che'i drung du phul ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //mtshungs med nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa la bstod pa rin po che'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs/38 rgya gar skad du/ dharmā bhā ṣa paṇḍi ta dā na kirti swatt+ra ratna kaṇḍa bhu ṣa na maḥ bod skad du/ chos smra ba'i mkhas pa sbyin pa grags pa la bstod pa rin po che'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus nas/ /'gro rnams sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i legs bskyangs te/ /snyan pa'i grags pa kun gyi kha na rgyu/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs gsung dam chos 'dul ba'i sgor zhugs nas/ /sha chang la sogs dug can zas bzhin spangs/ /rgyal bas bcas pa mig 'bras ltar srung ba'i/ /btsun pa gnas brtan mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /theg chen rtsa ba sems bskyed legs nos nas/ /bdag bas gzhan gces byang sems rin chen gyi/ /kun la phan bde sgrub pa'i mdzad pa can/ /rgyal sras sems dpa' chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun lha dang sngags dang ye shes su/ /nye bar sdom pas thugs rgyud gtams gyur nas/ /snang srid dag pa lha yi 'khor lor shar/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /khyad par mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa yi/ /gsang mtha'i bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol nas/ /lha mchog bsgrub pas brag las chu nags dgon du bde mchog gsung bsnyen mdzad dus/

rgyun babs/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gsol ba 'debs/ /sa skya'i bla chen sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi dpe khang du gzim chung mdzad dus/ rje btsun sku mched kyis/ /'od gsal chen po'i ngang nas zhal bstan cing / /bdag nyid chen po sa skya chos 'chad mdzad pa'i phyag g.yon pa'i steng na mar na bza' lhug ge ba dang bcas pa'i/ paṇa chen zhal/ /yang yang gzigs pa khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na mkhyen brtse nus ldan yongs 'dzin rje/ /'brel tshad don ldan gang gi rnam thar cha/ /gang la bsam kyang yid rab 'phrog byed pa'i/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar bstod pas yongs 'dzin zhabs brtan zhing / /thub pa'i bstan dang 'gro la bde skyid tshogs/ /phan tshun 'dren pa bzhin du 'phel ba dang / de nyid rgyun mi chad par 'byung bar shog /bdag 'dra bya dang bya min lugs gnyis kyi/ /gnas gzhan phyogs su ma phyin bar mar ni/ /snyoms las srin bu'i kha chus rang gi lus/ /dam du bcings gang byams brtse'i thugs kyis skyong / /sngon byon gong ma'i mdzad bzang glang chen gyi/ /khur chen be'u'i phrag par lhung ba ltar/ /nyams chung bdag la dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /'khur 'dis rtag du lus sems ngal bar gyur/ /'on kyang dam pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus mthar phyin nas/ /sa skya pa yi chos srid rgyas gyur cig /ces mtshungs med nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa la bstod pa rin po che'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di yang / shrī sa skya pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad 'dun chen pos kun nas blangs te/ byi lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po bzhi thog bla brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //thub bstan lha chen gyi mkhan chen la bstod pa rab snyan lha'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/38'og /bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig yongs 'dzin dam pa dges pa'i thugs kyi sras/ /rim gnyis bsam gtan ting 'dzin nor gyis phyug /gzhung lugs mi 'dra bye ba'i rgya mtsho che/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdo sngags rig gnas thos bsam mtha' ru phyin/ /bsam gtan zas kyi rtogs pa'i lang tsho rgyas/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i rgya mtsho bshes gnyen che/ /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rnam dpyod blo gros 'od stong gis/ /thub bstan lha yi khang bzang ngo mtshar che/ /gsal bar mdzad pa'i yongs 'dzin kun gyi rgyan/ /bshes gnyen rgya mtsho'i mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i bshes/ /gang la gsol ba btab pas yongs 'dzin mchog /lo brgyar zhabs brtan de yi dge mtshan gyis/ /thub bstan lha yi khang chen mdzes gyur cig /de skad 'di yang sa skya pa/ /sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun bsod kyis/ /bris pas yid la re ba'i don/ /ji bzhin srung mas bsgrub gyur cig /ka lya na bardhantu/ shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza gattaṃ/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge zhing bkra shis// //rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/39 na mo gu ru badzra dha ra dā na kirti ye/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs kyi sras/ /btsun pa'i mchog gyur nges don mkhas pa'i phul/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug sbyin pa grags pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis mthar phyin stsol/ /zhes rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang skyes chen dam pa de nyid kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi myong ba'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa chos med sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi kha 'don du sug bris bgyis pa 'dis bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rgyur gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje dbang phyug rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'byung ba'i pho nya bzhugs so/40 na mo gu ru bha tra ye/ sa skya'i rje btsun snyan brgyud chu gter che/ /nyams rtogs dbang phyug rim gnyis ting 'dzin rgyun/ /rab tu brtan pa'i thugs mnga' bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes snyan brgyud gdams pa'i mnga' bdag chen po chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs myur du 'byung ba'i pho nya zhes bya ba 'di yang rje de nyid las sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa mang du thos pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi kha 'don du myur bar bris pa 'dis bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan la bstod pa lha rdzas me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba bzhugs/41 rgya gar skad du/ shrī tsakra shwa ra na ya ka wa ra dharmā swā mi mahā badzra dha ra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'dren mchog chos kyi rje rdo rje 'chang chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum dbang gnas lugs mtshan spel ba dang sbyar te bstod pa/ phyug khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gzhan ngor ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i tshul bzung nas/ /skal bzang 'gro la sku bzhi'i sa bon mchog /rab tu brtan par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid zhi'i so thar gyi bslab pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ phun tshogs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bu ram shing pa'i nges 'byung khrims kyi sgor/ /legs zhugs gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i rgyan/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhar byang sems kyi bslab pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ bcas skye dgu srid las bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rin chen byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /gzhan phan spyod pa nam yang mi ngal ba'i/

/sems dpa' chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun gsang sngags kyi bslab pa'i sgo nas bstod pa spel ba dang sbyar ba/ lha dang sngags dang ye shes kyis/ /rnam rol chen po'i ngang du dbang phyug nas/ /gang thugs dag pa'i 'khor lor rab brtan pas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal la gsol ba 'debs/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i rje tshar chen yab sras sogs la thos pa dang bsgom pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ yongs 'dzin du ma las/ /grangs med gsan pa rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhing / /rtse gcig bsgrub la brtson pa'i mdzad pa can/ /skyes chen dam pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /lhag par lha mchog lhag pa'i lha rnams kyi rjes su bzung ba'i skabs kyi rtags mtshan mngon du gyur gyi sgo nas bstod pa/ zhi khro rab 'byams kyi/ /grangs dang mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas/ /dbang dang rjes gnang bka' gtad gang stsal yang / /byin rlabs zil chen ldan par gsol ba 'debs/ /gangs can bstan nged rang sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud la chig brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa'i zab chos rnams kyi bdag por bzhugs pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /snyan brgyud zab las ches zab gdams pa rnams/ /yongs rdzogs 'dzin pa deng sang khyed gcig pu/ bsam bzhin bka' drin dran la gsol ba 'debs/ /mdor na khyod kyi rnam par thar pa mdor bsdus pa'i sgo nas bstod pa/ mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar che/ /gang la bsam kyang sngon byon gong ma yi/ /rnam par thar pa rnams dang dbyer med par/ /bdag gis shes nas dad pas gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma la/ lus ngag yid gsum yan lag bdun pa/ gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing / /las nyon dug gsum dang bral mchod pa 'bul/ /zag med sku gsum mnga' bas bzhes su gsol/ /rab nongs sgo gsum sdig rnams so sor bshags/ /rab dkar rigs gsum dge la rjes 'khor 'das bar ma'i bsags pa'i/

yi rang / /rab mchog theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /rab mang khams gsum mgon du rtag bzhugs gsol/ /rnam mang dge tshogs kunda brtsegs pa ltar/ /rnam dkar gang de'i bdud sde kun bcom ste/ /rnam grol thar pa'i rgyal srid der phyin nas/ /rnam mkhyen sku bzhi'i khri la dbang bsgyur shog /rdo rje 'chang dngos sku bzhi'i dbang phyug nyid/ /rdo rje lta bur bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing / /rdo rje theg pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo rnams/ /rdo rje'i slob mar mi nub rab brtan shog /sa skya'i sa skya'i gdung brgyud kho na las 'ongs pa'i zab chos rnams 'phel ba'i smon lam/ rje btsun rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud/ /sa skya'i gser chos zab mo'i rgyun 'di rnams/ /sa skya'i bstan 'dzin rnams la cher 'phel nas/ /sa skya pa yi bstan pa rgyas gyur cig /ces bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams kyi snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa'i srog shing chen po grub pa mchog gi ded dpon chos kyi rje dbang phyug rab brtan la bstod pa lha rdzas me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba 'di yang / yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid las sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo du ma'i bka' drin nos pa/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ glang lo zla ba dgu ba'i dmar cha'i tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du yud tsam zhig la sbyar ba'o/ /'di bgyis dge bas bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dharmā swā mi shrī wan saṅgu ru sarba dzñā waka gint+ra dharmā kirti dhwa dza shrī bha dra ye satwo tram̐ shrardha bhakti kri sa warṣa nyra be sha nā la shrī bhu mi paṇḍu paṇḍi te na kṛ te bi dza ha ra/

chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba dpal sa skya'i mkhas pas sbyar ba bzhugs/42 rgya gar skad du/ dharmā swā mi shrī wan saṅgu ru sarba dzñā waka gind+ra dharmā kirti dhwa dza shrī bha dra ye satwo tram̐ shrardhā bhakti kṛ pa warṣo nyra be sha na maḥ bod skad du/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ rje btsun mkhyen pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /utpal sngo ldan rigs kyi mtshan 'chang ba/ /gang sku 'dren byed dbang pos ste mig gi mngon brjod/ mthong tsam gyis/ yid ldan ste mi'i mngon brjod/ snying po'i ste sems kyi mngon brjod/ nag nog ste sdig pa'i mngon brjod/ sel mdzad pa'i/ /ljongs 'dis dbyig 'dzin ste sa gzhi'i mngon brjod/ mdzes pa'i rgyan der 'dud/ /gang gi rnam thar bu ram shing ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ pa ltar/ /ngo mtshar yon tan sa la 'gro ste rgya mtsho'i mngon brjod/ lta bu/ /mthong ba'i mod la skal bzang ma nu'i bu/ ste mi'i mngon brjod/ /bdag yid gcig min ste the tshom gyi mngon brjod/ dang bral dad pas 'dud/ /khyod kyi yid tshol ste mkhyen rab kyi mngon brjod/ zur phud lnga pa ste/ /dmigs med snying rje rdo rje nyi mar ste spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ mtshungs/ /nus pa zla ba'i thod can ste 'khor lo bde mchog gi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ la 'gran pa'i/ /kun gyi zhum byed ste ma dad pa'i mngon brjod/ 'joms pa'i dbang por 'dud/ /lha lam ste nam mkha'i mngon brjod/ 'od ldan mi ltung ste skar ma'i mngon brjod/

bgrangs yas kyang / /padmo'i bdag dang ste nyi ma'i mngon brjod/ grib ma'i lus ste zla ba'i mngon brjod/ lta bu/ /gzhan med de bzhin ri dwags 'phrog byed ltar/ ste seng ge'i mngon brjod/ /'gran bral snyigs ma'i mun pa 'joms der 'dud/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ ding sang yongs 'dzin gzhal med can ste lha spyi'i ming gi mngon brjod/ gyi tshogs/ /mtha' yas dbus na stobs 'jigs ste lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi ming gi mngon brjod/ ji bzhin du/ /grags khyod nyid brtan ste phyogs kyi mngon brjod/ kun las rnam rgyal bar/ /nyal slong ste shes rab kyi mngon brjod/ che ldan bdag gis shes nas 'dud/ /bdag blo skyes stobs sprin gyi so can las/ ri bo'i mngon brjod/ /legs 'ongs sbyangs pa'i blo gros sa'i gdub bu/ ste utpal gyi mngon brjod/ khyed gsung sgrogs ldan ste 'bab chu'i mngon brjod/ gyis bskyed legs bshad kyi/ /dri bsung rkang drug ste bung ba'i mngon brjod/ tshim pa stsol der 'dud/ /rnam dpyod rgya mtsho'i ske rags ste sa gzhi'i mngon brjod/ la 'gran pa'i/ /skal bzang slob bu'i 'dab chags ces pa bya'i ming ste 'dir ngang pa dang sbyar ro/ /grangs med rnams/ /ring na gnas kyang rab ste dad pa'i mngon brjod/ byed kyis bsdud pa'i/ /chos kyi rin chen 'byung gnas gang der 'dud/ /ye shes lnga ldan kha dog shākya dang / dkar po/ /kṛṣṇa nag po/ dang ni go bo ra ser ba/ yi mdog /ha ri ljang khu/ ro hi dmar po/ ta yi mdangs 'dzin pa/ /bhi shwa bo dha rigs lnga'i gtso der 'dud/ thams cad rtogs te sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ /gnas skabs dbyig ldan ste brgya byin gyi mngon brjod/ /bde la'ang ma chags shing /

/gcig tu dpal sdug ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ bsgrub la gzhol ba can/ /gdul bya drangs phyir mngon shes drug ldan ste sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ nyid/ /shes bu'i ste mi'i ming gi mngon brjod/ zol gyi bstan pa spel der 'dud /sngon sbyangs blo yi gtsug phud can gsal ba/ te me lce'i mngon brjod/ /las 'ongs rnam dpyod ste du ba'i mngon brjod/ me yi rgyal mtshan can/ /kun gyi bskyed byed ste pha'i ming gi mngon brjod/ dang ni mngal 'dzin ma/ ste ma'i ming gi mngon brjod/ lta bur gyur pa'i nyi ma'i gnyen ste shākya thub pa'i mtshan kyi mngon brjod/ der 'dud/ /de ltar gu ru bla ma rdo rje 'chang / badzra dha ra yi/ /yon tan su shin tu rnam dag bi mukta bkod pa'i gtam/ /ngo mtshar a bhi dhā na a ba li/ mngon brjod phreng ba/ 'dir sbyar dge bas sidhārtha: don grub ste shākya thub pa'i mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ 'grub shog /ces chos kyi rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la bstod pa dad gus thugs rje'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di yang yongs su 'dzin pa chen po de nyid las chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bka' drin nos pa dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ me mo yos kyi lo sa ga zla ba'i lo dārdza phulla si ta dharmā ko ṇa ta mahā gu ṇa ratna ka ra: yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i/ shrī wan bhu mi'i gnas mchog bzhi thog bla brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa maṅgala'i bkra shis/ ming can gyis bgyis so/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas chos srid kyi karma 'phrin las rgyas par gyur cig

bistā ra bha wa tu/ shu bham̐ ka lyā ṇa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig wardhantu/ su khashtsa phan bder gyur cig hi tā stu/ 'dir smras pa/ /mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba dang / /tshig gter mu tig phreng ba sogs/ /ngo mtshar mngon brjod glegs bam la/ /bag chags sad pa gang des sbyar/ /sgra rig rgya mtsho ma 'thung yang / /sgra yi sbyor tshul phra mo rnams/ /mthong bas shes de'i yang srid mngon/ /sgra bsgyur lo tsā ma yin nam/ /zhes nyams ldan gyi tshig smras pa la sa de lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rje/ wa dza saṅgu ru dharmā swā mi khyed kyis bzod par mdzad nas/ sngon chad kyang thugs rje chen pos a dhiṣtha byin gyis rlabs kyi/ nā/ /da dung byang chub bar du a dhiṣṭha te swāhā/ smras pa/ dpyod ldan mkhas pas sbyar ba'i bstan bcos gang / /ming rnams mngon brjod gyis spras bying che zhing / /tshig dag snyan ngag gis brgyan rna bar snyan/ /don rnams brjod bya dang 'brel rtogs sla zhing / /gcod mtshams sdebs sbyor dang mthun brjod bde ba/ /de 'dra 'byung zhes sngon gyi mkhas rnams la/ /yongs su grags mod ding sang phyogs 'dir ni/ /blo mig gsal ba ljongs 'dir re re tsam/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //chos kyi rje mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa la gsol 'debs dad pa'i me tog ces bya ba bzhugs/43 shrī wan gu ru mahā badzra dha ra ye na maḥ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /rjes su bzung du gsol/ /mdo rgyud man ngag thun mong rigs gnas sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub bye ba'i shing rta'i srol/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags zhabs/ /bskal brgyar brtan par gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang mkhan chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po las/ rnal 'byor bla med gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang lung man ngag rgyud kyi bshad pa sogs zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin nos pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du yud tsam zhig la sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig

/sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //bdag bstod bskul byed dga' bskyed nyid/ /rgyas par phye ba'i yi ge bzhugs/44 /oṃ swasti siddham̐/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs rigs kyi thig le las 'khrungs shing / /skyes stobs blo gros rab gsal dang ldan pas/ /shes bya'i gnas kun gzigs pa tsam gyis dgongs/ /blo ldan skye bo'i gtsug rgyan khyod la 'dud/ /gang sku mdzes shing brjid chags mthong na dga'/ /gang gsung chos sgra sgrog la mtshungs pa med/ /gang thugs bde stong kho nas dus kun 'da'/ /gang gi 'gran zla dang bral khyod la 'dud/ /gzhung brgya 'chad pa'i lce bde blo gsal zhing / /lung rigs 'gal 'brel rtsod pa'i 'dren byed kyang / /sdebs legs rtsom pa'i ro 'dzin bsgyur mkhas pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i nyi ma khyod la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos bla mas rjes bzung zhing / /rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len zab mo yis/ /rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor chos kun gzigs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan khyod la 'dud/ /gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor zla med pas/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'di yongs su khyab mdzad pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gyur khyed la 'dud/ /de ltar gus pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas/ /yongs 'dzin 'brel tshad don ldan khyod zhabs pad/ /bskal brgyar brtan zhing bdag sogs gdul bya rnams/ /dges pa'i thugs kyis rtag tu skyong bar shog /skye ba kun du mgon po khyod drung du/ /skyes nas gsung gi bdud rtsi legs 'thung ste/ /skye ngan 'khor ba'i btson ra kun spangs nas/ /skyes mchog khyed dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang / /ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /rang gi rang bzhin brjod pa dang /

'byung rung yon tan 'ga' zhig la/ /smon pa'i tshul gyis smras pa'o/ /'di ltar bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis/ dad ldan slob ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /kun mkhyen ye shes 'jug gyur cig bdag gi dus gsum dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /skyes nas bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang / /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin par shog /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyang / /bdag gi rjes bzung thar pa'i bde thob shog /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam 'di/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /log par 'dren pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal nas/ /ji bzhin ma lus legs par 'grub gyur cig /ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs don gnyis mthar phyin zhes bya ba bzhugs/45 rgya gar skad du/ shrī bhu mi paṇḍu mant+ra dha ra wa gint+ra nanda puṇya kirti dhwa dza shrī bha dra ye na ma: bod skad du/ dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag dbang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ lha yi rjes bzung shing 'gro ba/ kun dga' ba'i/ dpal la 'god par nus pa'i/ /bsod nams kyi/ gter chen po dang ldan pas sa gsum snyan pas/ grags pa'i rgyal khyab pa'i/ mtshan 'dzin/ zhing / /dpal 'byor lung rtogs kyi yon tan du mas/ bzang po mtha' dag gi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i/ bstan pa'i srog shing chen po/ khyed/ nyid/ bskal 'gro ba sems can gyi don du/ brgyar zhabs pad/ brtan nas/ chos dang / srid kyi dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ rgyas nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba bzhin che cher gsal bar/

gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang cho rigs btsun pa'i rigs su 'khrungs shing / mdo sngags kyi zab don la thugs kyi snang ba rgyas pas/ rje btsun sa skya pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi rje ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis 'di lta bu'i brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad ming dang spel ba'i khyer bde nyung ngu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i zhal ngo ma gcog par/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bris pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi kha skongs yar ngo'i zla dbang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/46 /bkra shis par gyur cig bskul ba po'i don du 'dir cung zad smras pa/ 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma'i/ bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog gyur khyed la 'dud/ /ces pa'i rjes su/ dpal ldan 'phags pa mya ngan 'das rjes su/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i lugs gnyis phun tshogs rnams/ /dpal ldan khyed dang mtshungs pa gzhan ma mchis/ /dpal ldan sprul pa'i skyes chen khyed la 'dud/ /sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen khyod kyi/ rigs dang chos las 'khrungs pa'i bu slob tshogs/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /thub bstan srid mthar gsal mdzad khyed la 'dud/ /ces sbyar/ de ltar gus pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas/ zhes sogs man sngar bzhin bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di'ang rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i rab 'byams smra ba dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod nams kyi ming can gyis nan chen pos bskul ba la brten/ byi ba la glang chen dang / phyug po la rnam thos dang / rgyal phran la brgya byin dang / /bshes gnyen phal pa la yang sangs rgyas dang mtshungs par bsngags pa brjod pa la snyan ngag gi bstod pa'i skabs 'dir 'gal ba med par/ chos rje sa skya paṇa chen gyis gsungs pa bzhin/ sngar gyi rtsom pa po rang nyid kyi ci brtol bskyed de smras pa 'di'i 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig

/kalyā na wardhantu// ༈ //brtan bzhugs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/47 na mo gu ru badzra ā tsarya/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la phyag 'tshal lo/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag /sa skya'i bla chen yab sras khu dbon sogs/ /bstan 'dzin brgyud par bcas la gsol 'debs kyi/ /bsam don 'di dag 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ mdo rgyud man ngag thun mong rigs gnas sogs/ /shes bya ma lus gzigs pa'i thams cad mkhyen/ /bstan pa'i srog shing sngags 'chang kun dga'i mtshan/ /sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe mthar phyin shog /gang gi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gdung gi sras/ /myur du 'byon zhing de rgyun bskal pa'i bar/ /rgyun mi chad sogs bzhed don ma lus pa/ /bka' srung rnams kyis thogs med sgrub gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob cing / zab mo'i lam la gcig tu gzhol ba'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa bshes gnyen dam pa bkra shis chos 'phel gyis lhag bsam dag pas bskul ba'i ngor/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta mkhas pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis dpal sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i shar lho rig 'dzin pho brang du yud tsam zhig la bris pa 'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /dharme u da ya mastu// ༈ //grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/48 /rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru siddha shwa ra ya na ma: bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa grub pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi grub pa'i snyan grags 'dzam gling gis/ /skye dgu kun gyis gtsug na legs mchod pa'i/ /thang stong rgyal por grags pa'i grub dbang rje/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag lus zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas/

/sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas rtag tu mchod/ /sdig pa kun bshags kun kyang byang gyur cig /'khor 'das dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams 'phrul bgrang yas rnams/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bsod nams 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / bsam don kun 'grub phyi ma lhan cig par/ /bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yos lo lho mtshams kyi phag ri rdzong gi bya 'dabs bsam 'grub lha khang na bzhugs pa'i grub thob chen po'i byin rlabs rten ngor mtshar can rnams kyi drung du slebs skabs dad pa chen po rab tu g.yos te sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che'i tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/49 /rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru dharmā swā mi siddhi shwa ra mahā gu ru ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ka ba bzhin du gzhan don khur chen po/ /kha ba can 'dir yig drug 'phrin las rgyun/ /ga bur dri bzhin phyogs kun khyab mdzad pa'i/ /nga yis skyabs mgon thang stong rgyal por 'dud/ /ca re spyi bor sgom zhing gsol btab na/ /cha shas phra mo'i bar chad kun kyang sel/ /ja sogs 'dod yon sred pas ma bcings pa'i/

/nya gang zla 'dra'i yon tan rgyas der 'dud/ /ta la'i ljon pa rgyas 'dra'i dbu skyes dang / /tha mal rnam rtog grol ba'i sku'i snang brnyan/ /da lta mthong ba tsam gyis dngos 'dzin bzlog /na rgas skye 'chi spangs pa khyed la 'dud/ /pa tra ris ltar ngor mtshar grub rtags kyis/ /pha mtha' yas pa'i 'dzam gling kun bkang nas/ /ba glang lta bu'ang blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /ma lus 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen der 'dud/ /tsa ra la sogs phyi yi 'gal rkyen dang / /tsha grangs 'dus pa'i nang gi gegs las grol/ /dza re khrag 'dzag sha zan srin po yang / /wa skyes lta bur zhum mdzad gang der 'dud/ /zha long lta bu'i blang dor ma rmongs shing / /za btung kho na don gnyer mtha' mi la'ang / /'a 'ur chos kyi bag chags 'jog mdzad pa'i/ /ya rab kun gyi bsngags pa'i yul der 'dud/ /ra hu la 'dra'i gzugs med stobs ldan rnams/ /la chu 'phrang gsum kun tu dam la btags/ /sha khrag dga' ba'i 'byung po grangs med btul/ /sa gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog der 'dud/ /ha re sdang mig gzigs pa'i lta stangs kyis/ /a yig chos kyi don las ma g.yos bzhin/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pas gang khyab pa/ /khyod kyi 'phrin las 'jug pa mnga' der 'dud/ /sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal zhing / /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas rtag tu mchod/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig kun bshags/ /skye 'phags dge ba kun la rjes yi rang / /gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor du gsol/ /kun kyang mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /shes rgyud sgrib gnyis ma lus byang gyur nas/ /dus 'dir tshe mthar phyin zhing dbang po gsal/ /bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud mang du 'phel ba sogs/ /yid la re ba'i don kun lhun grub ste/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bstan pa rin chen 'di/ /rab tu 'phel zhing yun du gnas pa dang /

/bdag dang bdag la yid gtad slob bu rnams/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /phan tshun ngo shes lus ngag spyod pa kun/ /dam chos sgrub dang sa lam bsgrod pa yis/ /grogs su gyur nas yun ring ma thogs par/ /rnam grol thob ste slar yang gang 'dul gyi/ /sprul pas 'gro kun 'dren pa'i rgyur bsngo'o/ /zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan mchog gi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che'i tog ces bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sa mo yos kyi lo gtsang 'brug dus gzing gi sems can mang po sdug bsngal gyis nyams thag pa'i tshe/ lhag bsam dag pa'i sgo nas phan tshun legs spel gyi slad du/ lho bod mtshams kyi phag ri rnam rgyal rdzong gi bya 'dabs sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen bsam 'grub lha khang du slebs pa'i skabs/ grub thob chen po'i byin rlabs rten ngo mtshar can rnams mjal ba'i mod la/ dad pa lhag par 'phel ba'i rkyen byas te/ gong gi byin rlabs rten rnams la bskor ba khri ra can gcig bgyid pa dang bstun dbo zla ba'i dmar cha'i tshes la legs par sbyar bi yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i shab stod pa bkra shis don 'grub bo/ /'dis kyang bdag cag dpon slob kyis 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs kyi yi ge yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs/50 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa sangs rgyas la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog

/ces pa 'di dga' ldan nas byon pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che'i gtsos pa'i rgya bod kyi ston pa'i sku byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od gzhan las rmad du byung ba chos rje sa paṇa gyi dbu'i gtsug phud phul ba'i thub dbang rdo rje gdan chung ma sogs ngo mtshar can rnams la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po la/ /mchod sprin rgyal mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di rgyal ba byams mgon gyi sku rdzi gyim las rang byon du byon pa'i gang gsol ba btab pa yid bzhin du stsol bar nges pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar can don la gnas pa der gsol ba btab pa'o/ /rtsod pa kun las rgyal ba'i 'jam dpal la/ mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di sa skya paṇa chen dang 'phrog byed dga' bo gnyis rtsod pa mdzad dus rtsod rgyab dang dpang mdzad par grags pa'i 'jam dbyangs rtsod rgyal ma zhes mtshan don dang ldan pa der yid ches mos gus kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab pa'o/ /dgos 'dod kun 'byung padma 'byung gnas la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi sku 'dra byin rlabs rang dang mnyam pa'i sku tshab gnyer lnga'i nang tshan bye ma a krong las grub pa gsol ba btab na ring bsrel rgyun mi chad par 'byon bzhin pa de nyid la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /sa skya'i bla chen dpal ldan rtse mo la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog

/ces pa 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen phul chung pas bzhengs pa'i sa 'jam zhal sprod kyi sku la brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs du mas bskor ba'i bris sku sa skya pa chen po'i phyag nas ma rje btsun sku mched kyi thugs dam gyi rten 'khrul med de nyid la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos grags pa rgyal mtshan la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni grags pa'i mtha' can gyis bzhengs pa'i rje btsun rin po che'i sku rtsod bral rnams la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs /bdag sog dus 'dir bsam don 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni rje btsun sa paṇa gyi sku chos rje pa nyid kyi phyag nas ma 'khrul med gsum la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rgyal 'phags pa'i hor sku dngul las grub pa 'phags pa nyid kyi phyag nas ma 'khrul med dang / bris sku gos thang hor dus kyi chos kyi rgyal po rang nyid kyi phyag nas ma de nyid la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /'gro mgon chos rje theg chen chos rgyal la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi sku yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi bzhengs pa 'gro mgon chos rje rang gi phyag nas ma rtsod bral dang / theg chen rin po che'i sku theg chen chos rje rang gi phyag nas ma spyan zur na ring bsrel gsar du byon pa'i byin rlabs yid ches can gnyis la gsol ba btab pa'o/

/thams cad mkhyen pa legs pa'i 'byung gnas la/ mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sku 'dra rje de nyid kyi phyag nas mar gyur pa zung la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /sa skya lo tsā yongs 'dzin e waṃ par/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / /ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sku 'dra rje yab sras de gnyis kyi phyag nas mar gsol ba btab pa'o/ /rtsod bral sngags 'chang yab sras rnam gsum la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen yab sras mtshungs med gsum gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma byin rlabs yid ches can rnams la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mus pa chen po la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni rtsod dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po kho bo cag gi tshe rab du ma'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen du gyur pa'i rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku 'dra rje de nyid kyi phyag nas ma byin rlabs gzhan las ches rmad du byung ba rnams dang / rje btsun 'brel tshad don ldan de nyid kyi sku gdung rin po che dgos 'dod ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pa de nyid la gsol ba btab pa'o/

/yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs la/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni chos rgyal 'phags pa'i thugs dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sku khyad 'phags dang / ba ri lo tsā ba'i thugs dam ma 'khrul med seng gdong ma'i sku/ sa lo tsā ba'i thugs dam dmar po bskor gsum byin rlabs yid ches kyi rtags can dang / 'khor lo bde mchog kyai rdo rje sogs kyi sku glo bo ma 'khrul med khyad par can rnams dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa/ bla ma dam pa/ rje kun dga' grol mchog sa lo/ sngags 'chang yab sras/ mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa sogs bla ma gong ma rtsod bral du ma'i thugs dam rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi bris sku du ma dang / lhag par rdo rje phur bu lcags las grub pa'i gter ma 'khrul med byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba grangs kyang bcu phrag du ma dang / yang theg chen rin po che'i thugs dam ma rgya bzo ngo mtshar can gyi phur cha dang / gzhan yang rgya gar 'phags yul nas byon pa'i li sku ngo mtshar can grangs kyang bcu phrag du ma dang / rgya nag ma khyad par can bcu phrag gsum lhag pa/ gzhan yang ye shes sems dpa' zhugs nges pa'i bla ma brgyud pa dang / de ma yin pa'i bris 'bur gyi sku bgrangs ba las 'das shing / ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba rnams la gsol ba btab pa'o/ /mahā kā la tsa turmu khar bcas/ mchod sprin rgyal mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di ni shing mgon/ rdo mgon/ bris mgon/ bse 'bag nag po 'phur shes te nged rang sa skya pa la bka' babs pa'i chos skyong gi sku yid bzhin nor bu lta bu rnams dang / gnyan lo tsā ba'i thugs dam 'khrul med zhal bzhi pa'i sku rang byon du yod pa'i rten rdo ngo mtshar can dang /

yang bram gzugs kyi sku bris pa las gsal ba'i rang byon yod pa'i rten rdo sogs chos skyong che chung gi bris 'bur gyi sku rmad du byung ba du ma dang / rten rdzas ngo mtshar can chos skyong 'khor nges pa rnams la yid ches khyad par can brnyed pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pa'o/ /de ltar skal bzang kun dga'i ming can la/ /'khrul zad rje btsun rnams kyi lung bstan zhing / /chos srid dpal 'byor rgya mtsho'i bka' babs pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i bsod nams zhing rnams la/ /gsol 'debs bsam 'phel nor bu'i phreng ba 'di/ /skal ba bzang po can des sbyar ba yin/ /bsod nams 'di yi bdag dang gdul bya yi/ /'di phyi'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rten mchod khyad par can de dag gi drung du yid dag pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pa thams cad 'bad med du 'grub nges pa'i nges shes yang dag pa thob ste/ rang gzhan la phan bde rgya chen po 'byung phyir bris pa 'dis bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bar gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa sarga bzhi pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/51 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa sarga bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /dbu ma chen po 'gro la gsal mdzad pa/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan klu sgrub snying po zhes/ /snyan grags 'jig rten gsum na gsal der 'dud/ /des gsungs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbu ma'i don/

/snod ldan mkhas pa'i skye bo du ma la/ /rgya cher spel mdzad arya de wi'i zhabs/ /rjes 'brangs sangs rgyas bskyangs/ legs ldan 'byed/ zla ba grags pa/ zhi ba lha/ dpal sbas pa/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes grags pa/ zhi 'tsho/ ka ma la shī la/ 'phags seng gnyis/ lwa wa pa sogs so/ /bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar klu sgrub dbang po yab sras sogs/ /gus pas bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir dbu ma'i gzhung lugs kun rig cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab du byed pa sarga bzhi pa zhes bya ba las/ dpal ldan 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras la bstod pa'i rim pa ste dang po'o/ /zab yangs chos mdzod mngon pa'i sde snod dang / /sbas don mngon rtogs 'gro la gsal mdzad pa/ /sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med kyi/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis phye ba'i gnas brgyad mngon rtogs rim/ /blo bzang snod dang ldan pa'i gdul bya la/ /mchog tu spel mdzad kun mkhyen dbyig gnyen zhabs/ /rjes 'brangs blo brtan/ rgyal sras/ don gsang / mkhan po/ chos skyong / ngo bo nyid med pa/ gser gling pa/ shanti pa sogs so/ /bcas la bdag yid dwangs bas 'dud/ /de ltar 'phags pa thogs med sku mched sogs/ /bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i legs byas mthus/ /tshe 'dir chos mngon byams chos kun rig cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa sarga bzhi pa zhes bya ba las rje btsun thogs med sku mched la bstod pa'i rim pa ste gnyis pa'o/ /chos kun gtan la 'bebs byed tshad ma'i gzhung / /gtan tshigs rig pa 'gro la gsal mdzad pa/ /'phags pas rje bzung phyogs kyi glang po zhes/

/rnam dag rig pa'i dbang phyug che de rgyal/ /de yi lam srol tshad ma rigs pa'i gzhung / /rnam dpyod gsal ldan skyes bu bgrangs yas la/ /yongs su spel mdzad chos kyi grags pa'i zhabs/ /rjes lha shaka rgya nag mkhan po/ chos mchog shaṃ karnanta/ a tsa ḍa/ nyi sbas/ ya ma ri/ rgyal ba can sogs so/ /'brangs bcas la rtag par phyag bgyi'o/ /de ltar phyogs glang chos grags yab sras sogs/ /dad pa'i dbang gis gsol ba 'di btab pas/ /tshe 'dir tshad ma'i gzhung lugs kun rig cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa sarga bzhi pa zhes bya ba las rigs pa'i dbang phyug phyogs glang yab sras la bstod pa'i rim pa ste gsum pa'o/ /bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba mchog /so so thar pa 'gro la gsal mdzad pa/ /'dul 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan yon tan 'od/ /ces grags 'gro ba'i gnyen de phyag byar 'os/ /gang gi lam srol 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i gzhung / /skal bzang mtshungs par spyod pa'i 'gro ba la/ /rab tu spel mdzad shākya 'od kyi zhabs/ /rjes 'brangs chos shes/ dul lha/ dge legs bshes gnyen/ tshul khrims bskyangs/ sa ga'i lha/ dzi na mi tra/ dā na shī la sogs so/ /bcas la bka' drin dran pas dad/ de ltar yon tan 'od dang shākya 'od/ /brgyud 'dzin bcas pa bstod pa'i bsod nams mthus/ /tshe 'dir 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs kun rig cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi skyes chen dam pa rgyan drug mchog gnyis la bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab tu byed pa sarga bzhi pa zhes bya ba las slob dpon 'od kyi zhabs can zung la bstod pa'i rim pa ste bzhi'o/ /'dir smras pa/ de ltar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul byon pa'i/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis la/

/bstod pa'i rab byed sarga bzhi pa zhes/ /gzhung lugs mang po'i byung tshul rtogs brjod 'di/ /sa skyar gnas pa'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /skyes sbyangs blo mig gsal ba de yis sbyar/ /deng sang phar tshad 'dul mdzod dbu ma'i gzhung / /thos bsam mdzad pa'i blo gsal tshogs rnams dang / /sngon byon gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa'i/ /skyes mchog rnams la bdag cag snying nas dad/ /kho bo skyes stobs blo gros mthu che bas/ /shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung ngu yi/ /rtogs par snang yang le lo'i dbang gyur te/ gzhung lugs mtha' dag sbyongs 'dod yul du lus/ /chen por skyes pa'i skal dman bdag 'dra la/ /'di phyi bar do'i gnas skabs thams cad du/ /skyabs gnas bslu med thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog rnams las/ /gzhan pa'i skyabs mgon bdag la ma mchis pas/ /kha zhe med par snying nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /ye shes spyan gyi 'bral med skyob du gsol/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bstan pa rgyas/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /yid la re ba'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig ces pa'i yi ge pa ni shab stod skyes pa'i tshe dbang dpal bzang gis bgyis so/ /'di'i 'phral dang yun du bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/52 na mo gu ru dharmā swā mi badzra dha ra ā nanda bha dra ye/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab yangs mdo rgyud chu gter las 'ong pa'i/ /gsang chen yid bzhin nor bu'i rin chen phreng /

/'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod nas/ /'gro ba'i gdung sel chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /ka ba bzhin du bstan pa'i khur 'degs shing / /kha bshad min par rtogs pa'i yon tan ster/ /gang yang bstan pa'i bya bas dus 'da' yang / /nga rgyal dregs pas ma gos gang der 'dud/ /ca co mi snyan gleng gzhi sha chang sogs/ /cha shas tsam gyi'ang gos par ma gyur cing / /ja sogs ting 'dzin 'phel ba'i zas bsten nas/ /nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas der 'dud/ /tab tob blo yi log rtog gzhan gzhung gi /the tshom lung dang rig pas sun phyung nas/ /da gzod yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i srol chen po/ /nam yang nyams med spel bar mdzad der 'dud/ /pa ṭa ri ltar mkhyen pa'i blo gros kyi/ /pha bzang bu ltar shes ldan slob ma skyong / /ba glang lta bu'ang chos kyis khrid mkhas pa'i/ /ma lus 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs der 'dud/ /tsa ra hor khrims la sogs ngan spyod kyi/ /tsha grang spyod pas gzhan gnod kun spangs te/ /dzar ba'i gos sogs chog shes blo ldan zhing / /wa yi sha ltar chos sred dges der 'dud/ /zhwa ltar mkhas grub bla mas gtsug na mdzes/ /zas nor la sogs bsnyen bkur chags pa spangs/ /'a 'ur dam chos 'brug sgra stong sgrogs pa'i/ /ya rab kun gyis bsngags 'os gang der 'dud/ /rang rgyud grol nas rtsod bral dri med kyi/ /lam bzang mchog la 'gro kun 'god pa'i phyir/ /sha sogs rang gi lus srog gtong phod pa'i/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan mchog der 'dud/ /ha la lta bu'i mi mthun phyogs bcom nas/ /a la la yi mdzad 'phrin ngo mtshar can/ /gang la bsam kyang yid 'phrog rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' bzang por grags der snying nas 'dud/ /gang gi thugs sras mus chen sems dpa' che/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs rim byon pa'i/ /e waṃ chos kyi mtho ba'i seng ge'i khrir/ /zhabs 'khod bstan 'dzin kun la dwangs bas 'dud/

/de ltar ston mchog zas gtsang sras po yi/ /lung bstan bdud rtsi brnyes pa bzang po'i zhabs/ /brgyud par bcas la gsol ba btab pa yis/ /dge 'di'i bsam don 'di dag 'grub gyur cig /bstan dang 'gro la phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bstan pa rin chen khur gyi mi ngal zhing / rlabs chen spyod pas don gnyis lhun grub ste/ /yid kyi re ba ma lus mthar phyin shog /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /bstan pa mchog tu 'phel ba'i mthu ldan zhing / /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /rtsa brgyud bla ma mkhyen brtse nus par ldan/ /bdag cag mi phyed dad pas stobs ldan zhing / /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa dad pa'i snye ma zhes bya ba 'di yang khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po rigs ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbang po'i mtshan can sku mched dang / mus chen 'khor lo sdom pa buddha'i mtshan can gyi gsung las skyes pa'i shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rab 'byams smra ba rgya mtsho'i mtha' can dang / shab stod pa bkra shis kyi ming can gyis bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams 'phral dang yun du bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal dang ldan par gyur cig /mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge la bstod pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs/53 na mo gu ru puṇya singha ya/ kun mkhyen pa'i dbang po bsod nams seng ge la bstod pa dad pa rgya mtsho'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba/

rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis mthar phyin pa'i/ /bcom ldan shākya seng ge'i bstan pa nyid/ /'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i phrin las can/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /sa mo bya la mdo khams phyogs su bltams/ /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i mgon gyis bzung / /shes bya'i gnas kun 'bad pa chung ngu'i mkhyen /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad 'dren pa bzang po dang / /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ /rjes bzung yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i bdag por gyur/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bod yul bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung skyong mdzad mkhas grub mang byon yang / /thun mong min pa'i dgongs pa 'grel mkhas pa'i/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bstan pa'i bya ba rnam gsum mthar phyin nas/ /mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la rab brtson zhing / /bslab gsum ldan pa'i chos grwa spel mdzad pa'i/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mdo rgyud gzhung don 'chad la nga mkhas zhes/ /cher rlom mang yang kun gyi 'gran bral ba'i/ /bsod nams gter chen smra ba'i seng ge mchog /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /gzugs sku bsdu tshe brtse chen bla ma bzhin/ /skal ldan 'ga' la sku yi bkod pa'i tshogs/ /du ma bstan nas bde ba can du gshegs/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de ltar rnam pa kun mkhyen chos kya ི rjer/ /rab dang gus pa'i yid kyi gsol btab pas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun dgongs don zab mo la/ /khyed ltar 'jigs med smra ba'i seng ger shog /dus ngan skye bo'i spyod pa'i yid dub bdag /bde gshegs bstan pa'i khur chen khyer ba la/ /dam can mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi nyer bskyangs te/ /sngar bzhin yid la re ba kun 'grub shog

/mdor na bdag dang gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bstan pa rgyas/ /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /zhing mchog bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa rgyal mtsho'i rlabs phreng zhes bya ba 'di ni dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi kun mkhyen chen po'i gsung rab rnams mthong ba'i rkyen byas mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po thob pa dang / lhag par kun mkhyen rin po che'i 'phel gdung bya btang rje'i gdung skal gling dga' na bzhugs pa la ring bsrel 'phel bzhin pa/ bar skabs su rkyen 'ga' zhig 'grib pa la nged rang gi gsol ba btab pas ring bsrel bcu gcig tsam 'phel ba dang / /yang dus phyis thub bstan gong 'og sogs kun mkhyen chen po'i rjes 'jug rnams dang bstan pa la phan sleb che bar byung bar brten/ kho bo cag kun mkhyen chen po de nyid kyi rjes su bzung ba'i gang zag tu smon pa'i blos dad pa rtse gcig pa'i yid kyis dpal sa skyar sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //rje btsun mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/54 shrī wan gu ru ratna sa mu tra ya na maḥ rje btsun sems dpa' chen po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog dges pa'i thugs ldan bshes gnyen che/ /'phrin las rgya mtshos 'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes khams gsum gyi bla ma spyan snga rin po che'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs mus chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos mdzad pa'i lam 'bras bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skongs su rje btsun mus pa chen po'i gsung las skyes pa'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas dpal sa skya'i lha khang chen mo'i shar lho rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis bkra shis dang bde legs dpal 'bar bar gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i gsol 'debs don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/55 na mo gu ru/ ngo mtshar rnam thar mdzad pa'i tshul/ /gang la bsam kyang yid 'phrog pa'i/ /thogs med bzang po dpal ba la/ /sdig bshags gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po'i rnam thar dang gsung 'bum yang yang bltas pa'i rkyen byas shin tu dad cing gus pas yid kyis sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rje dkon mchog rgya mtsho la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/56 na mo gu ru ratna sa mu tra ya/ bla ma dang rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgya mtsho dang / /sangs rgyas gsung rab rin chen gyis/ /'phrin las rgya mtsho kun gyi bdag /dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /ces pa 'di yang sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /rang nyid gsol ba 'debs phyir dpal sa skya'i/ /dpe khang gsar pa chos mdzod chen mor sbyar/ /mastu sarba dza ga taṃ// ༈ //skyid grong jo bo rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs bcad don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/57 na mo gu ru lo ki shwa ra ya/ rang byon jo bo wa ti bzang po la/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas rtag mchod cing / /sdig pa kun bshags kun kyang byang gyur nas/ /bdag cag dpon slob lo brgya 'tsho bar shog /mkhyen brtse nus ldan jo bo'i thugs rje yi/ /bdag cag rnams kyi tshe thung gyur pa yi/ /sngon gyi las dang 'phral rkyen kun zhi nas/ /rtag tu gzugs bzang lo brgya 'tsho bar shog /jo bo mchod sogs dus gsum bsod nams mthus/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas/

/bdag cag dpon slob tshe mthar phyin par shog /mdor na bsam pa'i don kun legs 'grub par/ /gsol ba 'debs so jo bo rin po che/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'gro kun rjes su bzung / /gsol ba 'debs so don gnyis lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gzhan gyi re smon 'grub pa'i phyir skyid grong gi 'phags pa rang byon wa ti bzang po la mchod pa'i bye brag 'ga' zhig 'bul ba'i pho nya mngags pa'i tshe gsol 'debs sbyar ba 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs kha skongs dang bcas pa bzhugs/58 skyabs mchog thub dbang sgrol dkar ngag dbang grags/ /chos kyi grags pa dpal ldan a ti sha /rgyal sras 'brom ston spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ /sprul sku gzhon 'od rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgam po pa dang bsgom tshul ston pa'i zhabs/ /shes rab byang chub dpal ldan 'dul 'dzin pa/ /'bri khung gling pa dam chos gling pa'i mtshan/ /bla ma chos tshul rnams laྎ mnyam med lha lung grub chen yon gnas pa/ /chos kyi dbang phyug byang chub bzang po'i zhabs/ /bkra shis rnam rgyal bsod nams lha dbang rje/ /bsod nams legs mchog rnams laྎ mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇa chen ngag dbang grags/ /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog chos kyi rje/ /rgyal ba'i sras po spyan snga rin po che/ /ngag dbang chos grags zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /yi dam lha tshogs chos srung nor lha la/ /bdag gzhan mched grogs snying nas gsol 'debs kyi/ /mchog dang thun mong tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /bsod nams dpal 'byor ye shes rgyal par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'o/ /swasti siddham̐/ gong gi brgyud 'debs kyi spyan snga rin po che'i rjes su 'di ltar sbyar te/ dpal ldan chos kyi 'byor pa'i yongs 'dzin rje/

/mkhas btsun bzang po'i mnga' bdag kun dga'i mtshan/ /mgon des rjes bzung rigs 'dzin wa gint+ra/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /gong gi smon lam tshigs bcad gcig gi rjes su yang 'di ltar sbyar bar bya ste/ lhag par las dang tshe dang bsod nams tshogs/ /dpal ldan tshe sbyin lha mo'i gzi byin gyis/ /dkar phyogs bsil zer can ltar rab rgyas nas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rnams mthar phyin mdzod/ /snang srid gzugs brnyan yid bzhin dpal mo'i sku/ /grag stong sgra rnams gsang sngags rang sgra'i ngang / /gang bsam rig stong brjod med dpal mo'i thugs/ /gnad 'di'i ma mas mngon sum zhal ston mdzod/ /de la brten nas dug gsum gyis bskyed pa'i/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa skad cig gi /drung nas phyung ste dad ldan skal bzang bdag /tshe yi rigs 'dzin mchog de thob par mdzod/ /gzhan yang sdug bsngal rtsa ba bdag 'dzin gyi/ /thog med dus nas gdams pa'i rang sems kyi/ /rang mtshang rig pa'i mod la rtsa bral dngos/ /rjen par rtogs te don gnyis lhun grub mdzod/ /ces pa 'di yang yongs 'dzin dam pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'gran zla dang bral ba spyan snga rin po che ā nanda'i mtshan can de nyid las/ rje btsun sgrol ma 'di nyid kyi khrid nos dus 'dren mchog dam pa de nyid kyi bkas bskul ba spyi bos cod paṇa du blangs te sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen ngag dbang kun dgas bris pa'o/ /ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //'ba' ra lugs kyi tshe khrid kyi brgyud 'debs 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba bzhugs/59 /na mo gu ru a mṛ ta bha wa ye/ 'chi med dbang po rgyal ba 'od dpag med/ /rigs 'dzin brnyes pa grub pa'i rgyal mo'i zhabs/ /skyes bu'i gtsug rgyan rdo rje grags pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /gangs can grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mi la'i zhabs/

/gang de'i thugs sras chos rje sgam po pa/ /mkhas grub chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol baྎ rten 'brel zab mo'i don gzigs 'jig rten mgon/ /nyams rtogs phul du phyin pa'i spyan snga ba/ /rgyal ba'i rnam sprul yang dgon chos rje la/ /gsol baྎ dam pas rjes bzung spyan snga rin chen ldan/ /lha mi'i 'dren pa zur phug rin chen dpal/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal chos rje 'ba' ra ba/ /gsol baྎ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos chos kyi rgyal po dang / /zab lam mngon gyur sangs rgyas seng ge'i zhabs/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol baྎ mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs ye shes rin chen dang / /yon tan dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i chos kyi rje/ /sems gnyis mnga' bdag bsod nams shes rab la/ /gsol baྎ gzung 'dzin mdud pa grol ba'i kun mkhyen pa/ /gdod ma'i rang mtshang rig pa'i kun dga' bzang / /dam pa'i skyes bu bya rgod sprul sku la/ /gsol baྎ shes bya kun mkhyen snying rje bzang po dang / /mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med spyan snga rin chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag dang pha mar gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog / ces 'ba' ra lugs kyi tshe khrid zab mo'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'phags yul gyi mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho dang / gangs can gyi spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar sogs kyi sku'i sprul pa/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa spyan snga rin po che ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa de nyid slar yang bsam bzhin du sku skye ba bzhes pa/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' don grub kyi drung du/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi tshe khrid 'di sogs zab rgyas chos tshul rgya mtsho'i bka' drin nos dus/

'di lta bu'i brgyud 'debs cig gyis ces bka' stsal spyi bos blangs te dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba 'dis dge legs su gyur cig yi ge pa ni gdong dga' ba bsam pa don grub kyis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ /gong gi snying rje bzang po'i rjes su/ rims gnyis mthar phyin spyan snga rin po che/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos ngag dbang kun dga' la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med dngos grub stsol// ༈ //slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas la gu ru'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar nas bstod pa bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs/60 /na mo gu ru puṇya ind+ra kirti ma ti buddha dhwa dza tri ṇi ye/ rgya mtshor sku 'khrungs u rgyan yul du byon/ /rgyal po'i sras mdzad rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ /'khor bar ma chags rol rtsed sna tshogs mdzad/ /padma rgyal po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rgya gar yul byon rdo rje gdan du bzhugs/ /bdud bzhi bcom pas sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'dul khrims ldan pas dge slong cha lugs 'dzin/ /shākya seng ge'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /za hor yul byon ma ga dha ru bzhugs /bsil ba'i tshal du bam ro'i bsgrub pa mdzad/ /sde snod bcu gnyis thugs kyi klong na gsal/ /padma sambha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mu stegs yul byon dga' ba'i tshal du bzhugs/ /snyan pa'i sgra yi phyogs mtshams kun du khyab/ /gsang sngags phyi nang thugs kyi klong na gsal/ /rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yangs pa can byon so sa gling du bzhugs/ /lta ba mi 'tshol zhi gnas bsgom mi byed/ /tha snyad phyogs 'dzin ma gos nam mkha' ltar/ /padma thod phreng stsal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kha che'i yul byon siṅga la ru bzhugs/ /thos bsam ldan pas 'gro ba ma lus 'dul/ /byams pa chen pos pha ma lta bur mdzad/ /blo ldan mchog sred sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/li yi yul byon lcang ra smug por bzhugs/ /shel gong brag la mngon shes mkha' ltar khyab/ /gzhan don 'phrin las 'bras bu lo 'dab rgyas/ /nyi ma 'od zer sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bal po'i yul byon yang le shod du bzhugs/ /gnod sbyin rdzong du dam sri sde brgyad btul/ /khams gsum dbang bsdus srid gsum zil gyi gnon/ /seng ge sgra sgrogs sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bod yul dbus byon stag tshangs seng phug bzhugs/ /snang ba mtha' yas sprul pa 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mkha' 'gro sde bzhi ma tshogs rol du khrid/ /bde ba'i dngos grub sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srin po'i yul byon rnga yab gling du bzhugs/ /zangs mdog dpal rir gdong dmar srin po btul/ /skye 'gro sems can thams cad bde la bkod/ /padma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de ltar slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la/ /snying nas dad pas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'di rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyi grub par mdzad du gsol/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /de la brten nas bstan pa rab rgyas shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /spangs rtogs yon tan skad cig gis rdzogs te/ /gzhan phyir bsam bzhin srid pa len par shog /de yang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang / /bstan pa skyong ba'i stobs ldan sa skyong sogs/ /thabs mkhas sprul pa'i khyad par bgrangs yas kyi/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don mang bsgrub par shog /khyad par bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /dri ma med pa'i ring lugs ngo mtshar gyis/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs ljongs 'di khyab gyur ste/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i 'phrin las de 'drar shog /ces slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas la gu ru'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar nas bstod pa bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba 'di yang /

sa'i lha mo brtan ma 'khor dang bcas pas slob dpon rin po che'i rnam thar dang mthun par bstod pa'i dpe rnying las sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis kha skongs cung zad dang bcas dag par bris pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༈ /slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas la thugs rje myur bskul gyi gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bod khams kun du bde ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so/61 /na maḥsarba buddha bodhi satwa ya/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /mkhyen brtse nus ldan gu ru rin po che/ /lho nub rnga yab gling phran dpal gyi ri'i/ /padma 'od nas da lta gnas 'dir byon/ /steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /bar gyi cha la yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /'og gi cha la bka' srung mkha' 'gro rnams/ /bu yug 'tshub ltar mngon sum gsal bar bzhugs/ /bdag gzhan lus srog longs spyod dus gsum gyi/ /dge tshogs mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /yid kyis sprul nas mchod yul rnams la 'bul/ /rgyun chad med par spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /ding sang gangs can ljongs 'dis 'gro 'di rnams/ /las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu du ma smin/ /smra shes don go mi yi lus thob kyang / /ngan song sdug bsngal lta bu'i gzir la gzigs/ /tsha grang srog bral dmyal ba'i yul ljongs bzhin/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal yi dwags lus dang mtshungs/ /bsad spyad bkol spyugs dud 'gro ltar myong ba'i/ /'gro ba 'di rnams thugs rjes myur du skyobs/ /gzhan dma' 'bebs phyir g.yo sgyu khram gsum gyi/ /'khrug longs ma lus zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /chags sdang dbang gi dus 'khrugs 'di zhi nas/ /so so rang dbang thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal po rnams kyi chos bzhin sa skyongs zhing / /'bangs rnams bka' bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/

/bstan 'dzin thams cad sku tshe legs brtan zhing / /bzhed don lhun gyi 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dge 'dun sde rnams 'chad nyan 'phel ba dang / /bstan pa ris med dar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bsgrub pa po rnams g.yeng bas ma gos pa'i/ /ting 'dzin las su rung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /yul phyogs kun du char chu dus su 'bab/ /lo phyugs rtag tu legs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi nad phyugs nad dus 'khrugs rgyun chad nas/ /rgyal khams bde bas 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /stobs ldan rnams kyi rgyud la bsam ngan gyi/ /'jig rten phung sems zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ci ste las ngan dbang gis phung g.yos kyang / /nus med rang zhir 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' srung rnams kyi'ang gzhan gyis ma bskul yang / /gdug can dngos su sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /skye bo 'di kun ngo tsha khrel yod kyi/ /gcig sems gcig gis 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /phan tshun byams sems g.yo med rab brtan pas/ /kun gyi bde thabs sgrub par byin gyi rlobs/ /de la brten nas ljongs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams/ /bde skyid dpal la spyod par byin gyis rlobs/ /kun kyang chog shes rtsod med mnga' ris kyi/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin mchod par byin gyis rlobs/ /'byung po rnams kyang gdug rtsub kun zhi nas/ /'gro la brtse sems skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na gzugs can gzugs med 'gro ba kun/ /shes rgyud chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ /de la brten nas phyi ma lhan cig par/ /bde ba can du skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gu ru rin po che/ /'khor bcas rang la thim pa'i byin brlabs kyis/ /slob dpon chen po'i lung rtogs yon tan dang / /rang nyid nus pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag gis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod pas/ /bdag cag byas med yus kyi gdung shugs kyis/

/bdag nyid chen po khyed la gsol btab pas/ /bdag gzhan don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces slob dpon rin po che padma 'byung gnas la thugs rje myur bskul gyi gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bod khams kun tu bde ba'i dpal ster zhes bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lcags mo sbrul lo dbus gtsang gi ljongs 'dir dus ngan gyi 'khrug long sna tshogs byung dus/ skye 'gro rnams myur du bde ba la 'god pa zhig byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas blang ste/ hor zla bcu pa'i dkar phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la dge sdings chos kyi pho brang chen por legs par sbyar ba 'dis kyang / bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la mchod cing bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs/62 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza shākya mu ne ye/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la mchod cing bstod pa'i rab du byed pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ston pa thams cad mkhyen pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don la gcig gzhol ba'i/ /mngon par mkhyen dang rdzu 'phrul zhabs ldan pa/ /'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug po/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bdag gis dngos 'byor mchod pa ji snyed dang / /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /mchod sprin stong gsum khyab par rab sprul nas/ /gus pas 'bul lo brtse bas bzhes su gsol/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin thub dbang zas gtsang sras/ /des gsung lung rtogs bdag nyid dam pa'i chos/ /rgyal sras bstan 'dzin 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/

/thub pas bka' bsgos bstan pa rin chen skyong / /mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /lha dang mi yi bsod nams dpal gyi zhing / /gnas brtan 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ti se'i gangs na stong dang sum 'khor dgra bcom pa/ brgyas bskor/ /mthong reg tshul khrims dri yi rnam dag cing / /nyon mongs kun sel spos snod rnga yab bsnams/ /gnas brtan yan lag 'byung laྎ drang srong ri ngogs dgra bcom brgya yi bskor/ /mthong thos dran pas tshul khrims la sogs pa'i/ /yon tan 'phel ba'i mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /gnas brtan ma pham pa laྎ lo ma bdun rir stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor/ 'khor dgra bcom pa/ /gang bstad gnod pa kun zhi'i sdig mdzub dang / /ser bus log rtog gdung sel rnga yab bsnams/ /gnas brtan nags na gnas laྎ zangs gling gnas na stong dang 'khor dgra bcom pa/ chig brgyas bskor/ /mthong dang reg pas spangs rtogs kun thob cing / /'khor mang 'du ba'i gser gyi rna skor bsnams/ /gnas brtan dus ldan zhabs laྎ sing ga'i gling na dgra bcom stong gi bskor/ /gdug pa zhi nas 'dun 'gyur sdigs mdzub dang / /mthong dang reg pas don grub rnga g.yab bsnams/ /rdo rje mo yi bu laྎ ya mun na gling stong dang bzhi 'khor dgra bcom pa/ brgyas bskor/ /chos kun don rtogs chos 'chad phyag rgya dang / /ting 'dzin 'bras can grub pa'i mnyam gzhag mdzad/ /gnas brtan bzang po'i zhabs laྎ kha che'i yul na dgra bcom lnga brgyas bskor/ /gang zhig mthong thos reg pas gzung spobs sogs/ /yon tan kun stsol gser gyi zhags pa bsnams/ /gnas brtan gser be'u laྎ ba glang spyod na dgra bcom bdun brgyas bskor/ /gang gi 'dun byas ngan 'gro las grol zhing / /dga' bde ye shes rgyas mdzad mnyam gzhag can/ /bha ra dhwa dza gser can laྎ sgra mi snyan na dgra bcom dgu brgyas bskor/ /mthong zhing reg nas dpal 'byor kun stsol cing /

/phar phyin drug sogs chos 'phel ne'u le bsnams/ /gnas brtan ba gu la laྎ pri yang ku lir stong 'khor dgra bcom pa/ dang nyis brgyar bcas/ /mthong zhing reg na nyes pa kun sel zhing / /chos kyi tshig don rtogs pa'i prog zhu bsnams/ /gnas brtan sgra gcan 'dzin laྎ bya rgod phung por 'khor dgra bcom pa/ stong dang drug brgyas bskor/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs me dpung zhi mdzad nas/ /phan bde rgyas mdzad mnyam gzhag phyag rgya can/ /gnas brtan lam phran bstanྎ lus 'phags gling na dgra bcom stong gis bskor/ /mthong dang reg pa sdug bsngal kun sel ba'i/ /phyag g.yas glegs bam g.yon pas mnyam gzhag mdzad/ /bha ra dhwa dza bsod snyoms len la 'dud/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yul na dgu brgyas bskor/ 'khor dgra bcom pa/ spobs pa rgya che bskyed mdzad glegs bam dang / /blo gros snang ba 'phel ba'i chos 'chad can/ /gnas brtan lam bstan zhabs laྎ ngos yangs ri na stong dang bzhi brgyas bskor/ 'khor dgra bcom pa/ phyag g.yas dgos 'dod kun 'byung bum bzang dang / sgra thos nad rims kun sel 'khar sil bsnams/ /gnas brtan klu'i sde laྎ bhi hu la rir stong dang nyis brgyas bskor/ /mthong zhing reg na gnas lnga la mkhas shing / /nyon mongs nad kun sel ba'i glegs bam bsnams/ /gnas brtan sbed byed zhabs laྎ gangs ri'i rgyal por dgra bcom stong gis bskor/ /mthong thos reg na sdig pa kun zhi nas/ /'dod don ma lus 'grub pa'i mchod rten bsnams/ /gnas brtan mi phyed pa laྎ thub pa'i bstan srung gnas brtan bka' bzhin bsgrub/ /phyag g.yas rnga yab g.yon pas bum pa bsnams/ /dge bsnyen du ma'i 'khor gyis legs bskor ba'i/ /dge bsnyen dharma pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar dgra bcom bcu drug 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing gus pa'i yid kyis gsol btab pas/ /bdag gi yid la re ba'i don 'di rnams/ /'bad med lhun gyis grub par mdzad du gsol/

/bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /de la brten nas bstan pa rab rgyas shog /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /spangs rtogs yon tan skad cig gis rdzogs te/ /gzhan phyir bsam bzhin srid pa len par shog /de yang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dang / /bstan pa skyong ba'i stobs ldan sa skyong sogs/ /thabs mkhas sprul pa'i khyad par bgrangs yas kyis/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i don mang sgrub par shog /khyad par bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /dri ma med pa'i ring lugs ngo mtshar gyis/ /'dzam gling byang phyogs ljongs 'di khyab gyur te/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i 'phrin las de 'drar shog /ces 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la mchod cing bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di yang / /gnas brtan gyi mdo dang / byams pa lung bstan du gsungs pa'i phyag mtshan gyi phan yon dang mthun par sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos gnas brtan chen po de dag la dwangs 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa rab tu g.yo bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ sa sbrul zla ba lnga pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yangs rtse ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas su legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig gnas brtan bcu drug 'khor dang bcas pas sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha hūm̐/ dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsal du gsol/ ma mā sya saṅgha sa pa ri wa ra sya da sha dharma tsarya sā dha na wardha naṃ kurbantu/ bdag dang dge 'dun 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos skyod bcu'i bsgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/
