buddha de sha bistā ra bha wa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnam par rgyas par mdzod/ sarba a pakṣa u pa shintaṃ kurbantu/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sarba maṅgalaṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// ༈ //lam zab brgyud 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/63 rdo rje 'chang chen bdag med bi ru pa/ /sa skya'i bla chen yab sras rnams pa lnga/ /tshogs bsgom brag phug pa dang 'gro mgon rje/ /buddha shrī ngor chen mus pa rje/ /kun mkhyen yongs 'dzin sa skya lo tsā ba/ /dkon mchog lhun grub sngags 'chang yab sras dang / /dkon mchog rgyal mtsho mus chen buddha'i mtshan/ /ngag dbang kun bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i rjes bzung nas/ /zab mo'i yangs rtse lam zab bla ma yi/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med lhun grub shog /ces pa 'di yang a nandas/ /nyung la dga' ba'i bu slob kyis/ /bskul nas de ma thag tu bris/ /dpon slob bsam pa mthar phyin shog /ka lyā na wardantu// ༈ //rigs 'dzin bskul gyi kha skong bzhugs/64 rigs 'dzin bskul gyi sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i rjes su 'di ltar sbyar te/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros kyis/ /grang ba'i ngad ldan ri bo la/ /ji ltar rtag brtan snyel lam ci/ /phur bu bsgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tshul 'di ngag dbang kun bsod kyis/ /dad pas sbyar ba'i bsod nams kyis/ /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /sras kyi thu bo byed par shog /phur pa'i brgyud 'debs kha skong bzhugs/65 nged rang sa skya pa'i pha chos lhad med rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub bsgrub pa'i smin byed dbang gi chu bos bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i rjes su 'di ltar sbyar bar bya ste/ smin byed dbang gi chu bo'i rgyud sbyangs nas/ gdams pa nyams len chu bo mthar phyin te/

skal bzang 'gro la rnam grol lam ston pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon tshe byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho/ /phyi rab 'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes/ /dus 'dir sngags 'chang bla ma sems dpa' che/ /grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rigs sras bsod nams bye ba'i gter/ /grub pa'i mtshan mas 'dzam gling dbang du bsdus/ /gzhan sde log bsgrub stong gis ma pham pa'i/ /'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs/ /dri med gzhung brgya 'chad la thogs med cing / /khrims ldan 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi brgyan/ /rims gnyis ting 'dzin mchog ldan sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di rdo rje phur pa'i stod las byang chub bsgrub pa'i dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skongs du sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis yud tsam zhig la bris pa'o/ /don gnyer can rnams dges par mdzod/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gshed dmar spros med kyi zab mo'i khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/65'og dge legs 'phel/ /na mo gu ru mañdzu badzra ya/ dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dang birwa pa/ /ḍoṃ bhi ba dang grub chen dpal 'dzin zhabs/ /blo zab snying po dar paṇa a tsarya/ /shes rab rin chen rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro mgon pa pa mchog ldan legs pa'i blo/ /dpal ldan seṅge bu ston rin chen grub/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan theg chen rin po che/ /'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal shar chen ye shes mtshan/ /ngor chen kun bzang mus chen sems dpa' che/ /bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan kun spangs rje/ /blo gsal rgya mtsho rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang /

/mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /ngag gi dbang phyug chos kun gzigs pa yi/ /grags pa srid gsum gsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i thugs kyi sras/ /kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seṅge dang / /dkon mchog 'phel ba lha mchog seṅge'i mtshan/ /dkon mchog lhun grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dkon mchog dpal ldan shar chen kun bkras dang / /zab yangs chos kyi mdzod 'dzin spyan mnga' ba/ /bka' drin mnyam med kun dga' don grub ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gzung 'dzin spros pa'i snang ba sna tshogs kyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen por ltung byed pa'i/ /g.yo ba'i sems 'di spros med rnal 'byor gyis/ /'od gsal dbyings su thim par byin gyis rlobs/ /thun mtshams kun du ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ /dmigs med snying rje'i shugs kyis las drangs nas/ /'khor gsum mngon zhen dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la 'bad par shog /bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /'gro kun blo gros mun pa rab bsal nas/ /shes bya'i gnas kun ji snyed thams cad la/ /thog pa med pa'i blo gros stsal du gsol/ /ces gshed dmar spros med kyi zab mo'i khrid kyi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ dpal sa skyar gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid lan gsum spel ba'i tshe/ chos nyan slob ma rnams kyi don du 'gyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shes rab rgya mtshos bgyis pa 'dis 'phral yun du dge legs su gyur cig dharmā u da ya mastu/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ / 'di'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rgya mtshos gong ma thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag dpe las btus pa lags so// //bde kye gsang gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs dang brgyud 'debs skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i kha skongs bzhugs/66

dpal ldan sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gsang gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs dang / brgyud 'debs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i kha skongs cung zad brjod na/ bde mchog bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs su/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo'i rjes su/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i zhabs/ sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan sogs/ /rab mchod dngos grub thams cad stsol/ ces sbyar ro/ /brgyud 'debs gang drin ma'i skabs su/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i rjes su/ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho/ /snyigs dus slar yang mi'i zol/ /sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /sbyin bya bzhi dang blang bya gnyis/ /drod dang spyod pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /'di dag ni dbang bskur rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ste/ khrid kyi brgyud pa ni 'dir yi ges 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /shes par 'dod na kho bo'i thob yig skal ldan yid 'jug tu gsal lo/ /kyai rdor man ngag lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs su/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen gyi rjes su/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ /drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du o āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyar/ brgyud 'debs dpal mchog ma'i 'jam dbyangs sa lo'i rjes su/ snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang rje/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos bsod nams dbang po dang / /mkhas pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs/

/de sras mthu bo ratna sa mu tra/ /bka' drin mnyam med sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la sogs/ de bzhin du rnam dag dkyil 'khor ma'i rjes su byams pa'i dpal mnga' sogs/ dkon mchog gsum dngos yongs 'dzin mgon gyi bzung / sogs/ dkon mchog dgyes pa'i thugs ldan bshes gnyen che/ /'phrin las rgya mtshos 'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab/ /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes dang / sangs rgyas kun 'dus sogs dang / der rjes bskyed pa phyi yi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor du sogs sbyar/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi rjes/ su kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen/ 'dren mchog dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sbyar/ 'di ni dbang khrid gnyis ka'i brgyud pa yin cing / dbang bskur rkyang pa'i brgyud pa ni/ sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i dkyil chog tu gsungs pa ltar/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i rjes su/ rje sangs rin pa/ 'jam dbyangs sa lo/ rje dkon mchog lhun grub/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po yab sras rnams yin pas de ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos bde kye gsang gsum gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams la nang mchod 'bul ba'i skabs dang brgyud 'debs kyi skabs su nye bar mkho ba'i kha skongs 'di rnams khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang /

rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa sems dpa' chen po grags pa'i mtshan can sku mched kyi drung du zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dbang khrid lung man ngag rjes gnang bka' gtad rab tu mang po'i bka' drin nos shing / khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi drung du dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag sogs zab rgyas chos bgrangs ba las 'das pa zhig dang / lhag par bde kye gsang gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i zab khrid kyi rigs mi 'dra ba bcu drug tsam gyi bka' drin thob pa'i skal ba bzang po can/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lha khang chen mo'i shar lho kun bzang pho brang ngam/ rigs 'dzin pho brang zhes kyang bya ba'i gnas mchog de nyid du sbyar ba 'dis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi kun mkhyen chen po'i rjes su sbyar rgyu'i gsol 'debs kyi tshig bcad yid kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs/67 oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ 'dir smras pa/ kun mkhyen chen po bsod nams seng ges mdzad pa'i phar tshad kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni/ bla ma snga ma snga ma la/ phyi ma phyi ma'i phar tshad gnyis kyi bshad pa'i rgyun gsan pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i brgyud 'debs su snang zhing / deng sang chos grwa chen po 'di na phar tshad brgyud 'debs mdzad pa'i tshe/ kun mkhyen chen po'i rjes su/ sa skya lo tsā ba dang / chos sde 'di nyid kyi mkhan rab kyi gsol 'debs mdzad pa zhig 'dug pa 'di ni/ phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi kha skongs rang du 'gro bar ma nges kyang / sa lo dang mkhan rab sogs bstan pa la bka' drin che ba rnams la gsol ba 'debs par snang bas shin tu legs par mthong zhing /

rgyu mtshan des na sa lo sogs mkhan rab so so'i sku bstod shlau ka re re 'don pa'i chos spyod kyi tshegs skyungs ba'i phyir/ deng phyin chad phar tshad kyi brgyud 'debs gnyis ka'i kun mkhyen chen po'i rjes su 'di ltar sbyar ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa sa skya lo tsā'i zhabs/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rje/ /gang gi rgyal tshab 'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas la gsol ba 'debs/ /legs bshad sgo brgya 'byed pa'i blo gros can/ /lha dbang gtsug gi mchod pa bzang po'i zhabs/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad bkra shis 'byung ba'i gnas/ /dpal 'byor rnam rgyal rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa dpal mgon rin chen zhabs/ /gzhung lugs kun rig kun dga' rin chen dang / /ngag dbang lha yi byin rlabs grags pa'i mtshan/ /rin chen blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /phun tshogs bstan pa'i sgor zhugs rin chen mtshan/ /mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i don la dbang 'byor ba'i/ /bstan pa'i gsal byed rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs/ mkhan brgyud rim par byon la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sbyar ro/ /'di lta bu'i phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi kun mkhyen chen po'i rjes su sbyar rgyu'i gsol 'debs kyi tshig bcad 'di rnams ni phar tshad brgyud 'debs rang gi kha skongs thun mong ma yin par 'gro bar mi 'dug kyang / sa lo dang sngags 'chang yab sras sogs spyi dgos kyi bstan pa la bka' drin che ba rnams la gsol la 'debs pa'i tshig ngag 'don bde ba'i phyir tshigs bcad nyung ngu 'di rnams sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i kun nas blangs ste 'phral dang yun gyi rten 'brel gyi gnad zab mo 'grig pa'i phyir sbyar ba 'dis phyogs dus kun du bde legs su gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //'jam dbyangs la bstod pa byin rlabs bskul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/72

dhi yampa tiḥbuddha dhwa dza ye na maḥ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rab gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya las/ /rab mdzes chu skyes pod ral gyis mtshan pa/ /yid 'phrog 'jam pa'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /don med don log 'gal dang ma 'brel sogs/ /nyes pa kun bral rgyal ba dges pa'i lam/ /tshul bzhin ston la gzhan gyi mtshungs med pa'i/ /rtsod bral 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kun rig stong brjod med nam mkha'i ngang / /nges par gzigs pas ji lta ji snyed kun/ /ji bzhin mnga' bas bde stong rol pa che/ /zag med 'jam pa'i rdo rjer gus pas 'dud/ /khyod kyi gzugs sku du mas gangs can 'dir/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don mang mdzad pa'i rigs/ /bdag la mkhas pa'i bya ba rnams gsum la/ /thogs pa med pa'i blo gros stsal du gsol/ /ma rig mun pas khyab pa'i ma 'di dag /bdag ltas shes bzhin skyobs par ma nus pas/ /mkhyen zhing brtse la nus pa'i stobs ldan pa/ /khyod kyi khyod 'drar kun kyang 'gyur bar mdzod/ /ces pa rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la/ /bstod tshig byin rlabs bskul byed 'di/ /'jam dbyangs thig le las skyes pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa des/ /'jam dpal sku 'dra rtsod rgyal mar/ /dad pas ched du gtad nas bris/ /dges pas byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ kalyā na wardhantu// ༈ //bra hma ṇī sa ra swa sti stod tra ā la ka ra mā la nāḥbi ha ra tisma/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/73 rgya gar skad du/ bra hma ṇī sa ra pra swasti stod traṃ ā li ka ra mā la na maḥ bod skad du/ tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can ma la bstod pa rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dbang dbang phyug dga' ma'i bdag po dang / /nye dbang dbang po'i sgra dang rgan las thos/

/glang gdong gdong drug mkha' lding tshogs kun gyis/ /mchod byed byed pa'i bu mo de la 'dud/ /chu skyes rigs kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/ dkar po ge sar g.yo ba'i rtse mor ri bong 'dzin pa'i gnas la tsog pur bzhugs/ /zhal bya ba/ gcig zhabs gnyis dri za'i rgyud mang rin chen gdu bu'i sgra ldan phyag gis 'gying zhing bsgyur/ /dri zhim yon tan/ li ba'i dbu skra sil bur mdzes shing mkhur tshos rna brgyan dag gis rnam mdzes ma/ /tshangs rdzas/ pa'i bu mo rab mdzes yid 'phrog ma khyod bdag gi snying la 'jug par mdzod/ /ka dpe rgyan/ la ping ka'i gdangs las phul byung 'jig rten dbang po'i zhal las legs 'khrungs byed po'i gsung 'phrog sgra ldan ma/ /kha gzugs can/ dog rab mdzes 'od zer phreng ldan mig stong ldan pas bltas pas tshim med zla ba dung las dkar ba'i sku/ /ga gsal byed/ bur tsandan dri ldan ma khyod mtshan dang dpe byad dra ba 'bar ba'i nor bu'i phreng brgyan mdzes ma kye/ /nga bskor ba/ ni yang yang dad pa'i zla rgyas lag gnyis mtsho skyes spyi bor zum byas mig gnyis mchi ma'i chu rlabs g.yo/ /ca 'gog pa/ co smra bas ci bya gtol med snying nas yus pa'i ngu ba'i bu 'di mi gzigs ma yi dgos pa ci/ /cha don gzhan bkod pa/ shas kun nas rab mdzes mtsho skyes 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru'i phreng ldan dbyangs gsal hring gi ngag gi sgrib pa spongs/ /ja zlog pa can/ sogs 'dod dgu dpal bsgyur mes po dang mtshungs lha mo tshem la 'khrungs shing gdong bzhi pa ni phrag pa las/ /nya srid pa can/ dang zla ba'i zhal can yid 'phrog ma nyid ku mud mi 'dzum blo gros pad tshal ge sar rgod par mdzod/ /ta bsdus pa/ la'i rkang 'thung lo 'dab gsar ba'i grib bsil can kyang nya bsten gdung byed 'od las skyobs pa ltar/ /tha phul byung /

dad du ma'i rmongs pa skyob nus dbyangs can yid kyi blo gros shong ba shes bya'i yangs pa e ma mtshar/ /da rab rtags/ dung nyid dang mtshungs pa dpe zhig byed pos ma rnyed nyin mtshan chas mtshon nyi zla'i gling bzhir 'tshol bar nges/na rgyu'i rgyan/ tshod dar babs brgyad gnyis lon khyod mdzes ma nyid phyir pad dkar mig sogs lha dbang du ma'i yid 'phrog ma/ /pa phra mo/ la sha yi grib shing sngon po'i gdung byed 'od las skyobs pa ji bzhin lha mos bdag la dgongs par mdzod/ /pha cha'i rgyan/ rol phyin don zab pa'i gnas lugs yul nyid dran dus ma la ya rlung reg pas bdag mig mchi mar byed/ /ba rim pa/ mos ma reg ku mud ta dang pad dkar zla ba dag gi do shal thod bcings spyi gtsug mdzes par brgyan/ ma dga' ba/ li gsar pa'i dri ldan nu ma rab rgyas 'dzum pa'i bzhin can mig zur g.yo bas lhag par dga'/ /tsa nyams ldan/ ra ka sogs rig byed bzhi 'dzin dag gi khyod la skyabs tshol 'dzum dang gdangs snyan sgeg pa'i tshul can ma/ tsha gzi brjid/ dmyal thugs rje'i char gyis skyabs kyang 'bros pa'i dmyal srung nye bar mi gsod byams pa'i mtshon gyis kun las rgyal/ /dza rnam grangs/ lan dha ra spyi bo'i gnas kyi khyod zhabs padmo'i ze'u 'bru nyer mchog 'bar 'dzag bde skyed shes bya kun/ /wa kun phan/ le mkhyen khyod bsod nams las 'ong 'bad pa med par phun tshogs bzhed don ma lus grub pa e ma mtshar/ /zha rgya chen/ ltar bsten 'os rab mdzes lha mo'i dgra bo bu bzhin nye bar bskyangs shing 'byor ba phun tshogs ma lus brnyes/ za smyon dor/ 'og ltar bkra rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa 'di ni stong pa ma lags lha mo'i thugs rgyud gang ba lags/ /'a sbyar ba/ 'ur dar dir snyan pa'i grags pa gdong bzhi ldan pa'i gdong pas brjod dka' mnga' ba'i 'od zer 'phros ldan ni/

/ya khyad par brjod/ mtshan che ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa byams dang snying rje'i mtshon cha'i phreng bas mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba mtshar/ /ra mtshungs sbyor/ gan lcags sogs gser 'gyur rtsi dang rab mdzes yid 'ong lha mo gnyis pos 'gro ba 'dod bzhin bsgyur ba ni/ /la 'gal ba/ lar dkar gsal 'od chags 'bar dang la lar nam mkha'i mdog dang mtshungs pa'i lus phra yid 'ong mdzes ldan ma/ /sha skabs min/ yi spyan sogs mngon shes drug po'i yon tan yar ldan sdug bsngal mtsho las 'bad med brgal ba nyid bde ste/ /sa zol bstod/ steng 'di na nye dbang myos byed bde 'byung sogs kyang bde bar gnas na sgrib pa zad khyod mtshar ci mchis/ /ha nges rten/ la'i rkang 'thung 'bras bu dang ldan sbyar bas srog 'phrog nye bar zhi ba'i rig pa che 'dzin khyod dang ni/ /a lhan cig nyid gdod nas skye ba med ston yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mtha' dag 'gro ba'i don la mnyam du byung / /'gro ba'i yongs rjes/ gdung bas thugs rjes bskul ste rab mdzes lha mo'i mdzad pa 'dis kyang 'gro ba'i dad pa bskul lags pas/ /bdag shis brjod/ sogs 'gro kun ma lus yid la sangs rgyas kun gyi mkhyen pas bkra ba'i dpal mo dbyangs can 'jug gyur cig /rnam dkar thog mtha' sbyar ba'i zung rgyan/ nyid kyi yon tan brjod las 'das/ /'das pa'i bde gshegs rnams kyang bskyed pa'i yum/ /yum mchog lha mo nyid la bstod byed gang / /gang yin de yi ngag la gnas byed shog /ces dbyangs can lha mo la bstod pa rgyan gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshom dmar chen po'i chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri padma can gyi drung du sngon byon pa'i mkhas pa chen po dag gi gsung rab la brten nas bris pa'i yi ge pa ni rang dang nye bar gnas pa'i dge sdings pa rab 'byams smra ba bsam gtan rgya mtshos bgyis so/

/'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gur drag bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong bzhugs/74 oṃ swasti siddham̐/ gu ru drag po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i rjes su/ theg chen chos kyi mtho ba'i seng ge'i khrir/ /ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzinྎ rang grolྎ rab 'byams mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i klong yangs su/ /'jam dbyangs bkra shis rin chen la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyis 'dzinྎ rang grolྎ skal ldan 'ga' aṣṭa la lo bdun bsnyen pa song zhing / sbyor drug gi nyams myong bzang po 'khrungs pa'i grub thob 'jam dbyangs rin chen zer ba gcig sogs skal ldan 'ga' slob dpon rin po cher dngos su mthong ba'i lo rgyus sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar can du ma mnga' ba/ la padma'i skur bstan pa'i/ /spyan snga kun dga'i mtshan can la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnyisྎ rang grolྎ mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i pho brang du/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams laྎ gnyis 'dzinྎ rang grolྎ zhes pa 'di yang snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa dam pa spyan snga rin po che byams pa kun dga'i mtshan can gyis bka' stsal lhur blangs te/ sa skya pa gdod nas rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis yud tsam zhig la bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bde mchog brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong bzhugs/75 bde mchog brgyud 'debs gang drin ma'i sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po'i rjes su 'di ltar sbyar bar bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba 'tsho/ snyigs dus slar yang mi yi zol/ /sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /sbyin bya bzhi dang blang bya gnyis/ /drod dang spyod pa mthar phyin pa'i/ /khyab bdag sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /rtag tu phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/

/zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gnyis po 'di ni bde mchog nag po lugs kyi dbang rgyun tsam gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kha skong du rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i dbang dang zab khrid rgya mtsho lta bu'i shes rgyud bltams pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa dge slong a nanda'i ming can gyis yud tsam zhig la bris pa 'dis skal bzang don gnyer can rnams la phan par gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //rig byed lha mo gtso bor gyur pa'i dmar po skor gsum la bstod cing 'phrin las 'chol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dngos grub char 'bebs don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs/80 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ phun tshogs 'byung gnas bod yul gangs khrod kyi/ /chos dang srid kyi bdag po sa skya pa'i/ /thun mong dngos grub ma lus bsgrub mdzad gang / /lha mchog rnam gsum gus pas bstod par bgyi/ /gang sku byu ru'i sdong po phyis pa la/ /'od dang 'od zer du ma'i 'du 'phro can/ /mthong ba tsam gyis srid gsum ma lus pa'i/ /yid rab 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu gsum der 'dud/ /khyad par rje btsun rig byed dbang mo ni/ /chu skyes nyin byed bzhad pa'i gdan steng du/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis gar stabs can/ /yid 'ong mig gi bdud rtsi de la 'dud/ /ma ma gang de'i zung gnyis phyag rnams kyi/ /khams gsum snying 'bigs mda' gzhu yid 'phrog dang / /lcags kyu zhags pa'i snang brnyan me tog phreng / /dbang po'i gzhu ltar mdangs bkra mdzes der 'dud/ /'od ldan thod skam nor bu'i phreng ba dang / /raktar bcas pa'i mgo phreng stag sham can/ /ma nu'i bu yi rus rgyan sgeg mo la/ /nyi ma gzhon nu'i khyim 'bar bzhugs der 'dud/ /gang gsung sna tshogs skad gyi gdul bya yi/ /rna ba'i dbang po tshim pa'i bdud rtsi mchog /khyod thugs padmo bdag dad tsha zer gyi/ /rjes chags brtse bas 'dab ma rgyas der 'dud/ /zab dang rgya che'i bsam brjod yul 'das pa'i/

/yon tan rin chen kun gyi gter gyur zhing / /'phrin las rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag khyod bsgrub pa/ /kun kyang de 'drar 'gyur ba mdzad der 'dud/ /de ltar bla ma rang sems lhag pa'i lha/ /dbyer med dbang bsdud dpal mo khyod bstod pas/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'chi bdag las rgyal nas/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin nyid du mdzod/ /nam yang 'byung bzhi'i nad kyis mi brdzi zhing / /gangs can ljongs 'di'i rgyal po blon po dang / /grong khyer ba sogs gzugs dang gzugs med kyi/ /stobs ldan dregs byed thams cad dbang 'dus mdzod/ /de la brten nas spyi dang bye brag gi /bstan pa rin chen 'phel ba'i mthu ldan zhing / /sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs brgyud dri med rgyun/ /ji srid bskal pa'i bar du mi chad mdzod/ /mdor na bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /tshe mthar phyin zhing bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar mdzod/ /ces rig byed lha mo gtso bor gyur pa'i dmar po skor gsum la bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa dngos grub char 'bebs don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sems dpa' chen po sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spro bsdu'i byed po dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa'i sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ sa skya pa'i dbang gi lha 'di gsum gyi rjes gnang man ngag sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa nos shing /

lha 'di gsum la mchog tu dad pa skyed pa'i rmis ltas ya mtshan can gdan sa chen por lan gnyis dang / dge sdings chos kyi pho brang du lan gcig ste thengs gsum byung ba'i rkyen byas te yos lo zla ba dgu pa'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la gdan sa bar pa dge sdings bkra shis bsam 'grub kyi bla brang chen po'i gzim chung du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge sdings pa rab 'byams smra ba rgya mtsho'i ming can gyis bgyis pa 'dis bdag cag dpon slob thams cad 'phral dang yun du dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //thub bstan lha chen gyi mchod rol la bsngags pa'i tshig bcad bzhugs/81 oṃ bde legs su gyur cig rab tu 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang chen 'dir/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing du brtan bzhugs pa'i/ /ngo mtshar sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang / /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas drung / /mchod rdzas tshangs pa'i dbyangs ldan rnga bo che/ /ngo mtshar sna tshogs mdang bkra yid 'ong dang / /bde chen skal bzang dag gis nyer bsgrub pa'i/ /'brug stong zil gnon rmad byung 'khar ba'i rnga/ dbang po'i gzhu yi mdang 'phrog phye 'phur tshogs/ /de lta'i lha rdzas mchod sprin dpag med 'di/ /'chi med 'od gsal lha rigs 'khon gyi brgyud/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /bzang po'i ming can gang des dad pas phul/ /legs byas bsod nams dpag med 'di yi mthus/ /bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa yis/ /gtso byas nam mkha'i mthar gtugs sems can rnams/ /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rab rgyas shing / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du padmo las/ /brdzus te skyes nas sa lam mthar phyin te/ /spangs rtogs mthar phyin ston pa nyid gyur cig

/ces sa skya pa rigs sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam btab pa 'di dag yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig yang smras pa/ skyabs gnas bslu med rin chen dkon mchog gsum/ /mchog dang thun mong stsol mdzad yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel chos skyong nor lhar bcas/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /yid gnyis spangs te mchod pa kun gyis mchod/ /sgo gsum nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags/ /'phags bzhi so skye'i dge la rje yi rang / /gnas lnga'i chos 'khor rtag tu bskor bar bskul/ /rigs drug 'gro ba'i don du rtag bzhugs zhes/ /nor bdun ldan pa'i rjes btsun bla ma la/ /chos brgyad g.yo zol min pa gsol ba 'debs/ /sa dgu'i bsdus pa'i mtha' yas 'gro ba rnams/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang ma thob bar/ /rnam 'dren khyod kyi byams pa'i phyag zung gis/ /srid zhi'i rgud pa kun las skyabs su gsol/ /gus pas bstod cing smon lam btab pa las/ /las dkar bsags pa gang de'i 'gro drug kun/ /kun mkhyen sa skya'i bzhed gzhung rjes 'gro zhing / /zhing 'dir phan bde'i 'byor pa rgyas gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //thub bstan lha chen du bla bre phul ba'i yi ge bzhugs/82 oṃ swasti siddham̐/ sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i lha tshogs drung / /mchod rdzas dbang po gzhu ltar rab bkra ba'i/ /bla bre 'dzam gling nam mkha' kun khyab 'di/ /dus mthar skyes pa'i sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /sa skya'i rje btsun gsung rab rgya mtsho la/ /shes nas dad pa thob pa'i blo gros can/ /skal bzang gang des shin tu dad pas 'bul/ /bsod nams 'di yi bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/

/don gnyis mthar phyin bstan pa cher rgyas nas/ /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig ka lyā na wardhantu/ thub bstan lha chen du rnga bo che phul pa'i yi ge bzhugs/83 oṃ swasti siddham̐/ sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i lha tshogs drung / /mchod rdzas ngo mtshar lha yi rnga bo che/ /'di la sngags 'chang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ /nyams gso bgyis te dad pas phul pa yis/ /bsod nams 'di yi 'gal rkyen kun zhi nas/ /khams gsum dbang 'dus snyan grags mkha' khyab cing / /bstan pa rab rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /dkon mchog rin po che rnams kyi bden pa'i mthu la brten nas bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //lha sa'i jo bo rin po che la snyan zhal mdzes byed phul pa'i kha yig bzhugs/84 oṃ bde legs su gyur cig lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs kyi mchog /shākya seng ge'i thugs kyi ye shes nyid/ /lha mi'i bsod nams mgron du 'phos pa las/ /gzhan ngos brgya byin dbang pos legs bzhengs pa/ /kun la grags pa'i zas gtsang sras kyi sku/ /rmad byung byin rlabs gzi 'od dpal 'bar ba/ /gang des gtso mdzad gtsug lag khang chen 'di'i/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i rten gsum lha tshogs drung / /zhal dkyil mdzes spyir chos 'khor lha sa'i sku rten che phra kun la zhal gser 'bul tshe zho bzhi re dgos kyi yod 'dug na'ang / de dus gser zho gang lhag tsam gyi jo bo rin po che sogs gal che ba rnams la zhal gser 'bul thengs gnyis re dang / gzhan sku che phra kun la 'bul thengs re tshegs med du kheb song bas de la kun gyis ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa byung / byed yid 'ong gser chab dang /

/kun la thun mong srab 'jam yang ba yi/ yid 'phrog rab tu mdzes pa'i lha rdzas yug /dri zhim yid 'ong ldan pa'i spos kyi tshogs/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas grangs med dang / /mar me'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba sogs/ /rab 'byams mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed 'di/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag sa skya pa'i/ /dri med rigs su skyes pa'i blo gros can/ /shākya'i dge slong rigs sngags 'chang ba gang / /byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /bzang po'i ming can gang des dad pas 'bul/ /dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams 'di yi mthus/ /bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa yis/ /gtso byas mkha' mnyam sems thams cad kyi/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa kun byang nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur thob shog /de ma thob kyi tshe rab kun du yang / /'phags nor bdun ldan dal 'byor lus thob cing / /tshe ring nad med dpal 'byor rgyas pa sogs/ /legs pa'i yon tan ma lus lhun grub ste/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i 'khur chen khyer ba dang / /bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje'i klong yangs mi zad rgya mtsho chen po nas/ /legs par 'ong ba'i sprul pa'i sku mchog bsam 'phel yid bzhin rin po che/ /'gran zla bral khyod da dung mi mjed zhing gi mchog 'dir bskal pa'i bar/ /brtan par bzhugs nas 'gro ba kun gyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par mdzod/ /mgon po khyed kyi yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i dri med srol 'dzin sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed gzhung zab dang rgya che'i dam chos bsam brjod yul las 'das pa rnams/ /bdag dang bdag gi gdul bya la brten phyogs dus kun du rab 'phel te/ /deng dus 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs dang bstan pa'i nyi mar bdag gyur cig /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i mthu dang bslu med dkon mchog thugs rje yis/

/bdag cag 'khor bcas dus 'dir tshe ring rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma rje btsun bla ma dam pa gang na bzhugs pa'i zhing mchog der/ /thogs pa med par brdzus te skye zhing rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /'di ltar du bsgrub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yi mthus bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir jo bo shākya mu ne byon nas mi lo brgya phrag bcu dang bcu phrag bzhir gnyis kyi ma lon pa'i don grub kyi lo dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong ā nanda'i ming can gyi rang lo nyer gsum lon tshe chos 'khor lha sa mjal bar lhags skabs mchod sprin rgya che phul pa'i dus nyid du bris pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //yin thang la na bza' phul ba'i kha yig85 oṃ bde legs su gyur cig bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i bris sku rje btsun gyis bzhengs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' mngon sum du bzhugs nges pa'i gsol ba btab na gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub bde lag tu stsol bar mdzad pa'i yin thang du grags pa'i lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam pa 'di nyid kyi drung du/ bod chen po'i yul nas 'ong ba'i lha rdzas gos bzang yon tan gyi grangs dang dang ldan pa'i na bza' 'di ni/ dpal sa skya pa rigs sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shes nas dad pas 'bul lo/ /legs byas bsod nams 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad 'grub pa dang / /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing gi mchog /bde ba can du skye bar shog /bsam don 'di kun yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ/ ka lya na wardhantu// ༈ //rje btsun rin po che'i sku 'dra mdze thod ma'i drung du phul pa'i mchod rdzas kyi kha yig86

na mo gu ru kirti dhwa dza ye/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mkhyen zhing brtse ba'i ngang las nus mthu thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas skal ldan gyi 'gro ba rnams thar pa'i lam la 'god pa'i phyir bsam bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i gang zag snang kun sgyu mar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po sngags 'chang mtshungs med rje btsun rin po che'i grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku 'dra gang de'i phyag nas ma thugs kar drod rgyun mi chad pa dang bcas pa sku dngos dang khyad par med pa'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du/ mdzes byed gos bzang btso ma gser gyi mdog ldan 'di dpal sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dad pas 'bul lo/ /bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la nges 'byung drag po myur du skyes nas lam bsgrub pa'i gegs su gyur pa'i tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos thong zhing bla ma dam pa nyid kyi rjes su bzung nas gdams pa zab mo dang mjal zhing dam tshig dang ldan pas snying rus chen pos bsgom sran bskyed de bsgom pa la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad zhi zhing / sa lam rnams myur du bgrod de/ nam mkha' la bya bzhin 'phur te gang de'i drung du 'gro ba dang / sprul pa dpag tu med pas sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god nus pa'i bya ba mtha' yas pa bdag gis byed nus par byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ /mi zad 'khor ba'i btson ra chen po 'dir/ /gdos bcas lus 'di yang yang blang dogs nas/ /rgyun du rje btsun nyid la gsol btab pas/ /zhal gyi dkyil 'khor myur du mthong bar shog /mthong ma thag tu rab dga'i sa thob cing / /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam 'di/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /ji bzhin ma lus legs par 'grub gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs/87

na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ /bla ma rje dang ngo mtshar rten mchod rnams/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod cing gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams 'di yis bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'am/ yang na gong gi tshig gnyis kyi rjes su/ bdag sogs dus 'dir bsam don kun 'grub cing / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces sbyar bar bya'o/ /zhes pa 'di yang 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rten mchog bgrangs ba las 'das pa rnams la so sor gsol 'debs rgyas pa zhig sngar byas mod kyang / thun mong du gsol ba 'debs phyir sa skya pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'di'i bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'byung bar gyur cig yang smras pa/ ngo mtshar rmad byung rten mchog rnams /mchod sprin rgyas mchod gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /bsam don thams cad 'grub gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dgyes bzhin gnang ba'i zhal gdams dgos 'dod kun 'grub las zur du bkol ba bzhugs/88 na mo gu ru bha dra ya/ dam tshig ldan pa kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /rab dga'i sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /bsod nams bye ba'i dbus su cher grags pa/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan g.yo med 'dzin mkhas pa'i/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang po gang der 'dud/ / ces 'di puṇya ind+ra yi/ /mkhon gyi rigs skyes rgyal bstan gyi/ /sgor zhugs ngag dbang kun bsod la/ /dges bzhin gnang ba'i zhal gdams mchog /dgos 'dod kun 'grub zhes bya las/ /logs su bkol zhes slob ma'i tshogs/ /mang pos yang yang bskul ba la/ /brten nas sa skya pa de yi/ /bla ma'i gsung gi 'phrin las dag /bsgrub phyir shin tu myur bar bris/ ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/89 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/

rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /bka' srung rnams kyi mthu rtsal gyi/ /bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud 'ga' myur du/ /'byung bar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir/ skyabs gnas bslu med rnams la yid ches gdeng khel gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs phyir bris pa'o/ /'dis bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub bzhugs/90 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bdag gi dus gsum sems can gyi/ /srog gcod sdig pa ci bgyis bshags/ /de dag bde ba can skyes zhing / /bdag sogs 'gro kun der 'gro shog /ces pa'i bshags pa smon lam re ba kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ā nandas srog gcod kyi sdig pa dran pa'i mod la shin tu myur bar bris pa'i dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams la srog gcod kyi rnam smin gyi sdig pas gos par ma gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //smon lam thar pa'i sgo 'byed bzhugs/91 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ dmigs rten byung ba'i gshin po thams cad kyi/ /sdig pa kun bshags de kun byang gyur cig /bla ma'i thugs rjes gshin po ltos bcas rnams/ /da lta bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces pa 'di yang chos med sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang don du bris pa'o// ༈ //gsol 'debs re ba kun 'grub bzhugs/92 oṃ na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ skyabs gnas bslu med kun 'dus pa'i/ /bdag gi bla ma mus pa rje/ /bde ba can sogs gar bzhugs kyi/ /rmi lam gsal po bstan du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di stag lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi tho rang rmi lam du rje bla ma mus pa chen po nyid byon nas/

gshed dmar gyi dbang gi ye shes dbab pa yan gnang ba shin tu gsal bar byung zhing gzhan yang gsung gleng mang du mdzad pa dang / rang gi rgyab tu rje bla ma de nyid gdan drangs nas phyag gzhan la brten pa sogs/ ya mtshan can gyi rmi lam mang du byung ba'i rkyen byas/ bla ma snying nas dran te rje bla ma de nyid kyi thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi bu gcig pa ltar bskyangs pa'i chos med rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa'i phyir bris pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs byin rlabs yid ches ldan pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/93 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ gang thugs dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /ye shes ngang du ro gcig pa'i/ /bdag gi bla ma mus pa rjes/ /nad 'di zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa 'di yang rgyal ba mus pa chen po rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i skal ba bzang po can sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs pa'i phyir bris pa byin rlabs yid ches ldan pa zhes bya ba 'di phyogs dus kun du dge legs su gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //byams pa'i sku 'dra gsung 'byon ma'i bstod pa bzhugs/94 na mo gu ru mai tri na tha ya/ ston pa bla med zas gtsang sras/ /gang gi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mi pham byams pa mgon po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa shākya'i dge slong byams pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /rgyal ba byams pa'i sku rang byon la shes nas dad pa thob ste bstod pa 'dis bsam pa thams cad 'grub par gyur cig bla ma dam pa'i sku 'dra phyag nas ma la snyan dar phul ba'i kha yig bzhugs/95 na mo gu ru/ bla med bla ma rnams kyi bla ma'i mchog /dam pa'i dam pa rnams kyi dam par 'dzin/ /bsod nams ye shes mthar phyin bstan pa yi/

/rgyal mtshan 'dzin mkhas 'dren mchog de yi sku/ /mgon de'i phyag nas 'khrul med mdzes byed 'di/ /'khon rigs btsun pa ngag gi dbang po yi/ /byin rlabs kun dga'i bsod nams mdzod 'dzin zhing / /grags pas yongs khyab bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs bzang po'i tshogs/ /rgyud la zhugs pa de yi dad pas 'bul/ /mkhas mchog khyed dang mtshungs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bkra shis gsol 'debs yid kyi 'dod 'jo bzhugs/96 na ma shrī wan gu ru ye/ bslu med dkon mchog rgya mtsho dang / /dbyer med rje btsun sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang rnal 'byor pa gdod nas rang grol gyis rang gi rig ma bsod nams chos kyi sgrol ma'i kha ton du myur bar bris zhes bskul ba'i rkyen byas nas yud tsam zhig la bris pa 'dis bskul ba po'i rgyud la bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs 'jug par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bshags pa'i tshigs bcad sgrib pa kun sel bzhugs/97 oṃ swasti siddham̐/ rten stobs bla ma dkon mchog drung / /sdig kun 'gyod sun drag pos bshags/ /phyin chad gnyen po kun spyod stobs/ /bgyis pas sor tshud stobs ldan shog /skyabs gnas bslu med mchog rnams dang / /dbyer med dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro/ /kun kyang lhar gsal mchod pas mchod/ /bdag gzhan lan chags kun byang shog /bdag la sngon las 'phral rkyen gyi/ /nad sogs mi 'dod gang byung ba/ /de yi mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sdig /dag nas rang gzhan bde thob shog /bdag gi 'brum bu'i mig skyon 'di'i/ /'gro kun mig nad 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /kun kyang rnam smin 'jug med shog /bdag mig sngar ltar gsal gyur cig /bdag gzhan dus gsum sdig kun bshags/ /rnam smin 'byung bar ma gyur cig /dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshor 'bul/ /tshogs rdzogs 'di phyi'i don 'grub shog

/ces pa'i tshig bcad lnga po 'di'i shlau ka phyi ma 'di la bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas maṇḍal 'bum ther dang stabs gcig par tshigs bcad 'di la yang 'bum ther zhig nged rang gis song yang / /gzhan rnams la sngon chad ma grub pas/ /skal bzang las 'phro can dag gis bdag gi sgrib pa sbyangs ba'i slad du/ /tshigs bcad gzhan rnams la yang 'bum ther re cis kyang mdzad pa zhu zhing / yon gyi snyed pa slad nas 'bul ba yang dgongs 'tshal/ zhes dge bskul dang bcas pa'i bshags pa'i yi ge nyung ngu 'di yang / chos med snyoms las mkhan sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ bya lo sa ka zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba dang po'i tshes la mgyogs par sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //smon lam bsam pa kun 'grub bzhugs/98 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ bdag gi 'brum bu'i mig skyon 'dis/ /'gro kun mig skyon 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /sgrib kun dag nas 'byung med shog /bdag mig sngar ltar gsal gyur cig /ces pa 'di'ang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che rnams la rjes su slob pa'i phyir dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang du yud tsam zhig la bris pa 'dis bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs/99 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /bstan 'dzin rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / rgyal ba mus pa chen po rnams gtsor bor smos pa'i/ rang la chos dang zang zing gi bskyangs pa'i bka' drin can rnams dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma sngags phyogs gtso bo la ngor rdzong rnam gnyis sogs dang / mdo phyogs gtso bo la g.yag rong / byams chen rab 'byams/ go shāka 'bum gsum sogs/

bla ma la/ gsol 'debs sdig pa ma lus bshags/ /don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /bdag la dmigs rten grangs med pa/ /byung ba'i tshe 'das thams cad kyi/ /sdig pa kun bshags kun byang nas/ /kun kyang bde ba can 'gro shog /bdag gis dus gsum sems can gyi/ /srog gcod sdig pa ci bgyis bshags/ /de dag bde ba can skye zhing / /bdag sogs 'gro kun der 'gro shog /bdag gis bstan 'gro'i don bsgrub phyir/ /dus gsum sdig pa thams cad bshags/ /dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /bdag gi lhag bsam nus mthu dang / /mkhyen brtse nus ldan skyabs gnas kun/ /gcig bsdus bla ma'i thugs rje yi/ /'di phyi'i don kun 'grub gyur cig /'di dag sngon chad rang gi kha 'don du/ thor bur bris mod kyang / /lhan cig bsdebs 'di chos grwa chen por 'gar/ /'dzugs pa'i slad du sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ ā nandas/ /dge 'phel ri bo'i spo mang mkhar tsha chu la phyin pa'i skabs zhig la gnas tshe sbyar/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag gi bsam pa ma lus pa yid bzhin du 'grub nas mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba ma lus pa zhing mchog bde ba can du 'dren nus par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// //gsol 'debs 'dod pa'i 'bras stsol bzhugs/100 /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /dbyer med kun dga' snying po la/ /bdag cag dpon slob sdig kun bshags/ /don kun 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba btab par bya'o/ /de bzhin du kun dga' snying po'i gnas su/ bsod nams rtse mo laྎ grags pa rgyal mtshan laྎ sa skya paṇa chen laྎ chos rgyal 'phags pa laྎ zhes rang gang mos kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma su yin gyi mtshan bcug nas gsol ba btab na rung ba nyid do/ /zhes pa'i gsol 'debs 'dod pa'i 'bras stsol zhes bya ba 'di yang rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mkhyen brtse nus ldan rnams kyi rnam thar dran pa'i mod la dad pa'i spu long rab tu g.yos te rang nyid kha 'don du bya ba'i slad du bzhi thog bla brang gi khang bzang bkra shis brtsegs par bgyis pa'i yi ge pa yang rang nyid lags so/

/'di'i bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/101 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /bstan 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag gzhan dus gsum gyis/ /sdig pa kun bshags kun kyang byang gyur cig /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba 'di yi mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don kun 'grub bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /phyi ma bde ba can du skye bar shog /skyes nas bsam bzhin srid pa len pa dang / /srid mtha'i bar du bstan pa 'dzin par shog /pha mar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyang / /bdag gis rjes bzung thar pa'i bde thob shog /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam 'di/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /log par 'dren pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal nas/ /ji bzhin ma lus legs par 'grub gyur cig /ces pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub ces bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ chos sde chen po 'ga' zhig tu 'dzugs pa'i slad du/ sngar rang gi brtsams pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam rnams nas yi ge nyung ngur bsdus nas sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi 'di phyi'i bsam don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs smon lam dang bcas pa'i rab tu byed pa dgos 'dod kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs/102 na mo buddha dhwa dza ye/ skyabs gnas bslu med rin chen dkon mchog gsum/ /mchog dang thun mong stsol mdzad yi dam lha/ /bar chad kun sel chos skyong nor lhar bcas/ /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

/bdag ni deng nas bzung ste byang chub bar/ /skyon med bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung zhing / /chos ldan blo mthun grogs dang skad cig kyang / /'bral ba med par bsam don kun 'grub shog /bdag cag dpon slob dus 'dir tshe ring zhing / /bsam don thams cad 'bad med lhun grub nas/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing du padmo las/ /brdzus te skyes nas sa lam mthar phyin te/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa sa skya pa rigs sngags 'chang ba ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsam don yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i smon lam btab pa 'di dag yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig de de bzhin du gyur cig de las gzhan du ma gyur cig thams cad bkra shis pa dang bde legs kyis khyab par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ ka lya na wardhantu// ༈ //bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs/103 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'phags pa 'jam dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rim par byon rnams dang / /yi dam zhi khro chos skyong nor lhar bcas/ /kun 'dus 'jam dbyangs mched dang mus pa rje/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol/ /bdag cag dpon slob mkha' mnyam sems can gyi/ /'phral dang yun gyi sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /thogs med dus nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib kun/ /snying nas 'gyod pa chen pos mthol lo bshags/ /bdag gi lus srog longs spyod dge ba rnams/ /mchod sprin rgya mtshor sprul nas khyed la 'bul/ bsod nams 'di yis don kun lhun grub ste/ /bstan pa rin chen mchog tu 'phel bar shog /bdag gis mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba rnams/ /bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i nus mthu yi/ /bdag dang lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ /bdag gi bsam pa ma lus mthar phyin shog

/don dam chos kun gnas lugs spros bral yang / /kun rdzob las 'bras bslu ba med rtogs nas/ /sngar byas sdig rnams bshags pas byang gyur te/ /phyin chad smon lam btab tshad 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis 'dir snang lugs gnyis kyi phun sum tshogs pa mthong ba'i tshe/ gang na 'byor pa de na rgud pa yod/ ces pa'i tshul gyi 'byor ba la rgud pa 'byung gis/ ma 'byor na de gnyis ka rgud pa yin pas ma 'byor ba la rgud pa zhes bya ba mi 'byung zhing / rgyu mtshan des na sngon bcom ldan 'das zhal bzhugs pa'i dus su yang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab tu chos nyan du phyin pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal po la chom rkun yong ba mkhyen bzhin du/ gsal rgyal la bcom ldan 'das kyis las 'bras kyi chos tshul rgya chen po bstan nas/ ha cang yun ring te nam sros nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi drung rgyal po'i khab nas gsal rgyal gyi phyir phyung ba dang / gsal rgyal la chom rkun gyis gnod pa byung bar bshad pa de lta bu ni bcom ldan 'das kyis chom rkun gyi gnod pa byung ba la mkhyen pa dang / de'i gnod pa zhi ba'i nus pa med pa ma yin yang / rgyal po gsal rgyal rang gi myong bar nges pa'i las myong bas mdzad pa la dgongs par gsungs 'dug pa mthong ba'i tshe/ las 'bras la yid ches khyad par can rnyed nas/ mdo sde las brgya pa las kyang / lus ngan rnams kyi bde sdug ni/ /las rnams yin par thub pas gsungs/ /las rnams kyang ni sna tshogs las/ /de yi 'gro 'di sna tshogs byas/ /sna tshogs rnam par 'khyams zhing 'jug /las kyi dra ba 'di che'o/ /zhes gsungs pa yang / yang nas yang du dran pa'i rkyen byas nas/ /sngar byas kyi las ngan rnams ci nas kyang bshags dgos par go zhing / bshags pa byas pas sdig pa nges par 'dag pa yang / bshes spring las/

gang zhig sngon chad bag med gyur pa yang / /phyi nas bag dang ldan par gyur de ni/ /zla ba sprin bral bzhin du rnam mdzes te/ /dga' bo sor phreng mthong ldan bde byed bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar na sngar byas kyi sdig pa rnams bshags nas/ deng phyin chad rang gzhan kun 'phral dang yun gyi bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pa'i smon lam gang btab kyang nges par 'grub pa yin te/ 'jam dpal zhing bkod las/ chos rnams thams cad rkyen bzhin te/ /'dun pa'i rtse la rab tu gnas/ /gang gis smon lam ci btab pa/ /de 'dra'i 'bras bu thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des na sngar byas kyi sdig pa bshags shing / yang dag pa'i smon lam 'debs pa ni shin tu skal ba bzang bar shes nas/ bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ byi lo zla ba bcu pa'i yar ngo'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i lha chen rigs 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis rang la bka' drin can a ma lags gshegs rjes cher gtad brtsams pa'i smon lam 'gro ba'i bsod nams ma zhes bya ba bzhugs/104 na mo gu ru sa ma ye/ 'gro ba'i bsod nams mthu las grub pa'i zhing / /yongs 'dzin dam pa rim gyis 'khrungs pa'i gnas/ /sar gnas byang chub sems dpa' 'du ba'i khang / /bde ba chen po'i gling la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang der mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri yi steng / /ljon shing dpag bsam rgyas pa'i rtsa ba na/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas 'od 'bar ba/ /grangs med 'phags pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag pos zin dang ma zin mchod pa'i tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul nam mkha'i khyon bkang ste/ /dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dad pas 'bul/

/dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med stsal du gsol/ /bdag gi byang chub bsgrub pa'i lus rten 'di/ /byin zhing lus stobs bskyed pa'i snying rje can/ /drin lan 'khor thabs med pa'i bka' drin can/ /dus las 'das pa'i bsod nams rgyal mo de'i/ /tshe grangs dpag med bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang / /mdor na byang chub bsgrub pa'i gegs gyur rnams/ /da lta nyid du thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /dri med ri bong can ltar mdzad du gsol/ /de ltar dri ma med pa'i thugs yid de/ /bde ba can zhes grags pa'i gnas mchog der/ /padmo dag las brdzus te 'khrungs gyur cig /sangs rgyas zhal mthong chos 'khor bskor ba dang / /yon tan gong nas gong du rab rgyas te/ /brgya phrag du ma 'gro don mdzad gyur cig /gal te zhing der re zhig mi 'khrungs na/ /mi lus rin chen thob cing chos dang mjal/ /dam pas rjes bzung man ngag mdzod ldan zhing / /'chi ba mi rtag rgyud la rab skyes te/ /rtse gcig bsgrub la brtson pa'i yon tan gyis/ /tshe gcig lus gcig sangs rgyas thob gyur cig /'chi kha'am bar dor smon pa med par shog /de lta'i yon tan rgyud la bar ldan nas/ /'khor bar 'ching ba'i gdul bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /gang la gang 'dul de la de bstan nas/ /thams cad smin grol lam la 'god gyur cig /bdag kyang dge ba'i phyogs la legs gnas shing / /rje btsun bslu med rnams kyi thugs rje las/ /tshe yi bar chad thams cad nyer zhi nas/ /lo brgya 'tsho bar byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ /bdag kyang 'chi ba mi rtag dran pa dang / /dal 'byor brnyed dka' 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs/ /dran zhing brtson 'grus lcag gis rab bskul te/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba blo yi thong ba dang / /dben gnas ri khrod zin zhing brten par shog /zang zing longs spyod nor la chags med cing / /rang nyid gcig pur rdo rje theg pa yi/ /zab pa las kyang ches zab gdams pa rnams/

/g.yengs ba med pa rtse gcig bsgom pa'i mthus/ /nang du rtsa mdud rim gyis grol ba dang / /rab dga' la sogs rim gyis myur bgrod nas/ /nam mkha' dag la bya bzhin 'phur bar shog /mdor na bdag gis dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba'i/ /lus 'di ma spangs byang chub 'grub pa dang / /pha mar gyur pa'i sems thams cad kyang / /bdag gis rjes bzung thar pa'i bde thob shog /bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i smon lam 'di/ /dkon mchog rnams kyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ /log par 'dren pa'i phyogs las rnam rgyal nas/ /ji bzhin ma lus legs par 'grub gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni 'khon rigs shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis rang la bka' drin che ba'i a ma lha sras bsod nams rgyal mo zhes bgyi ba glang lo cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo glo bur du gshegs nas bco lnga la spur rtags byung ba nas bzung ste zhag nyer gcig pa nas bdun tshigs gsum pa'i thog tu bzhi thog blang brang gi mkha' spyod du drin can a ma snying nas dran zhing myur bar bris pa 'dis drin can a mas gtso byas sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ/ tshe las 'das pa'i drin can a ma de nyid/ bar do'i 'jigs skrag kun las legs grol nas/ /bde ba can zhes grags pa'i gnas de ru/ /da lta skad cig nyid la 'khrungs gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang gong gi rtsom pa pos smras pa'o// ༈ //gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bzhugs/105 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /bka' srung rnams kyi mthu stsal gyis/ /bstan 'dzin rigs brgyud 'ga' myur du/ /'byung bar gsol 'debs byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis sems can gyi don rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i phyir/ skyabs gnas bslu med rnams la yid ches gdeng khel gyi blo bcos ma ma yin pa'i ngang nas rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa'i phyir bris pa'o/

/'dis bsam pa yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /thams cad bkra shis// ༈ //bshags pa dang smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa re ba kun 'grub bzhugs/106 na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bdag gis dus gsum sems can gyi/ /srog gcod sdig pa ci bgyis bshags/ /de dag bde ba can skye zhing / /bdag sogs 'gro kun der bgrod shog /ces pa'i bshags pa dang smon lam re ba kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang sa skya pa ā nandas srog gcod kyi sdig pa dran pa'i mod la shin tu myur bar bris pa'i dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams la srog gcod kyi rnam smin gyi sdig pas gos par ma gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsol 'debs kyi yi ge ci bsam lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/107 /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma rje dang rten mchog rnams/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pas mchod/ /dpon slob sdig kun byang gyur cig /'di phyi'i bsam don kun 'grub shog /ces pa 'di ni sbrul lo dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang chen mo'i yangs rtser sngar med pa'i gtsug lag khang khyad par can/ li ma lha khang rdo rje gdan du mtshan gsol ba dang / rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lngar mtshan btags pa gnyis gegs med du legs par grub pa'i tshe/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs la gdan sa khyad par can 'dir rgya dkar nag gi lha khang zhig byung na dgongs pa'i thugs kyi lhag ma rim par lus pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi thugs rjes rang gi lag tu long pa 'di nged rang dpon slob rnams skal ba bzang por shes pa'i dga' spro dang / rje bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa'i mod la sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi kha 'don gyi slad du sbyar ba 'dis bdag gzhan kun la phan bde bsam mi khyab par 'byung bar gyur cig /ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //smon lam re ba kun 'grub bzhugs/108

oṃ swasti siddham̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i zhing / /sa skya paṇa chen byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas/ /mngon dga'i zhing du bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /tshe 'di 'phos ma thag tu skye bar shog /de nas bde ba can sogs sa skya pa'i/ /rje btsun gong ma bzhugs pa'i dag pa'i zhing / /mang du bgrod nas spangs rtogs myur rdzogs te/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /ces pa'i tshigs bcad 'di chos rgyal ma 'don re bzhin lan re ma chag pa smon lam btab na rang gzhan kun la phan nges pa'i ltas cung zad zhig byung nas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mang mkhar chu tshan du mgyogs par sbyar ba/ sa skya pa'i dgon che chung rnams kyi bla ma grwa bu slob dang bcas pa'i thugs la 'jog pa zhu/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //rje tshar chen yab sras kyi sku gdung la gdung tsha btab pa'i grangs dang dngul gdung dang sku 'dra rin po che bzhengs pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad bzhugs/109 /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ rje tshar chen gyi gdung tsha btab pa la/ mchod dgu ma nyis brgya dang gsum/ mi 'khrugs pa skye tshang gcig tu bzhugs pa bcu/ gzhan ma chig rkyang gsum/ tshe dpag med chung gras stong ra can gcig dang bcu bdun/ che gras bco lnga/ bzhugs khang gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gong ma lnga tshar bco lnga/ slob dpon padma'i sku bco lnga/ sngags 'chang yab sras/ rje mus chen/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams skye tshang gcig tu bzhugs pa bcu gcig 'od dpag med bzhugs khang gcig tu bcu tshar re bzhugs pa bco lnga ste 'od dpag med kyi sku brgya dang lnga bcu/ 'jam dbyangs sku bcu gcig mchod rten brgya rtsa ma bdun rnams byung ba phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis dang dge legs kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig/ ༈ //oṃ swasti/ rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa chos rje sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /'khon rigs sngags 'chang kun dga' ming can gyis/

/rin chen dngul gyi mchod 'di'i sku rgyu la gser zho lnga bcu nga brgyad/ dngul khal gcig lhag tsam dngul chu zho nyis brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ zangs khal bcu gnyis dang nyag lnga song / rten ngo mtshar 'di/ /bzhengs pas mtshon pa'i dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma dad ldan 'od zer mtha' yas sogs/ /dpon slob kun kyang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /phan tshun ngo shes thugs yid gcig 'dres te/ /skad cig nyid la spangs rtogs mthar phyin nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ grub mchog sngags 'chang rje ta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gdung tsha btab pa la/ tshe dpag med lnga brgya dang bcu gcig 'jam dbyangs sku bco lnga/ slob dpon padma'i sku bco lnga/ bzhugs khyim gcig gi nang na bzhugs pa'i 'od dpag med bco lnga ste yongs bsdoms sku brgya dang lnga bcu/ skye tshang gcig tu bzhugs pa'i gong ma lnga tshar gsum/ sngags 'chang yab sras/ rje mus chen/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags rnams bzhugs khyim gcig tu bzhugs pa tshar gcig mchod rten brgya rtsa ma bcu gcig yang tshe dpag med kyi sku che ba lnga bcu nga lnga rnams byung ba phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis kyi dpal 'bar bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //oṃ swasti/ nus mthu'i mnga' bdag sngags 'chang ta ra ba/ /bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs dang mkhas pa'i rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen chos kyi rje'i/ /sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan ngo mtshar 'di/ /'khon rigs sngags 'chang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /mi phyed dad pa chen pos nyer bskul nas/ /bzhengs pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/

/mthar thug gyur nas bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma dad ldan 'od zer mtha' can sogs/ /dpon slob kun kyang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /phan tshun ngo shes thugs yid gcig 'dres te/ /skad cig nyid la spangs rtogs mthar phyin nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ /dge legs 'phel/ ka lya na wardhantu// //shar chen nor bu'i phyi skor bzang spyod du song gi grangs smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs/110 /bya lo nas bzung gro bzhin gyi yar tshes lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor yan la/ phyi skor stong phrag bdun dang / drug brgya dang / bdun cu don gcig song lags/ bzang spyod khri tsho bzhi dang stong phrag gnyis/ brgya dang bdun cu don bdun rnams song lags/ ༈ /dad ldan nor bus dpal ldan sa skya la/ /phyi skor stong bdun drug brgya don gcig dang / /bzang spyod khri bzhi stong gnyis brgya don bdun/ /sngon chad song dang phyis kyang ci song mthus/ /ngag dbang kun bsod dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /phyi ma dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms sa lam kun/ /myur du bsgrod nas sprul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /sa skya'i bstan pa srid mthar rgyas byed shog /ces kyang ā nandās smras so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub bzhugs/111 /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma sogs/ /rgya bod mkhas grub ji snyed dang / /mchog gsum rten gsum bgrang yas sogs/ /bsod nams zhing gyur ci mchis la/ /bdag gzhan zhing rdul lus gyur nas/ /phyag mchod sdig bshags skor ba bskor/ /sgrib byang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /sprul pas bstan pa rgyas byed shog /bdag gzhan dus gsum sdig kun bshags/ /kun byang rnam smin 'byung med shog /dge tshogs mchod sprin rgya mtshor 'bul/ /tshogs rdzogs 'di phyi'i don 'grub shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam bsam pa lhun grub ces pa 'di yang sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gzhan gyi 'di phyi'i don chen po sgrub pa'i phyir yud tsam zhig la sbyar ba'o/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// //gsol 'debs bsam pa myur 'grub bzhugs/112 oṃ swasti siddham̐/ bdag gi lus kyi nad rnams kyis/ /'gro kun nad kun 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /kun byang rnam smin 'byung med shog /bdag lus nad med bde gyur cig /ces pa 'di rang lo nga bdun lon pa'i dus sgyu lus nad kyis yun ring mnar ba'i tshe/ bla ma dkon mchog la khyed shes khyed mkhyen gyi tshul du/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis gsol 'debs bgyid pa'i slad du sbyar ba 'dis bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// //phar tshad brgyud 'debs kha skong yod/113 /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ phar tshad brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong nged rang gis sngar byas pa de'i rjes su 'di ltar sbyar bar bya ste/ sngags 'chang bla mas yang srid du ma ru/ /rjes su bzung bas dus 'dir skyes chen des/ /gsar du spel ba'i bstan pa rin chen gyi/ /rgyal mtshan mchog tu 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /gang gi rnam dpyod blo gros 'od stong gis/ /thub bstan lha yi khang bzang ngo mtshar che/ /gsal mdzad rim gnyis bsam gtan nor gyis phyug /bstan pa'i rgya mtsho che la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sbyar bar bya ba'i tshigs bcad gnyis po 'di yang chos med a nandas yud tsam zhig la bris pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mkhas pa dga' byed ces bya ba bzhugs/114 na maḥ shrī dharmā ra dza puṇya int+ra kirti ma ti buddha dhwa dza sa ma ye/ rab 'byams chos kun nam mkha'i mtshan nyid las/ /rnam pa kun du g.yo bar mi 'gyur kyang / /thog med bag chags dbang gi skal snang la/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje yan lag bdun ldan skur/ /legs bzhengs kun khyab 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs/

/'phags pa'i yul gyi so ma pū ri ru/ /dmar ser zhes pa me mo sbrul la bltams/ /rnam byung sa 'brug lo la dngos grub brnyes/ /so wa na thar 'gyur med rtag bzhugs pa'i/ /'khrul zhig dpal ldan chos skyong la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mchog rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs su/ /snyan brgyud gdams pa zab mo'i mdzod 'dzin phyir/ /bsam bzhin mi yi gzugs su sprul mdzad nas/ /u tsa ya nar kun ldan mchog brnyes pa'i/ /grub chen karṇa'i mtshan laྎ 'byor lnga'i sa rtsigs dbang gi yul gyi dbus/ /gang der bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad la/ /dgongs nas legs bskrun don gnyis mthar phyin zhing / /kan pa gling du gsal stong ngang la bzhugs/ /grol mdzad ḍā ma ru pa laྎ rgya gar wa ra ṇa si zhes grags par/ /legs 'khrungs dam pas rjes bzung zab don la/ /rtse gcig gzhol bas gnas lnga'i mchog gyur rig /mkha' 'gro rdzong du chos gnyis zung 'jug tu/ /'dres mdzad gnyis spangs chen po laྎ 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas mchog shar gyi phyogs/ /der 'khrungs gnas lnga kun la thogs pa med/ /dad ldan spro ba bskyed phyir 'od kyi tshul/ /kha rag thod bur kun gyi mngon gyur mdzad/ /mkhas grub ratna shrī laྎ bod yul kha ba can gyi mang mkhar du/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse bsdus nas mgon khyod bskrun/ /skad gnyis smra ba kun gyi rgyan gyur zhing / /mu gu lung du gzugs sku chos dbyings thim/ /lo chen shākya ye shes laྎmdo smad phyi 'brum gnas su sku 'khrungs shing / /zab lam g.yel med ngang nas skal ldan la/ /rgyud dang man ngag phyogs kun rab rgyas mdzad/ /mkhar chung gnas su zhing gzhan gshegs tshul bstan/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun rig laྎ gtsang gi sag thang zhes grags gang de ru/ /grangs med 'gro ba'i bsod nams mtha' bral las/ /mgon khyod bltams nas gdul bya'i bsam pa kun/ /tshim mdzad sag thang ding du bde bar gshegs/ /sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zhang stonྎ

dkar snum seng ge'i gdong 'dra'i gnas kyi phur/ /aṃ gir zhes pa chu pho sprel lor bltams/ /sa stag re bdun bar du gzhan don mdzad/ kha gdangs gnas su bkod pa rnam bzhir bstan/ mtshungs med kun dga' snying po laྎ dpal ldan sa skya'i gzim spyil dkar po ru/ /rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi lo 'khrungs/ /chu stag zhe gcig bar du zhing 'dir bzhugs/ /chu mig gnas nas mkha' spyod yul du gshegs/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams rtse mo laྎ yon tan 'byung gnas de yi mgon khang mdor/ /rab byung zhes pa me mo yos lo bskrun/ /me byi bdun cu'i bar du gzugs sku bzhugs/ /mgon khyod bskrun pa'i gnas der gzugs sku thim/ /sngags 'chang grags pa rgyal mtshan laྎ gnas mchog gang de'i spyod yul phug zhes par/ /dge byed ces pa chu pho stag lo byon/ /lcags phag bdun cu'i bar du re ba bskangs/ /sprul sder gshegs shing rgya bod mkhas kun gyi/ /gtsug rgyan sa skya paṇa chen laྎ byang phyogs stag sde rlung khung zhes grags pa/ /myos byed ces pa shing mo lug lo la/ /sku bltams lcags 'brug zhe drug bar bzhugs shing / /lha khang lho ru grub mtha' brnyes tshul bstan/ /'phags mchog blo gros rgyal mtshan laྎ ra sa mtshal khung zhes pa'i gnas mchog der/ /kun ldan zhes pa lcags pho byi lo 'khrungs/ me lug re brgyad bar du lam bzang spel/ /bod yul dbus kyi skyed 'phrang zhes su gshegs/ /yongs 'dzin ratna shrī laྎ dam pa de nyid 'khrungs pa'i gnas gang der/ /dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang lo la/ /legs bskrun lcags stag don bzhi'i bar du bzhugs/ /na bza' brag phug dgon par chos dbyings thim/ /grub brnyes bsod nams dpal ba laྎ zha lu khang gsar zhes su yongs grags der/ /yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi lo bltams/ /shing yos re bzhi'i bar bzhugs don gnyis phyin/ /bsam yas dkar por gshegs pa'i puṇya mtshan/ /bstan pa'i sgron me chen po laྎ

'bras khung sgang skya zhes pa'i yul nyid du/ /dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya lo'i steng / /sku 'khrungs sa yos re bdun bar bzhugs nas/ /shar stod gnas su gzhan don la gshegs pa'i/ /mtshungs med dpal ldan tshul khrims laྎ mdog gi sgo phur myos ldan zhes bya ba/ /sa mo yos lo la bltams zhing 'di ru/ /lcags byi gya gnyis bar du zhabs pad brtan/ /gzhi dgon gnas su rtags 'dzin snang ngo ru/ /bde gshegs buddha shrī laྎ bod yul rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa der/ /rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi lo la/ /legs 'khrungs snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi mar gyur/ /me byi don lnga'i lo la e waṃ du/ /dbyings thim rgyal ba'i lung brnyesྎ byang phyogs thub bstan gsal byed kun gyi brgyan/ /bde ba can gyi dgon pa 'debs bzhed de/ /rnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug lo'i dus/ /gling skyar bltams shing lcags stag gya gsum la/ /bsam gtan phur gshegs mus chen laྎ sa yi kha dog dkar mdangs bkra ba'i char/ /khro mo zhes pa shing 'brug lo 'khrungs nas/ /sa byi nga lnga'i bar bzhugs byams gling du/ /zhing 'di'i gdul bya rdzogs nas khams gzhan gyi/ /don dgongs kun dga' dbang phyug laྎ smad phyogs mdo khams 'bom gyi la steng su/ /zhi ba zhes pa sa mo bya lo la/ /ngo mtshar ltas bcas bskrun nas sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pa rgyas mdzad sa bya re gcig steng / /sngon mo rdzong gshegs kun mkhyen laྎ gu ra zhes bya gdan sa'i shar phyogs su/ /khro mo zhes pa shing mo glang lor bltams/ /shing khyi bdun cu'i bar bzhugs e waṃ rtser/ /thun mong snang ba'i sku yi bkod pa bsdus/ /bla chen dkon mchog 'phel ba laྎ /rgyal ba mus pa chen po 'khrungs/ /pa'i yul/ /gling skyar dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya'i/ /lo la sku 'khrungs shing sprel don gnyis la/ /bde ba can nas bde ba can gyi zhing / /der gshegs buddha ratna laྎ yon tan tshogs 'byung shrī rtse gdong gi

/phun tshogs gling du sna tshogs dbyig ces pa/ /shing mo sbrul gyi lo la sku btsas nas/ /chu sbrul zhe dgu'i bar du bstan pa spel/ /rin chen sgang gshegs sgra bsgyur laྎ sa skya lo tsā 'khrungs pa'i sa phyogs der/ /dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi lo/ /bltams nas snyigs dus bstan pa'i srog shing mchog /shing sprel re brgyad bzhes tshe sa skyar gshegs/ /sngags 'chang dharmā ra dza laྎ sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i yangs steng su/ /don 'grub ces pa sa mo lug lo bskrun/ /deng sang 'dren pa kun gyi rgyan gcig pu/ /'khrul pa'i dri mas ma gos sa skya pa/ /drin can puṇya ind+ra la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /rnam thar brjod dang gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ /skye ba kun du mtshan ldan bla ma yi/ /brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnyed dka'i lus dang 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ /rgyu 'bras chos sogs snang gsum khrid kyi don/ /legs par shes nas tshe 'di'i bya ba la/ /rtag tu zhen chags med par byinྎ rnam dag dbang gi cho ga las thob pa'i/ /mnyam rjes bza' bsrung mi 'bral dam tshig rnams/ /'bad rtsod drag pos srung sdom nus pa dang / /nyes ltung dri ma med parྎ gsal stong zung 'jug rgyu yi lhan skyes dang / /bskyed rdzogs ye shes lam gyi ye shes che/ /sprul chos longs sku 'bras bu'i lhan skyes rnams/ /dbyer med sems nyid rtogs parྎ rmi lam yul gyi snang ba ji snyed pa/ /snang mkhan sems las logs na med pa ltar/ /las nyon bag chags brtas pa'i phyi rol gyi/ /snang ba sems su rtogs parྎ sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta glang rnams/ /snang tsam nyid nas ngo bos stong pa ltar/ /rang sems 'khrul pa'i snang ba sna tshogs pa/ /snang stong sgyu mar rtogs parྎ sa bon mi rtag myu gur 'pho min yang / /myu gu mi chad skye bar snang ba ltar/ /chos kun skye med dbyings las skye bar snang /

/rten 'brel zab mo rtogs parྎ longs spyod rlabs kyi bde ba myong ba ltar/ /sems dang sgyu ma rten 'brel 'gal med du/ /nyams su myong yang yod med las 'das pa'i/ /brjod bral gnas lugs rtogs parྎ dngos kun byed po gzhan med sems nyid snang / /snang tsam rang stong sna tshogs rkyen gyis skye/ /skye med las skyes 'gag med nyams su myong / /myong stong brjod med rtogs parྎ 'khor 'das tshangs ba kun gzhi rgyu yi rgyu/ /smin grol nyams myong zung 'jug thabs kyi rgyud/ /lhun grub gnas 'gyur 'gal med 'bras bu'i rgyud/ /dbyer med lta ba rtogs parྎ sku yi rdo rje sprul sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /sgro 'dogs yongs gcod phyi yi bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs shing bum dbang stsol ba dang / /bskyed rim lam bzang gomྎ ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba rtogs pa dang / /'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha' bsnyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' bsnyog par ma nus na/ /gong nas gong du 'pho ba theb par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma theb na/ /lha sems dbyer med bar do'i gdam ngag la/ /brten nas rigs 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub te/ /sprul sku mngon du 'gyur barྎ gsung gi rdo rje longs sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /rang byung ston mdzad nang gi bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs shing gsang dbang stsol ba dang / /gtum mo'i lam bzang goms parྎ rang byung rnam bzhi'i lta ba rtogs pa dang / /ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' bsnyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' bsnyogs par ma nus na/ /'od gsal dbyings su 'pho ba theb par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma theb na/ /gsal la rtog med bar do'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas rigs 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub te/ /longs sku mngon du 'gyur barྎ thugs kyi rdo rje chos sku'i ngo bo nyid/ /lhan skyes ston mdzad gsang ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs shing sher dbang stsol ba dang /

/pho nya'i lam bzang goms parྎ lhan skyes dga' bzhi'i lta ba rtogs pa dang / /bde stong chung ngu'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na/ /rdor sems byon pa'i 'pho ba theb par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma theb na/ /lhan skyes bde ba bar do'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas rigs 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs 'grub te/ /chos sku mngon du 'gyur barྎ snying po rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku'i dngos/ /de nyid ston mdzad mthar thug bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs shing bzhi pa stsol ba dang / /rba rlabs lam bzang goms parྎ shin tu rnam dag lta ba rtogs pa dang / /bde stong chen po'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /tshe 'dir grub mtha' snyogs par ma nus na/ /phyag chen lam nas 'pho ba theb par shog /gal te 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ma theb na/ /bde stong mchog ye bar do'i gdams ngag la/ /brten nas rigs 'dzin mkha' spyod sogs grub te/ /bde sku mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mdor na rten dang brten pa gnas gyur gyi/ /sku lnga lhun grub zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang / /che ba gsum ldan bdag gi legs thob nas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro la chos 'khor bskor bar shog /'gro kun nges 'byung tshul khrims rnam dag cing / /brtse dang byang sems gnyis su med blo ldan/ /gsang chen lam gyi rim pa mthar phyin te/ /sku dang ye shes 'phrin las rgyas par shog /mdor na lam gyi rtsa ba dbang dang 'brel/ /lam gyi dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs nyams len rgyas/ /lam gyi snying po brjod bral lta ba mtho/ /lam mchog 'di 'bras myur du smin par shog /ces gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam thar mdor bsdus dang sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mkhas pa dga' byed ces bya ba 'di ni snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po puṇya ind+ra dang / sems dpa' chen po sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang /

rje btsun mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan ste 'brel tshad don ldan gsum gyi rjes su bzung zhing snying nas dad pa thob pa sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar so so la shin tu 'dris par byas nas rang lo bco brgyad lon tshe dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por bris pa 'di re zhig rdzogs so/ /rnam dag dbang gi cho ga las thob pa'i/ /zhes pa nas/ lam mchog 'di 'bras myur du smin par shog /ces pa'i bar 'di sar gnas byang sems kyi gsung du 'dug pas 'don pa rnams la byin rlabs che bar 'dug snyam tshig rigs cung zad bsgyur ba ma gtogs snyigs dus sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i sgron mer gyur pa shrī e waṃ pa chen po dkon mchog lhun grub kyis gsung bzhin bris pa yin no/ /yang smras pa/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig gdan sa cher/ /dmar ser zhes pa me mo sbrul lo'i dus/ /legs 'khrungs yongs rdzogs bstan pa cher rgyas mdzad/ /me sbrul re gcig bzhes tshe e waṃ gshegs/ /kun mkhyen dkon mchog lhun grub la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan 'dzin du ma byon pa'i gnas gling skyar/ /rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta lo 'khrungs/ /me khyi don bdun lo la chos grwa che/ /bde ba can nas gzhan don gshegs par mdzad/ /'dren mchog ratna'i mtshan can laྎ phun tshogs 'byung gnas byang phyogs sa yi char/ /dge byed ces pa chu pho stag lo la/ /sku bltams mkhas btsun bzang po'i mchog gyur cing / /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag bka' drin can/ /mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa 'di yang gong gi brgyud 'debs kyi kha skong du rtsa ba'i rtsom pa po de nyid kyis sbyar ba'o/ /gong gi brgyud 'debs kyi/ /sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po man chad dor nas 'di dag kyang rung mod/ 'on kyang gnyis ka byas na legs pas de ltar byed na kha skongs 'di rnams 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po'i gsol 'debs kyi rjes su bya'o//

༈ //dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim nyams su len tshul smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba bzhugs/115 na mo gu ru shrī kā la tsakra ya/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal mchog khyab bdag chos sku rdo rje 'chang / /longs spyod rdzogs pa dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ /sprul sku mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /shambha la yi chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogs/ /dam pa'i skye bu dus zhabs rnam pa gnyis/ /kha che'i paṇa chen zla ba mgon po la/ /gsol baྎ mkhas pa chen po 'brom ston lo tsā dang / /lung rtogs mnga' bdag lha rje sgom pa ba/ /'gro ba'i mun sel rnams brtsegs chen po la/ /gsol baྎ zab mo'i don gzigs grub chen yu mo ba/ /gang de'i thugs sras dharme shwa ra dang / /mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' 'od zer la/ /gsol baྎ mkhas pa'i phul phyin 'jam gsar sher 'od dang / /kun mkhyen chen po chos sku 'od zer zhabs/ /zhang ston kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus la/ /gsol baྎ byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba ye shes dang / /mkhas btsun chen po yon tan rgya mtsho ba/ /dus gsum kun mkhyen dol po sangs rgyas la/ /gsol baྎ chos kyi rgyal po phyogs las rnam rgyal dang / /mtshungs med nyang dbon chen po kun dga'i mtshan/ /grub pa'i sar bzhugs kun dga' blo gros la/ /gsol baྎ 'jam dpa'i dbyangs dngos dkon mchog bzang po dang / /snyigs dus dus 'khor bstan pa'i gsal byed mchog /rgyal sras lo chen ratna bha dra la/ /gsol baྎ grub chen spyod pa'i rdo rje gangs can 'dir/ /dge slong tshul 'chang kun dga' grol mchog zhabs/ /rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag shes rab rin chen la/ /gsol baྎ phyi ltar gsum ldan dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/

/nang ltar dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /dbyer med ngo bo spyan snga rin chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /don gnyis mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /de gsung sdug bsngal zhi byed dam pa'i chos/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub mdzad 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams/ /dbyer med bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi/ /gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal rang bzhin can/ /ji ltar byas kyang bde ba'i skal med pa'i/ /'khor ba chu shing snying po med 'dra la/ /zhen log gting nas skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ /shin tu rnyed dka'i dal 'byor lus 'di nyid/ /thob pa'i dus na phan bde kun grub cing / /myur du 'jig phyir brtson 'grus drag po yis/ /yengs med dam chos bsgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad mi dge'i rgyun las byung / /dge bas 'di phyi'i bde skyid ma lus 'grub/ /'dres ma'i las kyi 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ /sdig spongs dge la brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di'i pha mas drin gyis bskyangs pa bzhin/ /'gro drug sems can 'di rnams bdag gi ma/ /yin par nges nas drin lan bde ba dang / /bde ba'i rgyu la 'god par byin gyis rlobs/ /bde ba 'dod cing sdug bsngal rgyu la 'bad/ /snying nas bskul kyang chos la mi 'bad par/ /gzhan la 'khang pa'i ma rnams snying re rje/ /sdug bsngal de yi rgyu dang bral gyur cig /grangs med 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i pha ma rnams/ /thar med srid pa'i btson ra las bsgral te/ /bla med byang chub gnas su 'god pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor nyams su blangs bar bgyi/ /spyi bor he ru ka las bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /nye bar babs te lus kyi nang gang bas/ /dam tshig nyams chags dri ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /myur du byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen khri steng du/ /padma zla nyi sgra gcan dkyil 'khor dbus/
