/sangs rgyas kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /sna tshogs 'od 'phros bdag la dges bzhin bzhugs/ /lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge tshogs 'bul/ /yi ge bzhi las 'od 'phros dbang bzhi bskur/ /sgrib pa bzhi bcom rdo rje bzhi ldan pa'i/ /sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rang lus tha mal mi dmigs 'od gsal ngang / /dang po'i sangs rgyas lhan cig skyes pa'i sku/ /'khor 'das chos kun de bzhin nyid du thim/ /bskyed rim rtogs pa rab kyi mthar phyin shog /lus kyi byed bcings mi g.yo gsum ldan pa'i/ /sems kyi bzhag thabs bzhi la mnyam par gzhag /nyin mtshan rnal 'byor gnyis kyi tha mal pa'i/ /yul dang yul can so sor bsdud par shog /'khor lo bsgyur ba'i lta stangs la gnas nas/ /stong pa'i gzugs brnyan brtan phyir bsam gtan gyi/ /yan lag lnga ldan rtse gcig legs bsgom pas/ /sku yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /rdo rje'i bzlas pas rtsa rlung lam sbyangs te/ /'jam rtsub rlung gi dbu mar gzhug cing bcings/ /btsan thabs sbyor bas nyi zla'i lam bkag nas/ /dus me'i gnas su rlung sems chud gyur cig /de nyid rim bzhin brtan pas thur sel dang / /srog rlung 'dres pa 'khor lo lnga yi dbus/ /steng 'og 'dren pas thig le mi 'gyur 'dzin/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /dman pa 'bring dang mchog gi gnas skabs su/ /phyag rgya gsum la kunda dbab cing bzung / /rang lus 'od 'phros stong gzugs rjes dran pas/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /byang sems ma nyams gyen du drangs byas nas/ /dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon gyur gtsug tor gyi/ /gnas su 'gyur med bde ba'i ting 'dzin rdzogs/ /ye shes rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /yan lag drug po re re'ang sgra don dang / /bsgom pa'i dus mtshams bsgom tshul legs shes nas/

/rtags tshad mthar phyin dag bya dag byed dang / /'bras bu mngon du 'gyur bar gyis rlobs/ /de lta'i lam mchog ston pa'i bla ma rnams/ /phyi nang gsang bas mchod pas mchod bgyid cing / /lus ngag yid kyi sdig pa so sor bshags/ /rnam dkar dge la yi rang phyogs kun du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing 'gro ba'i don/ /rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' brtan bzhugs nas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas sems can thams cad la/ /thugs rje'i spyan gyi kun du gzigs su gsol/ /bdag kyang skye dang skye bar zab mo'i lam/ /mchog gi rnal 'byor 'di dang mi 'bral zhing / /nyams dang rtogs pa brtan phyir spyod pa dang / /nye rgyu'i mtshams sbyar sa rnams bgrod par shog /'chi med tshe dang dpal 'byor phun tshogs nas/ /phyogs bcur chos kyi rgyal mtshan rab bsgrengs te/ /phan bde kun 'byung rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /myur du bdag gzhan 'gro bas thob par shog /ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa lam rim nyams su len tshul smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'phrin las mkha' khyab ces bya ba 'di yang dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen pa theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren pa dam pa spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan kun dga' don grub kyis zhal snga nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i smin grol gyi lam yongs su rdzogs pa nos pa'i tshe/ yud tsam zhig la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i bzhugs khri padma can gyi drung du sbyar ba'o/ /lam rim kyi tshig bcad 'di rnams ngag 'don pa rnams la byin rlabs che bar bsam nas sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rab las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa yin no/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag thob pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs/116

rgya gar skad du/ badzra ya na mo ga nutta ra sya margad mu la gu ṇa ratna ka ra: shrī he ru ka badzra buddha dhwa dza ye na maḥ bod skad du/ rdo rje theg pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i lam gyi rtsa ba yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas dpal ldan khrag 'thung kyai rdo rje sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal ldan birwa pa'i thugs kyi nying khu/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rim par byon pa rnams kyi thugs dam nyams bzhes kyi gtso bo gsung ngag rin po che'i lam 'bras dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag ces yongs su grags pa 'di nyid thob pa'i gang zag rnams kyi rang rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba gdab cing smon lam bya bar 'dod pas 'di ltar brjod de/ yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi yi skur/ /ma dag gdul bya'i don du legs sprul nas/ /rnam dag chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa'i/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes la gsol ba 'debs/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje/ /bshes gnyen rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun nyer bsten nas/ /dam chos rgya mtsho legs par 'chad mkhas pa'i/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas khyed la 'dud/ /mkhyen rab rta bdun dkyil 'khor rab rgyas pas/ /bdag blo rmongs pa'i mun pa rab bcom nas/ /dam chos snang ba'i chog rab spel mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla mar rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgya rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi legs gsungs shing / /phan bde rgya mtsho'i gzhi dang rten gyur pa'i/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho rgyas phyir mgon po khyod/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor bzhugs pa gsol ba 'debs/ /rnam dkar dkar ba'i las bzang las grub pa'i/ /dal 'byor 'byor ba bcu ldan thob dus 'dir/ /yongs 'dzin 'dzin mar byon pa dkon khyod la/ /dam chos chos bzhin bsgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul/

/de las dge ba rgya mtsho gang thob des/ /srid pa rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i 'gro kun gyi/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' dag zhi ba'i phyir/ /bde ba rgya mtsho'i don 'di 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag sogs 'gro kun tshe rabs thams cad du/ /khyed kyi thugs rjes mi khom gnas spangs nas/ /mtho ris bdun ldan dal 'byor lus thob ste/ /dri med bde gshegs bstan la 'jug par shog /yongs 'dzin thugs rjes chu gter las 'ongs pa'i/ /bslab gsum nor bu'i phreng bas lus mdzes shing / /rnam dag thos dang bsam pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /mkhas mang dbus su chos sgra sgrog par shog /sdig pa'i grogs dang log 'tsho rab spangs nas/ /gangs ri'i mgul dang ri sul nags 'dab sogs/ /rgyal bas bsngags pa'i dben gnas dam pa ru/ /'gro la phan phyir bsgrub la brtson par shog /mdo rgyud rgya mtsho bsrub pa'i snying po'i don/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug man ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bka' srol dri ma med/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ldan bdud rtsis 'tsho bar shog /bslu med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs song nas/ /thun mong theg pa'i nyams len snang ba gsum/ /theg chen byang chub sems kyi rtsis zin pas/ /dbang gi snod gyur bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /ma bcos lhun grub dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi la/ /mtshan ldan bla mas dbang bzhi rab bskur bas/ /sku bzhi'i sa bon nus ldan legs thob nas/ /rmad byung lam bzhi'i snod du 'gyur bar shog /zab rgyas dbang gi rgya mtsho las 'ongs pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa nor bu'i phreng ba mchog /nyams chags nyes pa'i g.ya' yi ma gos pa'i/ /byang chub bar du bdag lus mdzes par shog /sum cu rtsa bdun dpe yi legs mtshon nas/ /yul snang sems dang sems snang sgyu mar grub/ /sgyu ma rten 'brel brjod bral legs goms pas/ /zung 'jug lta ba rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bag chags 'khrul pas bslad pa'i tha mal gzugs/

/snod bcud 'khor ba'i snang ba ji snyed kun/ /gsang chen theg pas thabs mkhas kyis sbyangs pas/ /lha dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo 'char bar shog /ma bcos skyon med rdo rje lus kyi rtsa/ /lha ru bsgom pas bdag rgyud byin brlabs te/ /snang stong gnyis 'dzin sgro 'dogs gsum chod nas/ /ngo bo nyid gsum lta ba rtogs par shog /zab rgyas rlung sbyor bdun gyi rten 'brel gyi/ /rlung rnams nang log gtum mo'i me sbar bas/ /phyi rol phyag rgya'i lus la ma ltos pa'i/ /rang byung rnam bzhi'i lta ba rtogs par shog /tha mal chags sogs zhen pas ma gos pa'i/ /'du shes gsum ldan thabs mkhas la brten pa/ /mtshan ldan phyag rgya bsten pa'i yas babs kyi/ /dga' bzhi lhan skyes lta ba rtogs par shog /lus ngag sems kyi rba rlabs gsum bsgom pas/ /thabs shes gnyis ka'i rgyud gsum dag pa'i mthus/ /ro rkyang gzung 'dzin rba rlabs gnyis rang pa'i/ /shin tu rnam dag lta ba rtogs par shog /mdor na tha mal rnam rtog lha ru bsgom/ /de nyid rdzogs pa'i rim pas thabs mkhas kyis/ /bde chen ye shes nyid du bsgom pa'i mthus/ /'dus pa gsum gyi lam rnams mthar phyin shog /slar yang sprul pa'i sku las dbang blang pas/ /byang chub yan lag bdun dngos 'khor lo bzhi/ /ro rkyang dbu ma dang bcas bdun mthong nas/ /brgya phrag bdun sogs yon tan rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nang rtags rlung gi rgyu ba sor drug 'gag /phyi rtags gsang gnas lte snying thig les bstan/ /'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha' mtshon pa yis/ /rab dga' la sogs sa drug mngon gyur shog mtshan dpe dpal 'bar longs skur dbang blang pas/ /dbang po lnga yi rang bzhin dwangs ma lnga/ /yi ge'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas legs mthong nas/ /sna tshogs 'gro ba'i skad bzhin dam chos ston/ /nang rtags rlung gi rgyu ba sor bcu 'gag /phyi rtags lung spyod 'khor lo thig le bstan/

/ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' mtshon pa'i sa/ /bdun pa la sogs rnam bzhi mngon gyur shog /zag med sgrib bral chos skur dbang blangs pas/ stobs lnga'i rang bzhin rlung lngas bskyed pa yi/ /byang sems bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas/ /mngon par shes dang rdzu 'khrul thogs med ldan/ /nang rtags rlung sor bcu gnyis tshad du 'gag /phyi rtags spyi gtsug hril gyis thig les bstan/ bde stong chung ngu'i grub mthas mtshon pa yi/ /dpe med ye shes chen po mngon gyur shog /kun khyab ngo bo nyid skur dbang blang pas/ /'phags lam brgyad dngos tshogs brgyad mngon gyur nas/ /sa chen rnam drug g.yo zhing bdud gnas 'jig /dbang phyug brgyad sogs yon tan rgyan gyis mdzes/ /nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhu tir 'jug /phyi rtags gtsug tor phyed du thig les bstan/ /bde stong chen po'i grub mthas mtshon pa'i sa/ /bcu gsum phyed kyi rtogs pa mngon gyur shog /bdag dang spangs rtogs 'dod pa mnyam pa yis/ /phyag rgya'i bha gar rtsa rlung byang chub sems/ /mchog tu dang po'i rdo rje slob dpon la/ /dbang bzhi blangs pas 'gros bzhi thim par shog /dus gsum rgyal ba'i bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ /legs par goms pa'i sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /gsung gsum dbyer med 'khor lo gsum ldan pa'i/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang dbang thob par shog /'bad rtsol med par smon lam bzang po'i mthus/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag rnams bzhi'i thabs mkhas kyi/ /'gro kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba yis/ /gru chen 'dzin pa'i ded dpon rgyal por shog /mdor na sdug bsngal ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /don med 'jig rten bya bas ma bcings par/ /dam chos tshol la gcig tu brtson pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa'i khur chen khyer bar shog /ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sum cu rtsa gcig po 'di ni/ rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru rnyog pa med pa yan lag mchog gis gus pas blangs pas thugs rje'i spyan ras kyis bu gcig pa ltar 'tsho ba shrī sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon gyi mkhas pa chen po dag gi gsung rab rnams nas legs bshad kyi cha blangs te/

'gal ba dang ma 'brel ba'i skyon spangs shing kha skongs cung zad dang bcas te bsdebs pa'o/ /'dir smras pa/ phyogs kun mthong ba'i dpyod ldan skye bo dag /phyogs 'di slob dang rnam 'grel bcu gcig sogs/ /phyogs med rtogs la the tshom yod ma yin/ /rang gi gzhung lugs sna re mi shes pas/ /ngan dus byon pas gong mas gsungs so zhes/ /gsang sngags zab mo'i don rnams dkrugs pa 'di/ /long bas long ba khrid dang mi mtshungs sam/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i don la blo rgyas pa'i/ /mkhas pas bstan pa spel ba thabs kyi dgag /dpyod ldan bshes gnyen rgyun du dmod cing spongs/ /blun po bkur bstis bstan pa 'dzin nus sam/ /yongs 'dzin mkhas par bzung bar ma gyur zhing / /gsung rab rgya mtsho blta ba'i skal med 'ga'/ /tshig gcig shes la 'dis chog rgya che yang / /dgos 'dus bslu zhes mkhas mchog gzhan dag la/ /thabs kyi dmod na shes par khas len pa'i/ /don de'ang ji ltar yin zhes dris pas gsal/ /thos med bsgom de khe nyen gang che soms/ /sngon tshe gong mas drag po'i las sbyor rnams/ /'bad med 'grub de dbang thob dam tshig ldan/ /chos skyong rnams kyi rjes gnang dbang khrid lung / /legs thob las tshogs rab 'byams lag len bcas/ /mkhyen zhing bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin mdzad pa las/ /byung ba yin gyis skye bo mang po dag /lhan cig 'dus pa'i mgrin pa'i sgra skad dang / /rol mo'i drag brdungs tsam gyi 'grub pa min/ /ding sang rmongs pa 'ga' zhig rol mo dang / /sgra skad bzang bas chos skyong 'khu ba la/ /the tshom med snyam sems 'di gad mo'i gnas/ /des na rjes gnang tsam yang ma thob dang / /dam tshig yod med sna tshogs lhan cig tu/ /las sbyor bsgrub 'di khe nyen gang che som/ /'di dag bla mas mdzad na drangs don te/ /phal pas byed na bstan la gnod par go /blang dor tshul bzhin mdzod dang dpyod ldan rnams/

/yang smras pa/ rkyen ngan med tshe thos bsam bsgom pa kun/ /ji bzhin rgyud la 'byor par gyur lags kyang / /rkyen ngan byung tshe gang yang mi dran pa'i/ /nyon mongs can la bla mas thugs rjes gzigs/ sngon dus dpon dang mdza' bshes nye 'brel kun/ /chos mthun zang zing med kyang bu ltar skyong / /deng sang nor med mtho dman kun gyis spongs/ /mgon skyabs med la bla mas thugs rjes gzigs/ /rang sems sdug bsngal drag pos brdungs pa'i tshe/ /blo ldan grogs kyis de dag bsal nus kyang / /rtag tu blun po'i gros kyi cher bskyed pa'i/ /grogs med sdug bsngal las skyobs chos kyi rje/ /chos mthun bgyis na mthun rkyen gser bas dkon/ /chos min byas na dgos 'dod char ltar 'bab/ /'on kyang bdag ni chos min bgyid mi 'tshal/ /bsam don 'grub par mdzod cig rin po che/ /chos kun sems yin sems kyang skye ba med/ /kun kyang rten 'brel gshis lugs brjod dang bral/ /de phyir mnyam rjes kun du bde stong gi /rol pa chen po'i ngang la lhan gnas par/ /byang sems rdo rje buddhas byin gyis rlobs/ /bag chags 'thug pos rtog pa cher 'phel tshe/ /bum can rlung gi sbyor ba la 'bad cing / /lta ba bskyangs pas rtog med la goms nas/ /da lta ngan rtog rgyud chad med pa 'di/ /ngang gi bye nyung 'gro bar 'gyur snyam sems/ /skal ldan las can yod na bsgom mdzod dang / /kho bos ngag tshig bden rdzun rjes su shes/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs/117 /na mo gu ru shrī mahā kā la ye/ rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /bram ze mchog sred bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shardha ka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i mal lo blo gros grags/

/mtshungs med sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga/ /dam pa kun grags bdag nyid chen po dang / /nam mkha' legs pa rnams laྎ dkon mchog dpal dang chos rje bsod nams pa/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs/ /shar chen ngor chen mus chen rgyal tshab rje/ /kun mkhyen yongs 'dzin rnams laྎ 'gro mgon bla mas rjes bzung kun rgyal ba/ /'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya gar shes bzang mtshan/ /sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chos rje dang / /'jam dbyangs sku mched rnams laྎ dpal ldan rgyal po spyan tshab tshul khrims bzang / /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal ldan bkra shis mtshan/ /lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /spyan snga 'jam dbyangs rnams laྎ sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / /paṇa chen de nyid sras dang slob mar bcas/ /'jigs rung gaṇḍe 'dzin pa'i mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams laྎ yar lung pa dang mkhan chen rgyal mchog pa/ /'jam dbyangs chen po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /rdo ring pa dang tshar chen mkhyen brtse ba/ /dbang phyug rab brtan rnams laྎ don grub rgyal mtshan chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / byams pa rab brtan snying rje bzang po'i zhabs/ /bsod nams chos 'phel ngag dbang chos grags dang / /spyan snga chos rje rnams laྎ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos sa skya paṇḍi ta/ /gangs can 'gro ba'i dpal du slar byon pa'i/ /sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /rgyal ba'i yab gcig bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /rnam snang pho brang rdo rje gdan la sogs/ /rgya bod mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas rnams su/ /bzhugs nas bstan dgra'i srog dbugs la dgyes pa'i/ /phyi yi chos skyong rnams kyis bdag srungs shig /rtsa gsum 'khor lo byang sems rlung gi dngos/ /gzung 'dzin dgra bo'i gshed ma lhan skyes kyi/ /ye shes bde chen mgon po'i sar 'khrid pa'i/ /nang gi srung mas rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /phyi nang sgyu 'phrul dregs pa'i zlos gar kun/

/rang sems gsal stong brjod bral blo 'das kyi/ /rol par shes pas snang srid rgyud gsum gyi/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i gsang ba'i mgon pos skyong / /de ltar phyi yi dregs pa rgyud gsum la/ /rnam drug rten dang gtor ma gsum la sogs/ /bsham nas bzlas brjod bskangs bshags bstod bskul gyis/ /mnyes par byas pas 'phrin las kun 'grub shog /lus la grub pa'i nang gi rgyud gsum po/ /dmigs rim zab mo'i byang sems dbab bzlog dang / rlung sbyor bzlas pa'i sngags kyis rgyud bskul bas/ bde chen mgon po'i 'dzum zhal mthong bar shog /gsal stong zung 'jug gsal ba'i rgyud gsum de/ /brjod bral blo 'das mchod pas dges byas nas/ /tshe 'dir sems nyid rtog med chos sku dang / /lus nyid 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog /de 'dra'i 'bras bu tshe 'dir ma thob na/ /'chi ba 'od gsal zhes bya'i sgra bo che/ /yang yang 'phrad pa'i mdza' bo de mthong bas/ /ngo shes nang gi 'pho bas grol bar shog /der yang 'khrul nas bar dor 'khyams gyur na/ /bla ma bstan srung rnam 'phrul bgrangs yas kyi/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs mchod sprin bcas/ /ming nas lung ston mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /ci ste las kyis mngal sgo 'grims srid kyang / /lus rten bla ma chos sogs mthun rkyen kun/ /bka' srung rnams kyis 'bad med legs bsgrub nas/ /ring por ma thogs rnam grol mchog thob shog /ces gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor gyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bsam don kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis/ rta lo zla ba dgu pa'i dmar cha'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod pho brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub bo/ 'di bgyis dge bas bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi chos skor yongs rdzogs sogs rang gi thob pa'i dbang lung man ngag rnams rigs dang chos las skyes pa'i bu rnams la legs par 'phrod cing /

srid mtha'i bar du chos rgyun rnams mi nub cing dar ba'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/118 /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma dang rdo rje nag po chen po dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /bram ze mchog sred bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shardha ka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i mal lo blo gros grags/ /'gran bral sa skya'i bla chen gong ma lnga/ /dam pa kun grags bdag nyid chen po dang / /nam mkha' legs pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dam pa bla chen kun dga' rgyal/ /'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya gar shes bzang mtshan/ /sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chen po dang / /'jam dbyangs mched sku rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /yar lung pa dang mkhan chen bsod rgyal ba/ /'jam dbyangs chen po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /rdo ring kun spangs tshar chen chos kyi rje/ /mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal ldan rgyal po spyan tshab tshul khrims bzang / /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal ldan bkra shis dang / /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rgyal ba mus pa rje/ /sangs rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /don grub rgyal mtshan chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / /byams pa rab brtan snying rje bzang po pa/ /bsod nams chos 'phel ngag dbang chos grags zhabs/ /spyan snga chos rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas dus kun rgyud rgyal ke la sha /zhes sogs gur gyi mgon po'i lam rim gyi smon lam tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhin bya'o/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel ces bya ba 'di yang /

sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi zur 'chad chos rje gser gling pa byams pa kun dga' shākya rdo rjes bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so/119 /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ya/ bla ma dang rdo rje nag po chen po dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje mar/ /bram ze mchog sred bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shardha ka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i mal lo blo gros grags/ /mtshungs med sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma la/ snying po rtse mo/ rgyal mtshan gyi mtha' can gsum ste/ /dam pa kun grags bdag nyid chen po dang / /nam mkha' legs pa mkhas btsun chen po/ rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /bla ma dam pa bla chen kun dga' rgyal/ 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya dkar shes bzang mtshan/ /sa skya lo tsā sngags 'chang chen po dang / /'jam dbyangs sku mched rnamsྎ bkras lung dge sdings pa dang sangs rgyal dpal/ /rin chen gling pa dkar gshong rin rdor ba/ /theg chen chos rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal/ /mkhan chen khrom yon rnams laྎ brag thog dpal 'dzin rdo rje gdan pa che/ /kun dga' rnam rgyal chag lo chos rgyal dang / /ngag gi bdag chen/ dbang phyug thugs sras kun dga' rgyal/ /tshe dbang bkra shis rnams laྎ yar klung pa seng rgyal/ pa dang mkhan chen rgyal mchog pa/ /'jam bdag chen/ dbyangs chen po bdag chen rdo rje 'chang / /rdo ring pa dang tshar chen mkhyen brtse ba/ /dbang phyug rab brtan rnams laྎ

dpal ldan tshul khrims buddha shrī dang / /rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che/ /rgyal tshab kun dpang grub chen kun blo dang / /ratna wardha rnams laྎ sngags 'chang gzungs dpal dge legs dpal bzang dang / /zur ban shākya dpal dang a nanda/ /mus srad rdo rje rgyal mtshan sgyi chu ba/ /shes rab rin chen rnams laྎ dpal ldan rgyal po mnga' ris pa/ spyan tshab tshul khrims bzang / mus chen sems dpa' chen po/ /sangs rgyas rin chen dpal ldan bkra shis mtshan/ /lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub dang / /spyan snga 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rnams laྎ buddha singha nam mkha' dpal bzang dang / /paṇa chen de nyid sras dang slob mar bcas/ /'jigs rung gaṇḍe 'dzin pa'i mus pa rje /sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams laྎ don bod/ grub rgyal mtshan spyan snga/ chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / /byams thub bstan mkhan chen/ pa rab brtan snying rtse gdong mkhan po/ rje bzang po'i mtshan/ /bsod rta ra ba/ nams chos 'phel ngag dbang chos grags dang / /spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ chos rje rnams laྎ phyi ltar sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen/ /nang ltar chos 'khor srog shing nag po che/ /gsang ba gdod ma'i mgon po sa skya pa/ /kun ngag dbang / dga'i bsod nams/ mtshan can rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs lam rim kyi smon lam tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhin bya'o/ /deng nas dus kun rgyud rgyal ke la sha /snyan brgyud tsha zer gyis bral gdams pa'i rgyun/ /ma dros chu klung las 'ongs bka' babs bzhin/ /zab don bdud rtsis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /dben pa'i dur khrod nags tshal yid 'ong bar/ /drug ldan rten gyi tshogs rnams legs bshams shing / /rnam gsum dmar chen gtor mas phyur bur gtams/ /phyi nang mchod pas bstan srung mnyes byed shog /rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dam rdzas dang /

/rab zab bskyed dang bsad pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcas/ /zab gsal ting 'dzin ma nor gsang ba'i sngags/ /rtse gcig 'bad pas bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin shog /thub bstan mchog dang bstan 'dzin 'joms pa'i dug /ma rig nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas pa/ /bdag gi mngon spyod drug po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /bskrad gzir bsgral te chos dbyings sbyor bar shog /deng nas bsgrub kyang don rung tshe 'di'i ched/ /bor nas rgyang ring dben pa'i ri sul du/ /bse ru'i rnam thar rjes su dran byas nas/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i lam mchog bsgom par shog /nang gi sreg byed rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga/ /dbab bzlog bdud rtsi'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /rlung sbyor rdo rje'i sngags kyi rjes bzung nas/ /zag med bde chen mgon po 'grub par shog /gsal stong zung 'jug gdod ma'i rgyud gsum po/ /spros bral blo 'das ngang du bsgrub pa yis/ /sgrib gnyis 'khrul pa'i dra tshogs drung phyung nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon 'gyur shog /go 'phang mchog de tshe 'dir ma thob kyang / /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi nag po che/ /ring nas 'grogs pa'i mdza' bo nyams dga' de/ /mthong ba'i mod la dbyer med 'gyur bar shog /der kyang 'khrul nas bar do shar gyur nas/ /bla ma mchog dang dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /yid 'ong mchod sprin gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs/ /ming nas lung ston mkha' spyod khrid par shog /mdor na deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ rje btsun bla ma gtsug gi nor bur bzhugs/ bka' srung chos skyong lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin dpal la spyod par shog /khyad par grub mchog rje btsun sa skya pa/ /gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud zhal gdams su/ /byon pa'i bstan srung nag po'i snyan brgyud rnams/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir ches cher rgyas gyur cig /mthu chen nag po'i stobs dang gzi brjid dang /

/'dod khams lha mo'i brtse gdung drag shul dang / /bka' nyan pho nya'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis /bkra shis dpal gyis bdag cag ring du skyong / /zhes sogs lam rim gyi smon lam tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa bzhin bya'o/ /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor yongs rdzogs kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba 'di yang / sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi zur 'chad chos rje gser gling pa byams pa kun dga' shākya rdo rjes bgyis so/ /'dis bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa bzhugs/120 oṃ swasti/ rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin/ zag med bde ba'i gar bsgyur rdo rje gur/ grub pa mchog gi ded dpon bram ze che/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yul dbus rnal 'byor mkhas pa bde ba'i mtshan/ /paṇa grub dbang po dad byed go cha'i zhabs/ /gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me lo tsā ba/ /snying nasྎ sngags 'chang nus pa mthar phyin brag steng pa/ /skad gnyis smra ba'i mkhas grub blo gros grags/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug brtse chen sa skya pa/ /snying nasྎ 'ja' lus mkha' spyod rol mdzad bsod nams rtse/ /grub rigs rgya mtsho'i rje btsun bla ma rje/ /gangs khrod mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇḍi ta/ /snying nasྎ dregs ldan gtsug gi legs mchod 'phags pa'i mtshan/ /'jigs rung gaṇḍe 'dzin pa kun dga' grags/ /mkhas grub rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bzang po dpal/ /snying nasྎ mthu stobs bdud rtsis myos pa'i nam mkha' legs/ /srid gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i chos kyi rje/

/snyan brgyud mnga' bdag bla chen kun rgyal ba/ /snying nasྎ rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po yar lung pa/ /de sras thu bo bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /padma'i rnam sprul 'jam dbyangs nam mkha'i mtshan/ /snying nasྎ rdo rje 'chang dbang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun rdo rje ring pa/ /dngos grub mchog stsol rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /yang na bla chen kun dga' rgyal ba'i rjes su/ /rab yangs blo gros nam mkha'i ngos la rol/ /snyan brgyud bzhi ldan rin chen khang bzang du/ /nyams rtogs bdud rtsi'i dpal la 'dod dgur spyod/ /mthu stobs rgyas mdzad srid mthar grags la 'dud/ /rgyud rgyal dmar po dpa' bo gar dgu ldan/ /kha ba can ljongs sa chen kun snying zhes/ /slar yang zhing 'dir snyan brgyud smra ba'i mchog /bdag chen rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes gcig bsdus he ru ka /skal bzang thub bstan skyong phyir srin po'i gzugs/ 'dzam gling chos kyi nyi ma kun spangs rje/ /dpal ldan bka' drin mtshungs med zhabs la 'dud/ /rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun rdo ring pa'i/ /snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor bya bral ba/ /shes ldan gzu bor gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /mang thos ngur smrig gos can de la 'dud/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos blo gsal rgya mtsho yi/ /thugs kyi byin rlabs snyan brgyud nor gyi phyug /skal bzang 'gro la phan bde kun stsol ba'i/ /rje btsun mai tri pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /bstan la rab dad gzhon nu rab tu byung / /dam pa'i thugs zin snyan brgyud gdams pa thob/ /rim gnyis lhur len skal ldan smin grol mdzad/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /deng nas dus kun rgyud rgyal ke la sha /snyan brgyud tsha zer gyis bran gdams pa'i rgyun/ /ma dros chu klung las 'ong bka' babs bzhin/

/zab don bdud rtsi'i bdag rgyud tshim par shog /dben pa'i dur khrod nags tshal yid 'ong par/ /drug ldan bstan gyi tshogs rnams legs bsham zhing / /rnam gsum dmar chen gtor mas phyur bur gtam/ /phyi nang mchod pas bstan srung mnyes byed shog /rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i dam rdzas dang / /rab zab bskyed dang bsad pa'i 'khrul 'khor bcas/ /zab gsal ting 'dzin ma nor gsang ba'i sngags/ /rtse gcig 'bad pas bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin shog /thub bstan mchog dang bstan 'dzin 'joms pa'i dug /ma rig nag po'i rtsa lag sder bcas pa/ /bdag gi mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyis/ /bskrad gzir bsgral te chos dbyings sbyor bar shog /deng nas bsgrub kyang don chung tshe 'di'i ched/ /bor nas rgyang ring dben pa'i ri sul du/ /bse ru'i rnam thar rjes su dran byas nas/ /rdzogs rim zab mo'i lam mchog bsgom par shog /nang gi dregs byed rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga/ /dbab bzlog bdud rtsi'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /rlung sbyor rdo rje'i sngags kyis rjes bskul nas/ /zag med bde chen mgon po 'grub par shog /gsal stong zung 'jug gdod ma'i rgyud gsum po/ /spros bral blo 'das ngang du bsgrub pa yis/ /sgrib gnyis 'khrul pa'i dra tshogs drung phyung nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon gyur shog /go 'phangs mchog de tshe 'dir ma thob kyang / /'chi ba 'od gsal don gyi nag po che/ /ring nas 'grogs pa'i mdza' bo nyams dga' bo/ /mthong ba'i mod la dbyer med 'gyur bar shog /des kyang 'khrul nas bar dor shar gyur nas/ /bla ma mchog dang dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /yid 'ong mchod sprin gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs/ /ming nas lung ston mkha' spyod 'khrid par shog /mdor na deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /rje btsun bla ma gtsug gi nor bur bzhugs/ /bka' srung chos skyong lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs/

/rim gnyis ting 'dzin dpal la spyod par shog /khyad par grub mchog rje btsun sa skya pa/ /gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud zhal gdams su/ /byon pa'i bstan srung nag po'i snyan brgyud rnams/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir ches cher rgyas gyur cig /mthu chen nag po'i stobs dang gzi brjid dang / /'dod khams lha mo'i brtse gdung drag shugs dang / /bka' nyan pho nya'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /bkra shis dpal gyi bdag cag ring du skyong / /zhes dpal rdo rje nag po chen po'i brgyud pa'i rim pa'i gsol 'debs phyi nang gsang ba'i lam gyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni/ thog mar rang nyid la rtsom pa'i blo yod pa dang / khyad par mdo khams stod pa bla ma grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bskul ba'i ngor/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos bsten pa'i bya bral ba dpal sa skya'i bla brang shar gyi yangs rtser sbyar ba 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //gong gi chos rje rdo ring pa'i rjes su/ gang de'i thugs sras blo gsal rgya mtsho las/ /snying nasྎ bla ma mgon pos rje bzung mai tri'i mtshan/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med spyan snga rin chen la/ /snying nas sogs 'gre/ zhes pa 'di chos rje tshar pas mdzad pa'i mgon po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skong du sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku'i rnam sprul gdon mi za ba spyan snga rin po che byams pa ngag dbang kun dga' don grub kyi drung du sa skya pa'i chos skyong che chung gi chos skor rnams rdzogs par nos dus myur ba nyid du bris pa'o/ /lha brgyad gsang khrid kyi brgyud pa la tshar chen gyi rjes su/

rigs gnas kun mkhyen mkhyen dbang po yi zhabs/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po byams pa rab brtan pa/ /mgon de'i rjes bzung snying rje bzang po la/ /snying nasྎ sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po tshul khrims 'bar/ /phyi rab ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa zhes/ /dus 'dir spyan snga byams pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /snying nas gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di yang gong gi kha skongs stsom pa pos bgyis so/ /bkra shis// ༈ //dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs/121 swasti pra dza bhyaḥ rgyal ba kun 'dus khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan 'dzin grub chen ba liṃ ta/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ /'jam dpal rjes bzung sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ /paṇa grub dam pa mar me mdzad bzang po/ /grub pa'i dbang po rje btsun shrī su kha/ /gsol baྎ mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan bi ma la gupta/ /bram ze'i btsun pa rin chen rnam pa gnyis/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ri sul rnal 'byor ma/ /gsol baྎ lo chen dam pa dpal ldan dar ma grags/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug sngags 'chang kha'u pa/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan sa skya pa/ /gsol baྎ bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs/ /rdo rje 'dzin dbang rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan/ /mkhas pa'i dbang po sa skya paṇḍi ta/ /gsol baྎ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/ /mgon po'i rnam 'phrul dam pa kun dga' grags/ /bdag nyid chen po bha dra shrī'i zhabs/ /gsol baྎ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal/ thugs sras dam pa bzang po rgyal mtshan pa/ /gsol baྎ rwa lo gnyis pa mkhas grub dge rgyal ba/ /sngags 'chang chen po rje btsun sangs rgyal mchog /mtshungs med dam pa skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal/ /gsol baྎ skyes mchog chos rje'i sras kyi thu bo pa/

/zhing skyong bran du skol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma drin can mdo khams pa/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs/ rnam gsum sngon 'gro'i rim pa bsgom pa yis/ /sdig ltung dri ma'i tshogs kun sbyongs ba dang / /rlabs chen bsod nams gong du 'phel byas nas/ /lam mchog bsgom pa'i snod du rung bar shog /'khor lo rnam lnga'i yig 'bru'i spro bsdu yi/ /nang gi dam can rgya mtsho yab yum rnams/ /zag med bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /bdag la nye ba'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin shog /rtsa gsum lha lnga'i rnam par gsal byas shing / /gnyen po rnam lnga'i gnad la mkhas gyur pas/ /zag med bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes byas nas/ /bdag la nye ba'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin shog /rtsa gsum lha lnga'i rnam par gsal byas shing / /gnyen po rnam lnga'i gnad la mkhas gyur pas/ /srid gsum mthu stobs bsdus ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /las su rung ba'i sgrub pa mthar phyin shog /e dbyings sde brgyad dbus su bsgrub bya'i gzugs/ /lus la zhing skyong bkod pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ rtsa dral khams gsol rnam shes 'phrogs pa yis/ /ma lus bstan dgra'i tshogs rnams 'joms par shog /stong nyid bu mo'i snying dbus nyi zla'i nang / /gsal dwangs lha lngatsha bsil gyis gdung pas/ /ma bzod bde chen sgyu ma'i gar g.yo zhing / rab 'byams las kun thogs med 'grub par shog /gnas mchog rang byung rdo rje lus kyi nang / /rang bzhin lhun grub mkha' 'gro'i gsang gnas su/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams 'dus pa yi/ /skad cig yang la 'bral ba med par shog /sems nyid rang bzhin mgon por shes pa dang / /de nyid rdo rje'i lus la tshangs ba dang / /phyi rol dregs pa'i gzugs su shar ba yi/ /gnas lugs rtogs pas 'bad med 'grub par shog /mdor na deng nas rang sems bla ma dang / /chos skyong dbyer med dag pa'i ngang zhig nas/

/snyan brgyud rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs bye ba brgyas/ /bstan dang skal ldan skyong bar bdag gyur cig /ces shrī tsa turmu kha'i gsang sgrub kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs khrid kyi rim pa'i smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni/ zhing skyong dges pa'i rnal 'byor pa blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos kha'u'i brag rdzong nag po'i ru 'dren gyi pho brang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa'i gsang sgrub kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyi kha skongs lcags bsgom pa'i rjes su/ swasti/ dpal ldan nag po gnyis pa tshar pa rje/ /mgon des rjes bzung mkhan chen chos rje'i zhabs/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa nam mkha' chos dar la/ gsol baྎ sngon tshe chos kyi rgyal po tshul khrims 'bar/ /phyi rab ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa zhes/ /dus 'dir spyan snga byams pa kun dga'i mtshan/ /gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud gyis rlobs/ /zhes pa 'di sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ lo nas spyan snga rin po che'i drung du tsa turmu kha'i chos skor zab la rgya che ba nos dus sbyar ba'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ/ ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs/122 /na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rje btsun mus pa chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun rdo rje chos dang gsang ba'i bdag /sa ra ha dang klu sgrub sha wa ri/ /lū hi pa dang dha ri ka pa'i zhabs/ /rdo rje dril bu rus sbal 'bar ba 'dzin/ /nag po spyod pa gu ru rnam rgyal zhabs/ /ti lo nā ro pham thing sku mched dang / /klog skya mal lo brtse chen sa skya pa/

/rje btsun sku mched sa skya paṇa chen dang / chos rgyal 'phags pa zhang ston dkon mchog dpal/ /brag phug pa dang 'gro mgon chos rje'i zhabs/ /dpal ldan tshul khrims ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / /rdo rje 'chang dang mus chen sems dpa' che/ /mnga' ris paṇa chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhabs/ /grub chen dkon blo buddha ratna dang / /sa lo sngags 'chang chos rje grags pa'i mtshan/ /sangs rgyas dpal bzang dpal ldan rgyal po'i zhabs/ /bzang po dpal dang paṇa chen nam dbang mtshan/ /rje btsun chos dbang rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /'khor lo sdom pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so mkha' spyod 'og min nas/ /ye shes spyan gyis 'bral med skyab du gsol/ /bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bsam don kun 'grub ste/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bstan pa spel bar shog /sbyin bya dbang bzhi'i yongs su smin byas te/ /nyams su blangs bya rim gnyis bsgom pa'i mthus/ /tshe 'dir drod thob spyod pas mtshams sbyar nas/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /ces dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rje btsun mos pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan las/ dpal sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu 'khor lo bde mchog lū nag dril gsum nā ro mkha' spyod dang bcas pa'i dbang byin rlabs bskyed rdzogs kyi zab khrid rgyud dang rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i bshad lugs sogs/ mdor na rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i bka' drin nos pa sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi kha 'don du dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang du sug bris bgyis pa 'dis rang gzhan gyi don gnyis 'grub par gyur cig

/sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i chos skor gyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/123 /rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan gu ru badzra ā tsarya mahā tsa sam wa ra ḍā ki sa mu dra ye na maḥ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje slob dpon chen po dang bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gsum dbyer med zung 'jug bde ba che/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi gtso/ /dus gsum kun mkhyen khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /gsang gsum 'khor lo'i mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal dbang dges mdzad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal sras kun gyi gtsug rgyan spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul blo gros rin chen te/ /rgyal dang dbyer med gsum laྎ bde mchog grub dbang tshul 'dzin sha wa ri/ /bde chen don gzigs mai tri gu pa ta/ /bde gshegs gnyis pa rgya gar phyag na ste/ /bde stong mchog brnyes gsum laྎ zab mo'i don rtogs ka ma la badzra/ /zab chos mnga' bdag grub chen dza se na/ ya'i mtshan/ /zab yang blo ldan lo tsā dar ma grags/ /zab don mthar phyin gsum laྎ rdo rje 'chang dngos sa skya'i rje btsun dang / /rdo rje rnon po sa skya paṇa chen zhabs/ /rdo rje'i thugs mnga' skyo ba dpal bzang ste/ /rdo rje gsum dngos gsum laྎ rigs grol brgyad ldan chos kyi dbang phyug dang / /rigs gnas mthar phyin lo tsā mchog ldan zhabs/ /rigs pa smra ba gzhon nu tshul khrims te/ /rigs kyi nus ldan gsum laྎ 'jam pa'i dbyangs mtshungs tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / 'jam dpal mi yi gzugs 'dzin ngag dbang rje/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje byang chub seng ge ste/ 'jam mgon bla ma gsum laྎ chos kyi spyan ldan sa bzang 'phags pa dang / /chos kun mnga' bdag ngor chen rdo rje 'chang / /chos zab gter gyur rje btsun sems dpa' che/

/chos kyi dbang phyug gsum laྎ mkhas par rab grags gung ru shes bzang dang / /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan kun mkhyen go ram rje/ /mkhas mchog byas 'gyur bsod nams seng ge ste/ /mkhas btsun bla ma gsum laྎ shes bya kun mkhyen paṇa chen nam dbang zhabs/ /shes bya'i don gzigs kun dga' legs grub dang / /shes byar blo rgyas kun dga' chos grags te/ /shes bya mthar phyin gsum laྎ 'khor lo'i 'dren pa nam mkha' chos dar dang / /'khor lo sdom pa spyan snga kun dga'i don 'grub/ mtshan/ /'khor lo'i khyab bdag sngags ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gsum laྎ de ltar skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma dang / /dbyer med 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs la/ /snying nas gus pa chen pos gsol 'debs kyi/ /'di phyi bar do kun tu thugs rjes gzigs/ /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung ste/ /ches zab mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du/ /smin byed dbang gi bdud rtsi thob par shog /'khrul ngor snang ba'i ma dag snang ba kun/ /lha sngags ye shes rol par legs bsgom pas/ /dngos kun 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ gsal bar shar nas bskyed rim mthar phyin shog /sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i man ngag la/ /brten nas rdzogs rim rtogs pa mngon gyur te/ /'khor 'das bsre ba'i spyod pa la brten nas/ /phyi dang nang gi sa lam kun bgrod shog /gangs khrod rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog /dpal ldan grags pa'i zhabs la bka' babs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i smin grol lam bzang 'di/ /srid mtha'i bar du rgyun mi chad par shog /bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa yis/ /bdag gzhan 'di phyi'i bsam don ma lus pa/ /bdag yid re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces bdag mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i chos skor gyi dbang gi bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa byin rlabs kyi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba 'di yang /

spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi sku'i rnam par sprul pa lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don 'grub kyi drung du/ lugs 'di'i smin byed kyi dbang gi bka' drin nos pa'i tshe/ gdub bu'i zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bcu/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje dgongs pa chos dbyings su mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshul bstan pa'i dus dran gyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i nyin shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bzhi thog bla brang du legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkra shis don grub kyis bgyis so/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// ༈ //dkar bdud gyi bstod pa dge legs phun tshogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/124 bhyo: dpal gyi bstan skyong ma mo ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ /sku mdog dkar la 'od ldan zhing / /phyag gnyis ri rab gling bzhi'i brel/ /gser dang rin chen sna tshogs pas/ /rnam par brgyan zhing nyi zla yis/ /dbu brgyan sku yi do shal byas/ /sna tshogs dar dang khyad par du/ /gangs dkar mdog can sham thabs gsol/ /zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs/ /me rlung dbus na rab tu brjid/ /dpal ldan dkar mo khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ bdud rnams kun gyi rgyal po ni/ srin po'i gzugs can ma rung pa/ /bdud rta la zhon glog ltar 'khyug /lcags mdung thod phreng lag na bzung / dar nag mi lpags na bza' gsol/ /rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /rang 'dra brgyad sogs 'khor gyis bskor/ /bstan pa'i dgra bo'i gshed ma ste/ /bdud rgyal nag po 'khor bcas bstod/ /don la chos kun spros bral yang / /rnam pa rang sems 'khrul snang gi /dam can srung ma'i thugs 'gal bar/ /sems kyis bdag 'dzin mthol lo bshags/ /nyams chags thams cad dag gyur cig /thun mong dngos grub 'bad med du/ /char ltar phob cig srung ma'i tshogs/

/mchog gi dngos grub bdag cag gis /tshe 'dir thob par mdzad du gsol/ /ces pa 'di ni sa skya pa shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang kun dga'i ming can gyis bris nas bzhi thog bla brang gi dkar mo nyi zla'i mgon khang dngos grub gling zhes bya bar dar dkar la bris nas phul ba yin/ /ka lyā na wardhantu// ༈ //rang gzhan gyi don du bris pa'i mchod brjod kyi yi ge blo gsal tshim byed ces bya ba bzhugs/125 rang la smras pa/ lus gdos bcas 'di sems 'di'i skyur nges shing / /'di nam skyur gyi nges pa cung zad med/ /de med bzhin du yun ring sdod snyam pa'i/ /sems rlom sems can khyed kyi 'khrul tshab la/ /rang nam 'chi dang gar skye cha med kyang / /khong gzhan dag gi yar 'dren byed zer ba'i/ /mi khyod rang la 'chi ba kho byung na/ /las ci 'dra rang byed pa snying rul po/ /dus 'di phyi dang bar do thams cad du/ /rje bla ma las re sa gzhan na med/ /rgyu de bas na mchod brjod 'di ltar byed/ /gang gi sku ni li khri'i mdangs ldan mthong bas yid 'phrog bshes gnyen sku/ /gang gi gsung ni chos kyi char 'bebs thos pas gdung sel dbyangs can gsung / /gang gi thugs ni bde stong rang bzhin dran pas bde ster zag med thugs/ /gang yang yon tan rgyan gyi mdzes pa'i chos rje sa skya paṇa chen rgyal/ /skye ba du mar sbyangs pa'i stobs kyi 'chad rtsod rtsom la thogs pa med/ mu stegs ngan pa'i rgol ba bzlog pas sa steng snyan pa'i grags pas khyab/ /deng dus sa skya paṇa chen zhes pa'i mtshan tsam gyis kyang blo gsal rnams/ /dga' zhing mgu la spro ba bskyed pa'i skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug rgyan rgyal/ /rnam mang mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i gling nas legs bshad yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng / /gang blo ded dpon chen pos blangs pa de nyid deng dus 'gro kun gyi/ /dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur de slad bka' drin mtshungs med pa'i/

/thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen kun nas kun du rgyal gyur cig 'di yan rang don du bris/ yang smras pa/ 'dzam gling phyogs kha gsum po dbang du sdud pa'i srid gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma mthu stobs dbang phyug rje btsun ngag gi dbang po'i rigs brgyud 'dzin pa'i/ tshad med thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ngag dbang dbang rgyal/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i las la 'gran zla bral ba'i/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsal byed ngag dbang kun bsod/ /sems gnyis rgya mtsho lta bu'i thugs rgyud gtams pa'i/ /'dus pa'i yongs 'dzin dam pa rin chen blo gros/ /'dren mchog sna tshogs thabs kyis dgyes par mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ded dpon blo gros rgya mtsho/ /dri med gzhung brgya 'chad la thogs med blo rgyas/ /lung rigs 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i 'dren byed rab yangs/ /sdebs legs rtsom pa'i ro 'dzin bsgyur la mkhas pa'i/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag las chen rnam gnyis/ rta thul bzhin du spyod lam kun nas dul zhing / /ka ta ya na'i bu ltar bslab byar rab gus/ /'od srung bzhin du sbyangs ba'i yon tan ldan pa'i/ /grangs med 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'di rgyal gyur/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'gal 'brel rtsod pa'i dus su/ /lung rigs rjes su gdams pa'i mche sder rnon pos/ /ma rtogs log rtog the tshom glang po'i lus nyid/ /'joms mdzad smra ba'i seng ge 'dus pa'i tshogs rgyal/ /tshul 'di skyes stobs blo gros kyi/ /chu skyes gsung rab rta bdun gyis/ /phye ba'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi ste/ /don gnyer rkang drug dgyes par rol// ༈ //shrī dharm+ma rā dza ma hā karm+ma sha sa na pā la ind+ra sya pra na ba mā mri ta purṇaṇa ma hā dundu bhi na ma shrī bhu mi paṇḍu paṇḍa te na kṛ te bi ha ra tisma/ dpal chos kyi rgyal po chen po phrin las bstan skyong dbang po la rab tu bsngags pa 'chi med gser gyi rnga chen zhes bya ba dpal sa skya'i mkhas pas sbyar ba bzhugs/126

/rgya gar skad du/ shrī dharm+ma rā dza ma hā karm+ma shā sa na pā la ind+ra sya pra ṇa ba mā mṛ ta purṇaṇa mahā dundu bhi ma/ bod skad du/ dpal chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'phrin karm+ma/ las bstan skyong dbang po la rab tu bsngags pa 'chi med gser gyi rnga chen zhes bya ba rje btsun ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phan bde'i 'byung gnas nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i mdzad phrin ngo mtshar che/ /sngon gyi chos rgyal mes dbon de dag dang / /rnam dbyer med pa'i mi dbang rtag tu dge /ngo mtshar 'phrin karm+ma/ las rnam bzhi'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar/ /skyong mdzad skye dgu'i dbang phyug chen po khyed/ /'gro 'di'i gnyen du bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /gang sku legs byas bye ba'i mthu grub pas/ /mdzes shing brjid chags ri dbang lhun po ltar/ /dpa' mdzangs blon po'i gser ris yongs bskor ba/ /nam yang g.yo med bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /gang gsung lugs gnyis blang dor spyi bye brag /ma 'dres gsal bar ston pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs/ /snyan dngags dge ba'i dbang po dang mtshungs pa/ /nam yang 'gal med bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /gang thugs skye dgu ma lus bde ba'i thabs/ /gcig tu dgongs pa'i rgyal sras sems dpa' che/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin yongs la rab brtse ba/ /nam yang 'gyur med bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /gang gi chab srid dpal 'byor yon tan tshogs/ /'khor los bsgyur rgyal rnams dang gnyis med pa'i/ /rmad byung ngo mtshar rnam thar bye ba'i gter/ /sa spyod dbang po bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol/ /de ltar bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa dang / /skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma'i thugs rje yis/ /sprul pa'i chos rgyal bskal brgyar zhabs brtan zhing / /bzhed don lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sa skyong chen po la brtan bzhugs dge legs shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa lnga phrag gcig dang gnyis kyi lhag pa de dag ni mi dbang chen po nyid kyis rje btsun sa skya'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel rgyas la dgongs te gsar du 'dzugs par mdzad pa'i phur pa grwa tshangs kun bzang chos kyi 'byung gnas chen po'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i rgyun gyi chos spyod sku rim du 'dzugs pa'i slad du sa skya pa ā nanda'i kun dga'i/

ming can gyis bha dra ti thi bzang po'i tshes la bris pa'o/ li kha staṃ/ slar yang mi bdag sa dbang chen po'i ngo mtshar ba'i yon tan rnams dran pa'i mod la 'di skad ces smras pa/ sgyu 'phrul sras shākya'i rgyal po'i mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ kyi bstan pa'i yon gnas che/ /khyod kyi yid mkhyen rab kyi mngon brjod/ tshol zur phud lnga 'jam dbyangs kyi mtshan/ pa ste/ dmigs med snying rje rdo rje spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan/ nyi mar mtshungs/ /nus pa lcang lo can phyag rdor gyi mtshan/ pa ji bzhin ldan/ /dkar mtha' thog sbyar ba'i rjes khrid/ la dwangs pa nya gang zhal ras gsal/ sku yi yon tan/ /gsal la ma 'gags gsung gi yon tan/ ma brtabs gdangs snyan gang / /gang la mnga' thugs kyi yon tan/ ba zag pa bag chags spangs/ /spangs pa gang la bdag cag dwangs bas dad/ /lha lam nam mkha'i mngon brjod/ 'od ldan ma ltung skar ma'i mngon brjod/ bgrang yas kyang / /'jig rten snang byed grib ma'i lus kho na/ zla ba'i mngon brjod/ /de bzhin ljongs 'dir rgyal phran gzhal med lha spyi'i ming / can/ /kun gyi khrod na khyed ni stobs 'jigs bzhin/ brgya byin gyi mngon brjod/ shes bya kun mkhyen bar gyi zung ldan/ mkhyen pa'i spyan mnga' bas/ /mkhas rnams yid 'phrog 'phrog byed sa dbang khyed/ /rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dbyangs can zlos gar las/ /tha mal nyid min min zhes 'di na gleng / /des na nyi brten phyogs kyi mngon brjod/ kun las rnam rgyal ba/ /khyod zhabs lhas bstan bskal pa'i mngon brjod/ bar du legs brtan nas/ /ljongs 'di'i yid 'dren mi'i mngon brjod/ ma lus rdzogs ldan ltar/ /bskyangs nas snying po'i sems kyi mngon brjod/ rnyog pa sdig pa'i mngon brjod/ pa zhi bar mdzod/ /stobs bzhi ka'i thog ma'i tshig

ldan legs byas bye ba'i dpal yon can/ /stobs ldan mi dbang khyed kyi bka'i springs yig /stobs ldan gangs ljongs skye dgus gus blangs pas/ /stobs ldan kla klo tha mi ngan pa rnams/ ming gi lhag mar mdzad/ /mun pa 'joms mdzad sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ bstan pa'i srol mang yang / /yid bzang lha'i ming gi mngon brjod/ bcas pa'i 'gro ba'i 'dren pa mchog /bu ram shing pa'i rgyal tshab sa skya pa'i/ shākya thub pa'i mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ /bstan 'di dung dkar nang nas lnga skyes g.yas 'khyil/ lags/ /rang bzhi ka'i thog ma'i zung ldan bar ma chod pa/ /rang sngon bsags las kyi 'phangs pa'i mthus/ skye bo mi bsrun pa 'ga'/ 'jigs 'jigs dmyal skye ba phyi mar/ ba'i me 'obs 'dod rnams la/ /bsil bsil mi dbang thugs brtse ba chen po'i snying / rje'i chu rgyun gyis/ brlan pa'i/ /yang yang khrims kyis bsgral nas gnas skabs drag po ltar bcos nas/ phyi ma myong 'gyur dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal tsam du zad par mdzad nas/ bde la bkod/ /sa skya'i rje btsun bzhed gzhung sa la 'gro/ rgya mtsho'i mngon brjod/ gang las 'ongs pa'i chos sgra grag 'bab chu'i mngon brjod/ ldan rgyun/ /yid skyes ma'i mngon brjod/ nyal slong shes rab kyi mngon brjod/ che ldan mtha' dag la/ /spel nas rgya mtsho'i sa gzhi'i mngon brjod/ gos can khyab par mdzod/ /slob dpon 'khor lo mgon dbang thob pa'i bla ma lhag pa'i lhar gzigs pas/ po'i ngo bor rtogs/ /nyid kyi snying gi siddhi snying po'i thugs la byin rlabs dngos grub myur du zhugs/ dang ring bsil/ /bde gshegs nyer len bshes sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma dge ba'i/ gnyen dge legs bsten/ par mdzad/ dus yun kun du lugs zung chos dang srid kyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad/

lhun du grub/ e ma skal bzang dpyod ldan ma nu'i bu/ mi'i mngon brjod/ shin tu nges pa'i go 'phangs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ don gnyer rnams/ /rgya mtsho'i ska rags sa gzhi'i mngon brjod/ can 'di'i lam spyod pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin gyi/ /gtsug sa skya pa'i/ rgyan chos tshul sprin gyi myu chu'i mngon brjod/ gu yis/ /nang gi byed pa'i sems kyi mngon brjod/ nag nog sdig pa'i mngon brjod/ rims sbyangs te/ rab rnam dpyod dam blo gros kyi mngon brjod/ mthong ldan pas nyams su len shes na/ dpal stug sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi mngon brjod/ tshe 'di nyid la 'grub pa'o/ /de ltar 'gro 'di'i bde skyid byed po mchog /mi dbang gang gi yon tan bsngags pa'i gtam/ /ngo mtshar lha yi rnga chen 'di bgyis pas/ /snyan grags 'dzam gling kun tu khyab gyur cig ces gangs ri'i ljongs kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag la bde skyid ma lus pa 'byung ba'i byed po dam pa/ ris med pa'i sems can mtha' yas pa dag gi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bo chen po/ sngon gyi chos rgyal mes dbon de dag gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i gar gyis snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos bsam bzhin du byon pa'i mdzad 'phrin rmad du byung ba can dpal chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'phrin karma/ las bstan skyong dbang po la bsngags pa 'chi med gser gyi rnga chen zhes bya ba 'di yang / sa la spyod pa'i brgya byin dbang po de nyid kyi thugs dgongs rnam par dkar ba'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba/ shrī sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta mkhas pa/ sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bsam pa dag cing sbyor ba gus pa'i sgo nas 'phags pa'i yul na bha wa dngos po/ ra zhes grags pa/ shing pho khyi'i rgya nag pa/

lo he menta'i kha ba'i dus/ dus kyi tshim byed rgyal gyi zla ba/ kyi zla ba'i dmar cha rgyal ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer brgyad/ tshes la/ gu ṇa ratna ka raḥshrī wan yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas/ bhū mi paṇḍu gnas mchog bzhi thog bla brang chen po'i yang steng sngon med gsar du bskrun pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag gi bsod nams kyi zhing sa dam par gyur pa mi la lha khang rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba dang / rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lnga'i bya 'dab dpe khang gsar pa chos mdzod chen mo dang nye ba'i ngo mtshar 'chi med rdo rje'i pho brang e waṃ byang chub 'byung ba'i gnas mchog gi rang byung dhya na gṛ bsam gtan khang bur/ har legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ākṣa rā'i 'du byed la mkhas pa bkra shis don 'grub kyis bgyis pa 'dis 'phral dang yun du dge legs su gyur cig /swasti dza yantu/ bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig sarba maṅgalaṃ/ thams cad bkra shis/ ka lyā ṇa wardhantu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 110 a myes zhabs/ mthu stobs dbang phyug la gsol 'debs sde tshan 35 nas 126bar/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 109
